definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N,N-dimethylaniline + NADPH + H+ + O2 = N,N-dimethylaniline N-oxide + NADP+ + H2O.

name: dopamine beta-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ascorbate + dopamine + O2 = (R)-noradrenaline + dehydroascorbate + H2O.

name: ecdysone 20-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AH(2) + ecdysone + O2 = 20-hydroxyecdysone + A + H2O.

name: kynurenine 3-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-kynurenine + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + H2O + NADP+.

name: tyrosinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + O2 = L-DOPAquinone + H2O. This reaction can use both monophenols (such as tyrosine) and catechols (o-diphenols) as substrates.

name: peptidylglycine monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-glycine + ascorbate + O2 = peptidyl(2-hydroxyglycine) + dehydroascorbate + H2O.

name: phenylalanine 4-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine + tetrahydrobiopterin + O2 = L-tyrosine + 4-alpha-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin.

name: squalene monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADPH + O2 + squalene = (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene + H2O + NADP+.

name: steroid 11-beta-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a steroid + reduced adrenal ferredoxin + O2 = an 11-beta-hydroxysteroid + oxidized adrenal ferredoxin + H2O.

name: steroid 17-alpha-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a C21-steroid + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = a 17alpha-hydroxy-C21-steroid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: steroid 21-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A C(21) steroid + [reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = a 21-hydroxy-C(21)-steroid + [oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O.

name: tryptophan 5-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + tetrahydrobiopterin + O2 = 5-hydroxy-L-tryptophan + 4-alpha-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin + H2O.

name: tyrosine 3-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + tetrahydrobiopterin + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxy-L-phenylalanine + 4-alpha-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin + H2O.

name: inositol-3-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose 6-phosphate = 1D-myo-inositol 3-phosphate. This reaction requires NAD, which dehydrogenates the CHOH group to CO at C-5 of the glucose 6-phosphate, making C-6 into an active methylene, able to condense with the aldehyde at C-1. Finally, the enzyme-bound NADH reconverts C-5 into the CHOH form.

name: nicotinate-nucleotide diphosphorylase (carboxylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CO2 + diphosphate + nicotinate D-ribonucleotide = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + 2 H+ + quinolinate.

name: nicotinate-nucleotide adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + ATP + H+ = deamido-NAD+ + diphosphate.

name: nicotinate phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinate + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + ATP + H2O = nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + ADP + phosphate + diphosphate.

name: nitric-oxide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + n NADPH + n H+ + m O2 = citrulline + nitric oxide + n NADP+.

name: nuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within nucleic acids.

name: endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within nucleic acids by creating internal breaks.

name: DNA endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within deoxyribonucleic acid by creating internal breaks.

name: RNA endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within ribonucleic acid by creating internal breaks.

name: ribonuclease A activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA to 3'-phosphomononucleotides and 3'-phosphooligonucleotides ending in C-P or U-P with 2',3'-cyclic phosphate intermediates.

name: RNA-DNA hybrid ribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA in RNA-DNA hybrids to 5'-phosphomonoesters.

name: ribonuclease III activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA with 5'-phosphomonoesters and 3'-OH termini; makes two staggered cuts in both strands of dsRNA, leaving a 3' overhang of 2 nt.

name: ribonuclease P activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA, removing 5' extra nucleotides from tRNA precursor.

name: exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of ester linkages within nucleic acids by removing nucleotide residues from the 3' or 5' end.

name: phosphodiesterase I activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential hydrolytic removal of 5'-nucleotides from the 3'-hydroxy termini of 3'-hydroxy-terminated oligonucleotides.

name: DNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' or 3' terminus of a DNA molecule.

name: deoxyribonuclease I activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of DNA to 5'-phosphodinucleotide and 5'-phosphooligonucleotide end products.

name: deoxyribonuclease II activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of DNA to nucleoside 3'-phosphates and 3'-phosphooligonucleotide end-products.

name: RNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' or 3' terminus of an RNA molecule.

name: exoribonuclease H activity
definition: Catalysis of the exonucleolytic cleavage of RNA to 5'-phosphomonoester oligonucleotides in both 5' to 3' and 3' to 5' directions.

name: 5'-3' RNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' terminus of an RNA molecule.

name: poly(A)-specific ribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the exonucleolytic cleavage of poly(A) to 5'-AMP.

name: DNA nuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within deoxyribonucleic acid.

name: RNA nuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of phosphodiester bonds in chains of RNA.

name: tRNA-specific ribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of phosphodiester bonds in tRNA molecules.

name: nucleoside diphosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + nucleoside diphosphate = ADP + nucleoside triphosphate.

name: dinucleotide phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a dinucleotide + H2O = 2 mononucleotides.

name: octanol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-octanol + NAD+ = 1-octanal + H+ + NADH.

name: hydrolase activity, hydrolyzing O-glycosyl compounds
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of any O-glycosyl bond.

name: alpha,alpha-trehalase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha,alpha-trehalose + H2O = 2 D-glucose.

name: alpha-amylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->4)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in polysaccharides containing three or more alpha-(1->4)-linked D-glucose units.

name: alpha-galactosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-D-galactose residues in alpha-D-galactosides, including galactose oligosaccharides, galactomannans and galactolipids.

name: alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-(1->4)-linked alpha-D-glucose residues with release of alpha-D-glucose.

name: alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-D-mannose residues in alpha-D-mannosides.

name: alpha-L-fucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alpha-L-fucoside + H2O = an alcohol + L-fucose.

name: alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues in N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminides.

name: beta-N-acetylhexosaminidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing N-acetyl-D-hexosamine residues in N-acetyl-beta-D-hexosaminides.

name: beta-fructofuranosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a fructofuranosylated fructofuranosyl acceptor + H2O = a non fructofuranosylated fructofuranosyl acceptor + a beta-D-fructofuranoside.

name: beta-galactosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing beta-D-galactose residues in beta-D-galactosides.

name: beta-glucuronidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a beta-D-glucuronoside + H2O = an alcohol + D-glucuronate.

name: beta-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing beta-D-mannose residues in beta-D-mannosides.

name: chitinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->4)-beta linkages of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine (GlcNAc) polymers of chitin and chitodextrins.

name: glycoprotein endo-alpha-1,2-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the terminal alpha-glucosyl-(1,3)-mannosyl unit from Glc-Man(9)-(GlcNAc)(2) oligosaccharide component of the glycoprotein produced in the Golgi membrane.

name: mannosyl-oligosaccharide 1,2-alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the terminal (1->2)-linked alpha-D-mannose residues in an oligo-mannose oligosaccharide.

name: mannosyl-oligosaccharide 1,3-1,6-alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the terminal (1->3)- and (1->6)-linked alpha-D-mannose residues in the mannosyl-oligosaccharide Man(5)(GlcNAc)(3).

name: Glc3Man9GlcNAc2 oligosaccharide glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the exohydrolysis of the non-reducing terminal glucose residue in the mannosyl-oligosaccharide Glc(3)Man(9)GlcNAc(2).

name: oligo-1,6-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in some oligosaccharides produced from starch and glycogen by alpha-amylase, and in isomaltose. Releases a free alpha-D-glucose.

name: sucrose alpha-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sucrose + H2O = alpha-D-glucose + beta-D-fructose.

name: oligosaccharyl transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a oligosaccharyl group to an acceptor molecule, typically another carbohydrate or a lipid.

name: N-acetylglucosaminyldiphosphodolichol N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-diphosphodolichol = UDP + N,N''-diacetylchitobiosyldiphosphodolichol.

name: chitobiosyldiphosphodolichol beta-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N,N'-diacetylchitobiosyl-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + GDP-alpha-D-mannose = a beta-D-Man-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + GDP + H+.

name: dolichyl-diphosphooligosaccharide-protein glycotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide + protein L-asparagine = dolichyl diphosphate + a glycoprotein with the oligosaccharide chain attached by glycosylamine linkage to protein L-asparagine.

name: dolichyl-phosphate beta-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + dolichyl phosphate = UDP + dolichyl beta-D-glucosyl phosphate.

name: dolichyl-phosphate beta-D-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-mannose + dolichyl phosphate = GDP + dolichyl D-mannosyl phosphate.

name: dolichyl-phosphate-glucose-glycolipid alpha-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an alpha-D-glucosyl residue from dolichyl-phosphate D-glucose into a membrane lipid-linked oligosaccharide.

name: ornithine carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carbamoyl phosphate + L-ornithine = phosphate + L-citrulline.

name: ornithine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ornithine + H+ = CO2 + putrescine.

name: L-ornithine transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-oxocarboxylate + L-ornithine = L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + an L-alpha-amino acid.

name: orotate phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: orotidine 5'-phosphate + diphosphate = orotate + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate.

name: dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-dihydroorotate + NAD+ = H+ + NADH + orotate.

name: orotidine-5'-phosphate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + orotidine 5'-phosphate = CO2 + UMP.

name: oxoglutarate dehydrogenase (succinyl-transferring) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue succinyltransferase] + 2-oxoglutarate + H+ = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-succinyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue succinyltransferase] + CO2.

name: pantoate-beta-alanine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + (R)-pantoate + beta-alanine = AMP + diphosphate + (R)-pantothenate.

name: pantothenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-pantothenate + H2O = (R)-pantoate + beta-alanine.

name: pantothenate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + pantothenate = ADP + D-4'-phosphopantothenate.

name: pantetheine-phosphate adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + pantetheine 4'-phosphate = 3'-dephospho-CoA + diphosphate.

name: protein-N-terminal amino-acid acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + an N-terminal L-alpha-aminoacyl-[protein] = CoA + H+ + N-terminal Nalpha-acetyl-L-alpha-aminoacyl-[protein].

name: peptidylamidoglycolate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: peptidylamidoglycolate = peptidyl amide + glyoxylate.

name: peroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a reduced substrate + ROOH = an oxidized substrate + ROH + H2O.

name: glutathione peroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 glutathione + H2O2 = oxidized glutathione + 2 H2O.

name: phenylethanolamine N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + phenylethanolamine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + N-methylphenylethanolamine.

name: phosphoadenylyl-sulfate reductase (thioredoxin) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine 3',5'-diphosphate + H+ + sulfite + thioredoxin disulfide = 3'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate + thioredoxin. Thioredoxin disulfide is the oxidized form of thioredoxin; 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate is also known as PAPS.

name: phosphatidate cytidylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + phosphatidate = diphosphate + CDP-diacylglycerol.

name: phosphatidylcholine-sterol O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylcholine + a sterol = a sterol ester + 1-acylglycerophosphocholine.

name: phosphatidylethanolamine N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + phosphatidylethanolamine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+ + phosphatidyl-N-methylethanolamine.

name: phosphatidylserine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + phosphatidyl-L-serine = CO2 + phosphatidylethanolamine.

name: phosphoacetylglucosamine mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate = N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphate + oxaloacetate = phosphoenolpyruvate + CO2 + other reaction products.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (ATP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + oxaloacetate = ADP + CO2 + H+ + phosphoenolpyruvate.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (GTP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + oxaloacetate = GDP + phosphoenolpyruvate + CO2.

name: phosphoglucomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate = alpha-D-glucose 6-phosphate.

name: phosphomannomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-mannose 1-phosphate = D-mannose 6-phosphate.

name: phosphogluconate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-phospho-D-gluconate + NADP+ = D-ribulose 5-phosphate + CO2 + NADPH + H+.

name: phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phosphoglycerate + NAD+ = 3-phosphohydroxypyruvate + NADH + H+.

name: phosphoglycerate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phospho-D-glycerate + ATP = 3-phospho-D-glyceroyl phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: phosphoglycerate mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R)-2-phosphoglycerate = (2R)-3-phosphoglycerate.

name: glycerophospholipase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a glycerophospholipid.

name: GPI anchor phospholipase D activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycoprotein phosphatidylinositol + H2O = phosphatidate + glycoprotein inositol, by cleavage of the second phosphodiester bond between the phosphate and phospholipid.

name: phosphatidylcholine lysophospholipase A1 activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine + H2O = a fatty acid + H+ + sn-glycerol 3-phosphocholine.

name: A2-type glycerophospholipase activity
definition: A glycerophospholipase activity that cleaves the fatty acid attached to the sn-2 position of the glycerol group of a glycerophospholipid. Substrates include phosphatidylcholine, phosphatidylethanolamine, choline plasmalogen and phosphatides.

name: C-type glycerophospholipase activity
definition: A glycerophospholipase activity that cleaves the first phosphodiester bond between the phosphate and glycerol, producing a mono- or a diacylglycerol, depending on whether the substrate is a lysoglycerophospholipid or a glycerophospholipid.

name: D-type glycerophospholipase activity
definition: A glycerophospholipase activity that cleaves the second phosphodiester bond between the phosphate and phospholipid, releasing a phosphatidic acid.

name: phosphomevalonate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-5-phosphomevalonate + ATP = (R)-5-diphosphomevalonate + ADP + H+.

name: phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine = CMP + diphosphate + (R)-4'-phosphopantothenoyl-L-cysteine. Cysteine can be replaced by some of its derivatives.

name: phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-[(R)-4-phosphonatopantothenoyl]-L-cysteinate + H+ = CO2 + pantetheine 4'-phosphate.

name: phosphopyruvate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-phospho-D-glycerate = phosphoenolpyruvate + H2O.

name: phosphoribosyl-AMP cyclohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(5-phosphonatoribosyl)-5'-AMP + H2O = 1-(5-phosphoribosyl)-5-[(5-phosphoribosylamino)methylideneamino]imidazole-4-carboxamide.

name: phosphoribosyl-ATP diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)-ATP + H2O = 1-(5-phosphonatoribosyl)-5'-AMP + diphosphate + H+.

name: phosphoribosylamine-glycine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-phospho-D-ribosylamine + ATP + glycine = N(1)-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: phosphoribosylaminoimidazole carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxylate + 2 H+ = 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole + CO2.

name: phosphoribosylaminoimidazolesuccinocarboxamide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxylate + L-aspartate + ATP = (2S)-2-[5-amino-1-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxamido]succinate + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: phosphoribosylanthranilate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)anthranilate = 1-(2-carboxyphenylamino)-1-deoxy-D-ribulose 5-phosphate.

name: phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine cyclo-ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-(formamido)-N(1)-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)acetamidine + ATP = 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(2)-formyl-N(1)-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O = 2-(formamido)-N(1)-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)acetamidine + L-glutamate + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: phosphoribosylaminoimidazolecarboxamide formyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10-formyltetrahydrofolate + 5'-phosphoribosyl-5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide = tetrahydrofolate + 5'-phosphoribosyl-5-formamido-4-imidazolecarboxamide.

name: phosphoribosylglycinamide formyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10-formyltetrahydrofolate + N1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide = tetrahydrofolate + N2-formyl-N1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide.

name: 1,4-alpha-oligoglucan phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,4-alpha-D-glucosyl(n) + phosphate = 1,4-alpha-D-glucosyl(n-1) + alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate.

name: O-phospho-L-serine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-phospho-L-serine + 2-oxoglutarate = 3-phosphonooxypyruvate + L-glutamate.

name: poly(ADP-ribose) glycohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of poly(ADP-ribose) at glycosidic (1''-2') linkage of ribose-ribose bond to produce free ADP-ribose.

name: polygalacturonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the random hydrolysis of (1->4)-alpha-D-galactosiduronic linkages in pectate and other galacturonans.

name: polynucleotide 5'-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-phosphopolynucleotide + H2O = a polynucleotide + phosphate.

name: polypeptide N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine + polypeptide = UDP + N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-polypeptide. This reaction is the modification of serine or threonine residues in polypeptide chains by the transfer of a N-acetylgalactose from UDP-N-acetylgalactose to the hydroxyl group of the amino acid; it is the first step in O-glycan biosynthesis.

name: polyribonucleotide nucleotidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RNA(n+1) + phosphate = RNA(n) + a nucleoside diphosphate.

name: porphobilinogen synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 5-aminolevulinate = 2 H2O + H+ + porphobilinogen.

name: procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: procollagen L-proline + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = procollagen trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline + succinate + CO2.

name: proline dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-proline + a quinone = (S)-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate + a quinol + H+.

name: propionyl-CoA carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + propanoyl-CoA + HCO3- = ADP + phosphate + (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA.

name: prenyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a prenyl group from one compound (donor) to another (acceptor).

name: protein farnesyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteinyl-[protein] + (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate = S-(2E,6E)-farnesyl-L-cysteinyl-[protein] + diphosphate.

name: protein geranylgeranyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the covalent addition of a geranylgeranyl (20-carbon isoprenoid) group via thioether linkages to a cysteine residue at or near the C terminus of a protein.

name: CAAX-protein geranylgeranyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: geranylgeranyl diphosphate + protein-cysteine = S-geranylgeranyl-protein + diphosphate. This reaction is the formation of a thioether linkage between the C-1 atom of the geranylgeranyl group and a cysteine residue fourth from the C-terminus of the protein. The protein substrates have the C-terminal sequence CA1A2X, where the terminal residue, X, is preferably leucine and A2 should not be aromatic. Known substrates include most g-subunits of heterotrimeric G proteins and Ras-related GTPases such as members of the Ras and Rac/Rho families.

name: Rab geranylgeranyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 geranylgeranyl diphosphate + protein-cysteine = 2 S-geranylgeranyl-protein + 2 diphosphate. This reaction is the formation of two thioether linkages between the C-1 atom of the geranylgeranyl groups and two cysteine residues within the terminal sequence motifs XXCC, XCXC or CCXX. Known substrates include Ras-related GTPases of a single family and the Rab family.

name: prephenate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: prephenate = phenylpyruvate + H2O + CO2.

name: prephenate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + prephenate = (4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate + CO2 + NADPH.

name: prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoate + AH2 + 2 O2 = A + H2O + prostaglandin H2.

name: prostaglandin-D synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: prostaglandin H(2) = prostaglandin D(2).

name: protein-arginine deiminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + L-arginyl-[protein] = L-citrullyl-[protein] + NH4+, resulting in citrullination of the target protein. This reaction is calcium-dependent.

name: protein C-terminal S-isoprenylcysteine carboxyl O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + protein C-terminal S-farnesyl-L-cysteine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + protein C-terminal S-farnesyl-L-cysteine methyl ester.

name: protein kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the phosphorylation of an amino acid residue in a protein, usually according to the reaction: a protein + ATP = a phosphoprotein + ADP.

name: protein histidine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + protein L-histidine = ADP + protein phospho-L-histidine.

name: protein serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: ATP + protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate.

name: transmembrane receptor protein serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Combining with a signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: ATP protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate.

name: 3-phosphoinositide-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: Phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

name: DNA-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: DNA dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

name: AMP-activated protein kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction requires the presence of AMP.

name: calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: Calmodulin-dependent catalysis of the reactions: ATP + a protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate; and ATP + a protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate. This activity require the presence of calcium-bound calmodulin.

name: elongation factor-2 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + [elongation factor 2] = ADP + [elongation factor 2] phosphate.

name: myosin light chain kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + myosin-light-chain = ADP + myosin-light-chain phosphate.

name: phosphorylase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 ATP + 2 phosphorylase b = 4 ADP + phosphorylase a.

name: cyclic nucleotide-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: cNMP-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

name: cAMP-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: cAMP-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

name: cGMP-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: cGMP dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

name: cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Cyclin-dependent catalysis of the reactions: ATP + protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate.

name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2alpha kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + [eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 alpha subunit] = ADP + [eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 alpha subunit] phosphate.

name: diacylglycerol-dependent serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction requires diacylglycerol.

name: calcium,diacylglycerol-dependent serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Calcium-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction is activated in the presence of diacylglycerol and calcium.

name: diacylglycerol-dependent, calcium-independent serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction is activated by diacylglycerol but not by calcium.

name: G protein-coupled receptor kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + G protein-coupled receptor = ADP + G protein-coupled receptor phosphate.

name: JUN kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: JUN + ATP = JUN phosphate + ADP. This reaction is the phosphorylation and activation of members of the JUN family, a gene family that encodes nuclear transcription factors.

name: JUN kinase kinase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: JNKK + ATP = JNKK phosphate + ADP. This reaction is the phosphorylation and activation of JUN kinase kinases (JNKKs).

name: MAP kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein + ATP = protein phosphate + ADP. This reaction is the phosphorylation of proteins. Mitogen-activated protein kinase; a family of protein kinases that perform a crucial step in relaying signals from the plasma membrane to the nucleus. They are activated by a wide range of proliferation- or differentiation-inducing signals; activation is strong with agonists such as polypeptide growth factors and tumor-promoting phorbol esters, but weak (in most cell backgrounds) by stress stimuli.

name: MAP kinase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the concomitant phosphorylation of threonine (T) and tyrosine (Y) residues in a T-X-Y motif in the activation loop of a MAP kinase (MAPK) substrate.

name: MAP kinase kinase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the phosphorylation and activation of a MAP kinase kinase; each MAP kinase kinase can be phosphorylated by any of several MAP kinase kinase kinases.

name: ribosomal protein S6 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ribosomal protein S6 + ATP = ribosomal protein S6 phosphate + ATP.

name: protein serine/threonine/tyrosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: ATP + a protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate; ATP + a protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate; and ATP + a protein tyrosine = ADP + protein tyrosine phosphate.

name: protein tyrosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein tyrosine = ADP + protein tyrosine phosphate.

name: transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activity
definition: Combining with a signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein-L-tyrosine = ADP + a protein-L-tyrosine phosphate.

name: non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + protein L-tyrosine = ADP + protein L-tyrosine phosphate by a non-membrane spanning protein.

name: protein-L-isoaspartate (D-aspartate) O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + protein L-beta-aspartate = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + protein L-beta-aspartate methyl ester.

name: protein-lysine 6-oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl-[protein] + O2 + H2O = (S)-2-amino-6-oxohexanoyl-[protein] + H2O2 + NH4+.

name: phosphoprotein phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a phosphoprotein + H2O = a protein + phosphate. Together with protein kinases, these enzymes control the state of phosphorylation of cellular proteins and thereby provide an important mechanism for regulating cellular activity.

name: protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein serine phosphate + H2O = protein serine + phosphate, and protein threonine phosphate + H2O = protein threonine + phosphate.

name: calcium-dependent protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: protein serine phosphate + H2O = protein serine + phosphate; and protein threonine phosphate + H2O = protein threonine + phosphate. These reactions require the presence of calcium ions.

name: protein tyrosine phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein tyrosine phosphate + H2O = protein tyrosine + phosphate.

name: non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine phosphate + H2O = non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine + phosphate.

name: protoporphyrinogen oxidase activity, oxygen as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3 O2 + protoporphyrinogen IX = 3 H2O2 + protoporphyrin IX.

name: pseudouridylate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 5-phosphate + uracil = H2O + pseudouridine 5'-phosphate.

name: purine-nucleoside phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: purine nucleoside + phosphate = purine + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.

name: pyridoxal oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:  pyridoxal + H2O + O2 = 4-pyridoxate + H+ + H2O2.

name: pyridoxamine phosphate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyridoxamine 5'-phosphate + H2O + O2 = pyridoxal 5'-phosphate + NH4+ + H2O2. This activity can also oxidize pyridoxine 5'-phosphate to pyridoxal 5'-phosphate + H2O2.

name: pyrimidodiazepine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a pyrimidodiazepine + oxidized glutathione = 6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin + 2 glutathione.

name: pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-proline + NADP+ = 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate + NADPH + H+.

name: pyruvate carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + bicarbonate + pyruvate = ADP + 2 H+ + oxaloacetate + phosphate.

name: pyruvate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-oxo acid = an aldehyde + CO2.

name: pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + pyruvate + H+ = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-acetyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + CO2.

name: pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring) kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit] = ADP + H+ + O-phospho-L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit].

name: [pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring)]-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-phospho-L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit] + H2O = L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit] + phosphate.

name: dihydrolipoyllysine-residue acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-dihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + acetyl-CoA = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-acetyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + CoA.

name: pyruvate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ADP + H+ + phosphoenolpyruvate = ATP + pyruvate.

name: all-trans-retinol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-retinol--[retinol-binding protein] + NAD+ = all-trans-retinal--[retinol-binding protein] + H+ + NADH. Recognizes the substrate both in free form and when bound to cellular-retinol-binding-protein (CRBP1), but has higher affinity for the bound form.

name: riboflavin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 6,7-dimethyl-8-(1-D-ribityl)lumazine + H+ = 5-amino-6-(D-ribitylamino)uracil + riboflavin.

name: ribokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-ribose = ADP + D-ribose 5-phosphate.

name: ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase activity, thioredoxin disulfide as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-deoxyribonucleoside diphosphate + thioredoxin disulfide + H2O = ribonucleoside diphosphate + thioredoxin. Thioredoxin disulfide is the oxidized form of thioredoxin.

name: ribose phosphate diphosphokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 5-phosphate + ATP = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + AMP + 2 H+.

name: D-ribulose-phosphate 3-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribulose 5-phosphate = D-xylulose 5-phosphate.

name: ribose-5-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: aldehydo-D-ribose 5-phosphate = D-ribulose 5-phosphate.

name: saccharopine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of N6-(L-1,3-dicarboxypropyl)-L-lysine to release an amino acid (lysine or glutamate), with the concomitant reduction of an electron acceptor.

name: saccharopine dehydrogenase (NAD+, L-lysine-forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-saccharopine + H2O + NAD+ = 2-oxoglutarate + L-lysine + H+ + NADH.

name: saccharopine dehydrogenase (NADP+, L-glutamate-forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-saccharopine + H2O + NADP+ = L-allysine + L-glutamate + H+ + NADPH.

name: selenide, water dikinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + hydrogen selenide = AMP + 3 H+ + phosphate + selenophosphorate.

name: sepiapterin reductase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: 7,8-dihydrobiopterin + NADP+ = sepiapterin + NADPH + H+ and (6R)-L-erythro-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrobiopterin + 2 NADP+ = 6-pyruvoyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydropterin + 2 H+ + 2 NADPH.

name: serine C-palmitoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + H+ + palmitoyl-CoA = 3-dehydrosphinganine + CO2 + CoA.

name: L-serine:pyruvate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + pyruvate = 3-hydroxypyruvate + L-alanine.

name: shikimate 3-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: shikimate + NADP+ = 3-dehydroshikimate + NADPH + H+.

name: shikimate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + shikimate = 3-phosphoshikimate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: spermidine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosylmethioninamine + putrescine = 5'-methylthioadenosine + spermidine.

name: sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + sphingomyelin = ceramide + choline phosphate + H+.

name: stearoyl-CoA 9-desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 + octadecanoyl-CoA = (9Z)-octadecenoyl-CoA + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O.

name: steroid Delta-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-oxo-delta(5)-steroid = a 3-oxo-delta(4)-steroid.

name: sterol ester esterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a sterol ester + H2O = a fatty acid + a sterol + H+.

name: sterol O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA + a sterol = a sterol ester + CoA.

name: steryl-sulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-beta-hydroxyandrost-5-en-17-one 3-sulfate + H2O = 3-beta-hydroxyandrost-5-en-17-one + sulfate.

name: succinate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: succinate + CoA + nucleotide triphosphate = nucleotide diphosphate + phosphate + succinyl-CoA.

name: succinate-CoA ligase (ADP-forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + succinate + CoA = ADP + succinyl-CoA + phosphate.

name: succinate-CoA ligase (GDP-forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + succinate + CoA = GDP + succinyl-CoA + phosphate.

name: succinate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: succinate semialdehyde + NAD+ + H2O = succinate + NADH + H+.

name: succinyl-CoA hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + succinyl-CoA = CoA + H+ + succinate.

name: sulfate adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an adenylyl group from an adenosine nucleotide (ATP or ADP) to sulfate, forming adenylylsulfate.

name: sulfate adenylyltransferase (ADP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ADP + H+ + sulfate = 5'-adenylyl sulfate + phosphate.

name: sulfate adenylyltransferase (ATP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sulfate + ATP + H+ = adenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + diphosphate.

name: sulfinoalanine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-sulfino-L-alanine = hypotaurine + CO2.

name: sulfite reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydrogen sulfide + 3 NADP+ + 3 H2O = sulfite + 3 NADPH + 3 H+.

name: superoxide dismutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 superoxide + 2 H+ = O2 + H2O2.

name: thiamine diphosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: thiamine diphosphate + H2O = thiamine monophosphate + phosphate.

name: thiamine diphosphokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + thiamine = AMP + thiamine diphosphate.

name: thiamine-phosphate diphosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-amino-2-methyl-5-diphosphomethylpyrimidine + 4-methyl-5-(2-phosphoethyl)-thiazole + H+ = diphosphate + thiamine phosphate.

name: thioether S-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + dimethyl sulfide = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + trimethylsulfonium.

name: thioredoxin-disulfide reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: thioredoxin-dithiol + NADP+ = thioredoxin-disulfide + H+ + NADPH.

name: thiosulfate-cyanide sulfurtransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: thiosulfate + hydrogen cyanide = thiocyanate + sulfite + 2 H+.

name: threonine aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-threonine = glycine + acetaldehyde.

name: threonine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-threonine = 2-oxobutanoate + NH4.

name: threonine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-phospho-L-homoserine + H2O = L-threonine + phosphate.

name: thromboxane-A synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: prostaglandin H(2) = thromboxane A(2).

name: thymidine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + thymidine = ADP + thymidine 5'-phosphate.

name: dTMP kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTMP + ATP = dTDP + ADP.

name: thymidylate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + dUMP = 7,8-dihydrofolate + thymidylate.

name: thyroxine 5'-deiodinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine + iodide + acceptor + H+ = L-thyroxine + acceptor-H2.

name: transaldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sedoheptulose 7-phosphate + D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate = D-erythrose 4-phosphate + D-fructose 6-phosphate.

name: transketolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reversible transfer of a 2-carbon ketol group (CH2OH-CO-) from a ketose phosphate donor to an aldose phosphate acceptor.

name: transposase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transposition of transposable elements or transposons. Transposases are involved in recombination required for transposition and are site-specific for the transposon/transposable element.

name: trehalose-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha,alpha-trehalose 6-phosphate + H2O = alpha,alpha-trehalose + phosphate.

name: triacylglycerol lipase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a triacylglycerol + H2O = a diacylglycerol + a fatty acid + H+.

name: triose-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate = dihydroxyacetone phosphate.

name: tRNA (5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridylate)(34)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-aminomethyl-2-thiouridine34 in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridine34 in tRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This enzyme specifically adds the terminal methyl group of 5-[(methylamino)methyl]-2-thiouridylate.

name: CCA tRNA nucleotidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a tRNA precursor + ATP + 2 CTP = a tRNA with a 3' CCA end + 3 diphosphate.

name: aminoacyl-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the formation of aminoacyl-tRNA from ATP, amino acid, and tRNA with the release of diphosphate and AMP.

name: alanine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-alanine + tRNA(Ala) = AMP + diphosphate + L-alanyl-tRNA(Ala).

name: arginine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-arginine + tRNA(Arg) = AMP + diphosphate + L-arginyl-tRNA(Arg).

name: aspartate-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-aspartate + tRNA(Asp) = AMP + diphosphate + L-aspartyl-tRNA(Asp).

name: asparagine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-asparagine + ATP + tRNA(Asn) = AMP + Asn-tRNA(Asn) + diphosphate + 2 H+.

name: cysteine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-cysteine + tRNA(Cys) = AMP + diphosphate + L-cysteinyl-tRNA(Cys).

name: glutamate-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-glutamate + tRNA(Glu) = AMP + diphosphate + L-glutamyl-tRNA(Glu).

name: glutamine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-glutamine + tRNA(Gln) = AMP + diphosphate + L-glutaminyl-tRNA(Gln).

name: glycine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + glycine + tRNA(Gly) = AMP + diphosphate + glycyl-tRNA(Gly).

name: histidine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-histidine + tRNA(His) = AMP + diphosphate + L-histidyl-tRNA(His).

name: isoleucine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-isoleucine + ATP + tRNA(Ile) = L-isoleucyl-tRNA(Ile) + AMP + diphosphate + 2 H+.

name: leucine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: leucine + ATP + tRNA(Leu) = AMP + diphosphate + 2 H+ + Leu-tRNA(Leu).

name: lysine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-lysine + tRNA(Lys) = AMP + diphosphate + L-lysyl-tRNA(Lys).

name: methionine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-methionine + tRNA(Met) = AMP + diphosphate + L-methionyl-tRNA(Met).

name: phenylalanine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-phenylalanine + tRNA(Phe) = AMP + diphosphate + L-phenylalanyl-tRNA(Phe).

name: proline-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-proline + tRNA(Pro) = AMP + diphosphate + L-prolyl-tRNA(Pro).

name: serine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-serine + tRNA(Ser) = AMP + diphosphate + L-seryl-tRNA(Ser). Also catalyzes the formation of L-seryl-tRNA(Sec) from tRNA(Sec), the special tRNA for selenocysteine.

name: threonine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-threonine + tRNA(Thr) = AMP + diphosphate + L-threonyl-tRNA(Thr).

name: tryptophan-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-tryptophan + tRNA(Trp) = AMP + diphosphate + L-tryptophanyl-tRNA(Trp).

name: tyrosine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + ATP + tRNA(Tyr) = L-tyrosyl-tRNA(Tyr) + AMP + diphosphate + 2 H+.

name: valine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-valine + ATP + tRNA(Val) = L-valyl-tRNA(Val) + AMP + diphosphate + 2 H+.

name: L-tryptophan 2,3-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + O2 = N-formyl-L-kynurenine.

name: tryptophan synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + (1S,2R)-1-C-(indol-3-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate = L-tryptophan + glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + H2O.

name: tubulin-tyrosine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + detyrosinated alpha-tubulin + L-tyrosine = alpha-tubulin + ADP + phosphate.

name: tyramine-beta hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tyramine + L-ascorbate + O2 = (R)-octopamine + L-dehydroascorbate + H2O.

name: tyrosine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine = tyramine + CO2.

name: L-tyrosine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + 2-oxoglutarate = 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate + L-glutamate.

name: ubiquitin activating enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: E1 + ubiquitin + ATP--> E1-ubiquitin + AMP + PPi, where the E1-ubiquitin linkage is a thioester bond between the C-terminal glycine of Ub and a sulfhydryl side group of an E1 cysteine residue. This is the first step in a cascade of reactions in which ubiquitin is ultimately added to a protein substrate.

name: ubiquitin-protein transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of ubiquitin from one protein to another via the reaction X-Ub + Y = Y-Ub + X, where both X-Ub and Y-Ub are covalent linkages.

name: cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity
definition: An thiol-dependent isopeptidase activity that cleaves ubiquitin from a target protein to which it is conjugated.

name: uracil DNA N-glycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the damaged DNA base and the deoxyribose sugar, releasing a free base and leaving an apyrimidinic (AP) site. Enzymes with this activity recognize and remove uracil bases in DNA that result from the deamination of cytosine or the misincorporation of dUTP opposite an adenine.

name: uracil phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: diphosphate + UMP = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + uracil.

name: urate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: urate + O2 + H2O = 5-hydroxyisourate + H2O2.

name: urea carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + bicarbonate + urea = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate + urea-1-carboxylate.

name: ureidoglycolate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-ureidoglycolate + H2O + 2 H+ = CO2 + glyoxylate + 2 NH4.

name: uridine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + uridine = ADP + UMP.

name: uridine phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine + phosphate = uracil + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.

name: uroporphyrin-III C-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uroporphyrinogen III + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = precorrin-2 + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

name: uroporphyrinogen-III synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydroxymethylbilane = H2O + uroporphyrinogen III.

name: uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uroporphyrinogen-III = coproporphyrinogen + 4 CO2.

name: xanthine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: xanthine + NAD+ + H2O = urate + NADH + H+.

name: xanthine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: xanthine + H2O + O2 = urate + H2O2.

name: D-xylulokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-xylulose + ATP = D-xylulose 5-phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: enzyme inhibitor activity
definition: A molecular function regulator that reduces a catalytic activity.

name: dUTP pyrophosphatase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of dUTP pyrophosphatase.

name: phospholipase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a phospholipase, an enzyme that catalyzes of the hydrolysis of a phospholipid.

name: protein kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a protein kinase.

name: cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase.

name: cAMP-dependent protein kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a cAMP-dependent protein kinase.

name: protein phosphatase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a protein phosphatase.

name: protein serine/threonine phosphatase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a serine/threonine protein phosphatase, an enzyme that catalyzes the reaction: protein serine/threonine phosphate + H2O = protein serine/threonine + phosphate.

name: endopeptidase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of an endopeptidase.

name: serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a serine-type endopeptidase.

name: cysteine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a cysteine-type endopeptidase.

name: asialoglycoprotein receptor activity
definition: Receiving an asialoglycoprotein, and delivering the asialoglycoprotein into the cell via endocytosis. An asialoglycoprotein is a plasma glycoproteins from which the terminal sialic acid residue on their complex carbohydrate groups has been removed. The asialoglycoprotein receptor recognizes the terminal galactose and N-acetylgalactosamine units of the asialoglycoprotein, the receptor-ligand complex is internalized and transported to a sorting organelle where disassociation occurs before the receptor is recycled to the cell membrane.

name: complement receptor activity
definition: Combining with any component or product of the complement cascade and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: complement component C3a receptor activity
definition: Combining with the C3a product of the complement cascade and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: complement component C3b receptor activity
definition: Combining with the C3b product of the complement cascade and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: complement component C5a receptor activity
definition: Combining with the C5a product of the complement cascade and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: nuclear receptor activity
definition: A DNA-binding transcription factor activity regulated by binding to a ligand that modulates the transcription of specific gene sets transcribed by RNA polymerase II. Nuclear receptor ligands are usually lipid-based (such as a steroid hormone) and the binding of the ligand to its receptor often occurs in the cytosol, which leads to its translocation to the nucleus.

name: nuclear glucocorticoid receptor activity
definition: A nuclear receptor activity regulated by glucocorticoid binding and modulating the transcription of specific gene sets transcribed by RNA polymerase II.

name: transmembrane signaling receptor activity
definition: Combining with an extracellular or intracellular signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity or state as part of signal transduction.

name: GABA-A receptor activity
definition: Combining with the amino acid gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA, 4-aminobutyrate) to initiate a change in cell activity. GABA-A receptors function as chloride channels.

name: cell adhesion receptor activity
definition: The binding by a cell-adhesion protein on the cell surface to an extracellular matrix component, to mediate adhesion of the cell to the external substrate or to another cell and to initiate intracellular signaling. Cell adhesion receptors include integrins and cadherins.

name: cytokine receptor activity
definition: Combining with a cytokine and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: ciliary neurotrophic factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with ciliary neurotrophic factor (CNTF) and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: erythropoietin receptor activity
definition: Combining with erythropoietin and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF) and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: granulocyte colony-stimulating factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (G-CSF) and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: growth hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with a growth hormone and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interferon receptor activity
definition: Combining with an interferon and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: type I interferon receptor activity
definition: Combining with a type I interferon and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity. Type I interferons include the interferon-alpha, beta, delta, epsilon, zeta, kappa, tau, and omega gene families.

name: type II interferon receptor activity
definition: Combining with interferon-gamma (a type II interferon) and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-1 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-1 to initiate a change in cell activity. Interleukin-1 is produced mainly by activated macrophages and is involved in the inflammatory response.

name: interleukin-1, type I, activating receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-1 to initiate a change in cell activity via signaling pathways and mediated by adaptor proteins.

name: interleukin-1, type II, blocking receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-1 to initiate a change in cell activity by inhibiting the activity of type I interleukin receptors.

name: interleukin-2 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-2 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-3 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-3 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-4 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-4 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-5 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-5 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-6 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-6 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-7 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-7 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-8 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-8 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-9 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-9 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-10 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-10 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-11 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-11 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: leukemia inhibitory factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF) and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: oncostatin-M receptor activity
definition: Combining with oncostatin-M and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: prolactin receptor activity
definition: Combining with prolactin and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: G protein-coupled receptor activity
definition: Combining with an extracellular signal and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: extracellularly ATP-gated monoatomic cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a monoatomic cation by a channel that opens when ATP is bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts on the extracellular side of the plasma membrane.

name: mating-type factor pheromone receptor activity
definition: Combining with a mating-type factor pheromone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: mating-type a-factor pheromone receptor activity
definition: Combining with the mating-type a-factor pheromone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: mating-type alpha-factor pheromone receptor activity
definition: Combining with the mating-type alpha-factor pheromone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: adrenergic receptor activity
definition: Combining with epinephrine or norepinephrine and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating the alpha-subunit of an associated heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: alpha-adrenergic receptor activity
definition: Combining with epinephrine or norepinephrine to initiate a change in cell activity via activation of a G protein, with pharmacological characteristics of alpha-adrenergic receptors.

name: alpha1-adrenergic receptor activity
definition: Combining with epinephrine or norepinephrine to initiate a change in cell activity via activation of a G protein, with pharmacological characteristics of alpha1-adrenergic receptors; the activity involves transmitting the signal to the Gq alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G protein.

name: alpha2-adrenergic receptor activity
definition: Combining with epinephrine or norepinephrine to initiate a change in cell activity via activation of a G protein, with pharmacological characteristics of alpha2-adrenergic receptors; the activity involves transmitting the signal to the Gi alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G protein.

name: beta-adrenergic receptor activity
definition: Combining with epinephrine or norepinephrine to initiate a change in cell activity via activation of a G protein, with pharmacological characteristics of beta-adrenergic receptors; the activity involves transmitting the signal to the Gs alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G protein.

name: beta1-adrenergic receptor activity
definition: Combining with epinephrine or norepinephrine to initiate a change in cell activity via activation of a G protein, with pharmacological characteristics of beta1-adrenergic receptors.

name: beta2-adrenergic receptor activity
definition: Combining with epinephrine or norepinephrine to initiate a change in cell activity via activation of a G protein, with pharmacological characteristics of beta2-adrenergic receptors.

name: angiotensin type II receptor activity
definition: An angiotensin receptor activity that acts via Gi protein coupling and cGMP (NO) generation, and may also act via additional signaling mechanisms.

name: bombesin receptor activity
definition: Combining with bombesin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: bradykinin receptor activity
definition: Combining with bradykinin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: calcitonin receptor activity
definition: Combining with calcitonin and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: cannabinoid receptor activity
definition: Combining with a cannabinoid to initiate a change in cell activity. Cannabinoids are a class of diverse chemical compounds that include the endocannabinoids and the phytocannabinoids.

name: chemokine receptor activity
definition: Combining with a chemokine, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity. Chemokines are a family of small chemotactic cytokines; their name is derived from their ability to induce directed chemotaxis in nearby responsive cells. All chemokines possess a number of conserved cysteine residues involved in intramolecular disulfide bond formation. Some chemokines are considered pro-inflammatory and can be induced during an immune response to recruit cells of the immune system to a site of infection, while others are considered homeostatic and are involved in controlling the migration of cells during normal processes of tissue maintenance or development. Chemokines are found in all vertebrates, some viruses and some bacteria.
definition_xrefs: [GOC:BHF, GOC:rl, GOC:signaling, IUPHAR_GPCR:1280, PMID:12183377, PMID:8662823, Wikipedia:Chemokine]

name: cholecystokinin receptor activity
definition: Combining with cholecystokinin and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein to initiate a change in cell activity. Cholecystokinin can act as a neuropeptide or as a gastrointestinal hormone.

name: dopamine neurotransmitter receptor activity
definition: Combining with the neurotransmitter dopamine to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: icosanoid receptor activity
definition: Combining with an icosanoid to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: prostanoid receptor activity
definition: Combining with a prostanoid, any compound based on or derived from the prostanoate structure, to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: prostaglandin receptor activity
definition: Combining with a prostaglandin (PG) to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: prostaglandin D receptor activity
definition: Combining with prostaglandin D (PGD(2)) to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: prostaglandin E receptor activity
definition: Combining with prostaglandin E (PGE(2)) to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: prostaglandin F receptor activity
definition: Combining with prostaglandin F (PGF (2-alpha)) to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: thromboxane receptor activity
definition: Combining with a thromboxane (TXA) to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: thromboxane A2 receptor activity
definition: Combining with thromboxane A2 (TXA(2)) and transmitting the signal across the membrane to activate an associated G-protein.

name: endothelin receptor activity
definition: Combining with endothelin and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: follicle-stimulating hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with follicle-stimulating hormone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: luteinizing hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with luteinizing hormone (also called lutropin) to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: G protein-coupled GABA receptor activity
definition: Combining with the amino acid gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA, 4-aminobutyrate) and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: galanin receptor activity
definition: Combining with galanin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: glucagon receptor activity
definition: Combining with glucagon and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: gonadotropin-releasing hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with gonadotropin-releasing hormone to initiate a change in cell activity. Gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) is a peptide hormone responsible for the release of follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) and luteinizing hormone (LH) from the anterior pituitary. GnRH is synthesized and released by the hypothalamus.

name: histamine receptor activity
definition: Combining with histamine to initiate a change in cell activity. Histamine is a physiologically active amine, found in plant and animal tissue and released from mast cells as part of an allergic reaction in humans.

name: glutamate-gated receptor activity
definition: Catalysis of the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when glutamate has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: AMPA glutamate receptor activity
definition: An ionotropic glutamate receptor activity that exhibits fast gating by glutamate and acts by opening a cation channel permeable to sodium, potassium, and, in the absence of a GluR2 subunit, calcium.

name: NMDA glutamate receptor activity
definition: A cation channel that opens in response to binding by extracellular glutmate, but only if glycine or D-serine is also bound and the membrane is depolarized. Voltage gating is indirect, due to ejection of bound magnesium from the pore at permissive voltages.

name: leukotriene receptor activity
definition: Combining with a leukotriene to initiate a change in cell activity. Leukotrienes are pharmacologically active substances with a set of three conjugated double bonds; some contain a peptide group based on cysteine.

name: melanocortin receptor activity
definition: Combining with melanocortin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: corticotropin receptor activity
definition: Combining with corticotropin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: beta-endorphin receptor activity
definition: Combining with beta-endorphin, and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein. Beta-endorphin is a peptide, 31 amino acids long, resulting from processing of the precursor proopiomelanocortin (POMC).

name: melanocyte-stimulating hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with melanocyte-stimulating hormone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: N-formyl peptide receptor activity
definition: Combining with an N-formyl peptide to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: neuropeptide Y receptor activity
definition: Combining with neuropeptide Y to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: olfactory receptor activity
definition: Combining with an odorant and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity in response to detection of smell.

name: G protein-coupled opioid receptor activity
definition: Combining with an opioid (any narcotic derived from or resembling opium), and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein.

name: octopamine receptor activity
definition: Combining with the biogenic amine octopamine to initiate a change in cell activity. Octopamine is found in both vertebrates and invertebrates and can have properties both of a hormone and a neurotransmitter and acts as an adrenergic agonist.

name: oxytocin receptor activity
definition: Combining with oxytocin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: parathyroid hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with parathyroid hormone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: platelet activating factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with platelet activating factor to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: G protein-coupled serotonin receptor activity
definition: Combining with the biogenic amine serotonin and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein. Serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine) is a neurotransmitter and hormone found in vertebrates and invertebrates.

name: somatostatin receptor activity
definition: Combining with somatostatin to initiate a change in cell activity. Somatostatin is a peptide hormone that regulates the endocrine system by signaling via G protein-coupled somatostatin receptors. Somatostatin has two active forms produced by proteolytic cleavage: a 14 amino acid peptide (SST-14) and a 28 amino acid peptide (SST-28).

name: tachykinin receptor activity
definition: Combining with a tachykinin neuropeptide and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein.

name: thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with thyroid-stimulating hormone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: thyrotropin-releasing hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with thyrotropin-releasing hormone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: transferrin receptor activity
definition: Combining selectively with transferrin, and delivering transferrin into the cell via endocytosis. Transferrin is a major iron carrier protein in vertebrates.

name: vasoactive intestinal polypeptide receptor activity
definition: Combining with vasoactive intestinal polypeptide to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: vasopressin receptor activity
definition: Combining with vasopressin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase activity
definition: Combining with a signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: protein tyrosine phosphate + H2O = protein tyrosine + phosphate.

name: ephrin receptor activity
definition: Combining with an ephrin receptor ligand to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: GPI-linked ephrin receptor activity
definition: Combining with a GPI-anchored ephrin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: transmembrane-ephrin receptor activity
definition: Combining with a transmembrane ephrin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: epidermal growth factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with an epidermal growth factor receptor ligand and transmitting the signal across the plasma membrane to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: fibroblast growth factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with a fibroblast growth factor receptor ligand and transmitting the signal across the plasma membrane to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: hepatocyte growth factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with hepatocyte growth factor receptor ligand and transmitting the signal across the plasma membrane to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: insulin receptor activity
definition: Combining with insulin receptor ligand and transmitting the signal across the plasma membrane to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: insulin-like growth factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with insulin-like growth factor receptor ligand and transmitting the signal across the plasma membrane to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: macrophage colony-stimulating factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) receptor ligand and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein-L-tyrosine = ADP + a protein-L-tyrosine phosphate.

name: platelet-derived growth factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with platelet-derived growth factor receptor ligand and transmitting the signal across the plasma membrane to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: platelet-derived growth factor alpha-receptor activity
definition: Combining with platelet-derived growth factor isoform PDGF-AA, PDGF-BB or PDGF-AB to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: platelet-derived growth factor beta-receptor activity
definition: Combining with platelet-derived growth factor isoform PDGF-BB or PDGF-AB to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: stem cell factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with stem cell factor (SCF) receptor ligand and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein-L-tyrosine = ADP + a protein-L-tyrosine phosphate. Stem cell factor is a cytokine that stimulates mast cell growth and differentiation.

name: vascular endothelial growth factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with a vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) receptor ligand and transmitting the signal across the plasma membrane to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: transforming growth factor beta receptor activity
definition: Combining with a transforming growth factor beta (TGFbeta) and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: ATP protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate.

name: transforming growth factor beta receptor activity, type I
definition: Combining with a complex of transforming growth factor beta and a type II TGF-beta receptor to initiate a change in cell activity; upon binding, acts as a downstream transducer of TGF-beta signals.

name: transforming growth factor beta receptor activity, type II
definition: Combining with transforming growth factor beta to initiate a change in cell activity; upon ligand binding, binds to and catalyzes the phosphorylation of a type I TGF-beta receptor.

name: neurotrophin receptor activity
