definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 3' terminus of a DNA molecule.

name: single-stranded DNA exodeoxyribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' or 3' terminus of a single-stranded DNA molecule.

name: DNA binding, bending
definition: The activity of binding selectively and non-covalently to and distorting the original structure of DNA, typically a straight helix, into a bend, or increasing the bend if the original structure was intrinsically bent due to its sequence.

name: structural constituent of muscle
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a muscle fiber.

name: voltage-gated monoatomic anion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an anion by a voltage-gated channel. An anion is a negatively charged ion. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

name: double-stranded DNA exodeoxyribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' or 3' terminus of a double-stranded DNA molecule.

name: single-stranded DNA 3'-5' DNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 3' terminus of a single-stranded DNA molecule.

name: double-stranded DNA 3'-5' DNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 3' terminus of a double-stranded DNA molecule.

name: 7S RNA binding
definition: Binding to a 7S RNA, the RNA component of the signal recognition particle (SRP).

name: structural constituent of vitelline membrane
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the vitelline membrane of an egg. An example of this is found in Drosophila melanogaster.

name: protein prenyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the covalent addition of an isoprenoid group such as a farnesyl or geranylgeranyl group via thioether linkages to a cysteine residue in a protein.

name: transmembrane protein transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a protein from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: monoatomic cation transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of cation from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: methyl-CpG binding
definition: Binding to a methylated cytosine/guanine dinucleotide.

name: protein tyrosine/threonine phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: protein threonine phosphate + H2O = protein threonine + phosphate; and protein tyrosine phosphate + H2O = protein tyrosine + phosphate.

name: high voltage-gated calcium channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion by a high voltage-gated channel. A high voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on high voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

name: low voltage-gated calcium channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion by a low voltage-gated channel. A low voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on low voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

name: gamma-butyrobetaine dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoate + O2 = carnitine + CO2 + succinate.

name: MAP kinase kinase kinase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the phosphorylation of serine and threonine residues in a mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase (MAPKKK), resulting in activation of MAPKKK. MAPKKK signaling pathways relay, amplify and integrate signals from the plasma membrane to the nucleus in response to a diverse range of extracellular stimuli.

name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat (consensus YSPTSPS) = ADP + H+ + phosphorylated RNA polymerase II.

name: sialyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of sialic acid to an acceptor molecule, typically the terminal portions of the sialylated glycolipids (gangliosides) or to the N- or O-linked sugar chains of glycoproteins.

name: acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an N-acetylglucosaminyl residue from UDP-N-acetyl-glucosamine to a sugar.

name: acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an N-acetylgalactosaminyl residue from UDP-N-acetyl-galactosamine to an oligosaccharide.

name: galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a galactosyl group to an acceptor molecule, typically another carbohydrate or a lipid.

name: thioredoxin peroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [thioredoxin]-dithiol + H2O2 = [thioredoxin]-disulfide + H2O.

name: mechanosensitive monoatomic ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an monoatomic ion by a channel that opens in response to a mechanical stress.

name: IkappaB kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + IkappaB protein = ADP + IkappaB phosphoprotein.

name: cholesterol monooxygenase (side-chain-cleaving) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholesterol + reduced adrenal ferredoxin + O2 = pregnenolone + 4-methylpentanal + oxidized adrenal ferredoxin + H2O.

name: steroid 7-alpha-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a steroid + AH2 + O2 = 7-alpha-hydroxysteroid + H2O.

name: steroid 15-alpha-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] + O2 + a steroid = oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] + H2O + H+ + 15alpha-hydroxy steroid.

name: coumarin 7-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: coumarin + O2 + NADPH + H+ = hydroxycoumarin + H2O + NADP+.

name: testosterone 16-alpha-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + testosterone = 16alpha,17beta-dihydroxyandrost-4-en-3-one + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: arachidonate monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the incorporation of one atom from molecular oxygen into arachidonic acid and the reduction of the other atom of oxygen to water.

name: arachidonate epoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of an NADPH- and oxygen-dependent reaction that converts arachidonic acid to a cis-epoxyeicosatrienoic acid.

name: steroid hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the formation of a hydroxyl group on a steroid by incorporation of oxygen from O2.

name: oxysterol 7-alpha-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7-oxocholesterol + H+ + NADPH = 7alpha-hydroxycholesterol + NADP+.

name: sterol 12-alpha-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a steroid + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = a 12-alpha-hydroxysteroid + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]- H2O +H+.

name: sterol 14-demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 14alpha-methyl steroid + 3 O2 + 3 reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = a delta14 steroid + formate + 4 H+ + 4 H2O + 3 oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase].

name: retinoic acid 4-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the conversion of retinoic acid to 4-hydroxy-retinoic acid.

name: 25-hydroxycholecalciferol-24-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydroxylation of C-24 of 25-hydroxycholecalciferol (25-hydroxyvitamin D3) to form 24(R),25-dihydroxycholecalciferol.

name: arachidonate 14,15-epoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of an NADPH- and oxygen-dependent reaction that converts arachidonic acid to cis-14,15-epoxyeicosatrienoic acid.

name: arachidonate 11,12-epoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of an NADPH- and oxygen-dependent reaction that converts arachidonic acid to cis-11,12-epoxyeicosatrienoic acid.

name: 3'-5' exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of ester linkages within nucleic acids by removing nucleotide residues from the 3' end.

name: 5'-3' exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of ester linkages within nucleic acids by removing nucleotide residues from the 5' end.

name: CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a coenzyme A (CoA) group from one compound (donor) to another (acceptor).

name: 4-hydroxybenzoate polyprenyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + an all-trans-polyprenyl diphosphate = a 4-hydroxy-3-all-trans-polyprenylbenzoate + diphosphate.

name: 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanosine triphosphate pyrophosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanosine triphosphate (8-oxo-GTP) + H2O = 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanosine diphosphate (8-oxo-GDP) + phosphate. 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanosine triphosphate (8-oxo-GTP) is the oxidised form of the free guanine nucleotide and can act as a potent mutagenic substrate for transcription.

name: fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a fucosyl group to an acceptor molecule, typically another carbohydrate or a lipid.

name: protein-N-terminal asparagine amidohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-terminal L-asparaginyl-[protein] + H+ + H2O = N-terminal L-aspartyl-[protein] + NH4+. This reaction is the deamidation of an N-terminal asparagine residue in a peptide or protein.

name: RNA lariat debranching enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of branched RNA structures that contain vicinal 2'-5'- and 3'-5'-phosphodiester bonds at a branch point nucleotide.

name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat--phospho-L-serine/threonine (consensus YSPTSPS) + H2O = RNA polymerase II large subunit + phosphate.

name: long-chain fatty-acyl-glutamate deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-long-chain-fatty-acyl-L-glutamate + H2O = a fatty acid anion + L-glutamate.

name: beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing beta-D-glucose residues with release of beta-D-glucose.

name: glycoprotein 6-alpha-L-fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(4)-{N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-(1->3)-[N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-(1->6)]-beta-D-mannosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl}-L-asparagine + GDP-L-fucose = N(4)-{N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-(1->3)-[N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-(1->6)]-beta-D-mannosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->4)-[alpha-L-fucosyl-(1->6)]-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl}asparagine + GDP + H+.

name: 2-methoxy-6-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-methoxy-6-all-trans-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 6-methoxy-3-methyl-2-all-trans-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

name: protein kinase C inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of protein kinase C, an enzyme which phosphorylates a protein.

name: calcium-dependent protein kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a calcium-dependent protein kinase.

name: ribonuclease inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of ribonuclease.

name: phosphatidylethanolamine binding
definition: Binding to a phosphatidylethanolamine, a class of glycerophospholipids in which a phosphatidyl group is esterified to the hydroxyl group of ethanolamine.

name: selenium binding
definition: Binding to a selenium (Se) ion.

name: vitamin E binding
definition: Binding to a vitamin E, tocopherol, which includes a series of eight structurally similar compounds. Alpha-tocopherol is the most active form in humans and is a powerful biological antioxidant.

name: JUN kinase binding
definition: Binding to JUN kinase, an enzyme that catalyzes the phosphorylation and activation of members of the JUN family.

name: thyrotropin-releasing hormone activity
definition: The action characteristic of thyrotropin-releasing hormone (TRH), a hormone released by the mammalian hypothalamus into the hypophyseal-portal circulation in response to neural and/or chemical stimuli. Upon receptor binding, TRH increases the secretion of thyroid-stimulating hormone by the anterior pituitary.

name: inositol-1,4,5-trisphosphate 3-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate + ATP = 1D-myo-inositol 1,3,4,5-tetrakisphosphate + ADP + H+.

name: 3'(2'),5'-bisphosphate nucleotidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + H2O = adenosine 5'-phosphate + phosphate.

name: 3-hydroxyisobutyrate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxy-2-methylpropanoate + NAD+ = 2-methyl-3-oxopropanoate + NADH + H+.

name: phosphofructokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group, usually from ATP, to a phosphofructose substrate molecule.

name: CDP-diacylglycerol-glycerol-3-phosphate 3-phosphatidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + CDP-diacylglycerol = 3-(3-sn-phosphatidyl)-sn-glycerol 1-phosphate + CMP + H+.

name: D-aspartate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-aspartate + H2O + O2 = H2O2 + NH4+ + oxaloacetate.

name: GDP-mannose 4,6-dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-alpha-D-mannose = GDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-alpha-D-mannose + H2O.

name: L-ascorbate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 L-ascorbate + O2 = 4 monodehydroascorbate + 2 H2O.

name: N-acetylglucosamine-6-phosphate deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate = acetate + D-glucosamine 6-phosphate.

name: N-acetylglucosamine-6-sulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the 6-sulfate group of the N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-sulfate units of heparan sulfate and keratan sulfate.

name: RNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the formation of a phosphodiester bond between a hydroxyl group at the end of one RNA chain and the phosphate group at the end of another.

name: L-alanine:glyoxylate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-alanine + glyoxylate = pyruvate + glycine.

name: alpha-1,3-mannosylglycoprotein 4-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + (N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,3-(beta-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-1,2-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,6)-beta-D-mannosyl-R = UDP + N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,4-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-1,2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,3-(beta-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-1,2-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,6)-beta-D-mannosyl-R.

name: alpha-1,6-mannosylglycoprotein 2-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + alpha-D-mannosyl-1,6-(N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,2-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,3)-beta-D-mannosyl-R = UDP + N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,2-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,6-(N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,2-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,3)-beta-D-mannosyl-R.

name: alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues in N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosaminides.

name: carnitine O-octanoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-carnitine + octanoyl-CoA = CoA + O-octanoyl-(R)-carnitine.

name: chondroitin 6-sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + chondroitin = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + chondroitin 6'-sulfate.

name: dTDP-glucose 4,6-dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTDP-glucose = dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-alpha-D-glucose + H2O.

name: formylmethionine deformylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-formyl-L-methionine + H2O = L-methionine + formate.

name: hydroxypyruvate reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-glycerate + NAD+ = 3-hydroxypyruvate + NADH + H+.

name: glycogenin glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + glycogenin = UDP + glucosylglycogenin. This first reaction is a self glucosylation. Further UDP-glucose goups are added to the [1,4-alpha-D-glucosyl](n) group of glycogenin until a length of about 5-13 residues.

name: [heparan sulfate]-glucosamine 3-sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucosaminyl-[heparan sulfate](n) + 3'-phosphoadenylyl sulfate = 3-sulfo-alpha-D-glucosaminyl-[heparan sulfate](n) + adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + H+.

name: 3-methylbutanoyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methylbutanoyl-CoA + H+ + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = 3-methyl-(2E)-butenoyl-CoA + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein].

name: ornithine cyclodeaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ornithine = L-proline + NH4.

name: palmitoyl-(protein) hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: palmitoyl-protein + H2O = palmitate + protein.

name: procollagen-lysine 5-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl-[collagen] + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = (5R)-5-hydroxy-L-lysyl-[collagen] + succinate + CO2.

name: protein-tyrosine sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + protein tyrosine = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + protein tyrosine-O-sulfate.

name: purine nucleosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a N-D-ribosylpurine + H2O = a purine + D-ribose.

name: pyridoxal kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + pyridoxal = ADP + pyridoxal 5'-phosphate.

name: tRNA-guanosine(34) queuine transglycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine34 in tRNA + queuine = guanine + queuosine34 in tRNA.

name: sarcosine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sarcosine + H2O + electron-transfer flavoprotein = glycine + formaldehyde + reduced electron-transfer flavoprotein.

name: sphingosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a sphingoid base + ATP = a sphingoid 1-phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: sulfite oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + O2 + sulfite = H2O2 + H+ + sulfate.

name: transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an amino group to an acceptor, usually a 2-oxo acid.

name: sulfuric ester hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RSO-R' + H2O = RSOOH + R'H. This reaction is the hydrolysis of a sulfuric ester bond, an ester formed from sulfuric acid, O=SO(OH)2.

name: diphosphoinositol-polyphosphate diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: diphospho-1D-myo-inositol polyphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol polyphosphate + phosphate.

name: gamma-glutamyl carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-glutamate + reduced vitamin K + CO2 + O2 = peptidyl-gamma-carboxyglutamate + vitamin K epoxide.

name: UDP-galactose:glucosylceramide beta-1,4-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a beta-D-glucosyl-(1<->1')-N-acylsphing-4-enine + UDP-alpha-D-galactose = a beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-beta-D-Glc-(1<->1)-Cer(d18:1(4E)) + H+ + UDP.

name: arsenite secondary active transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of arsenite from one side of a membrane to the other, up its concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a chemiosmotic source of energy. Secondary active transporters include symporters and antiporters.

name: tetracycline transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of tetracycline from one side of a membrane to the other. Tetracycline is a broad spectrum antibiotic that blocks binding of aminoacyl tRNA to the ribosomes of both Gram-positive and Gram-negative organisms (and those of organelles).

name: translation activator activity
definition: Any of a group of soluble proteins functioning in the activation of ribosome-mediated translation of mRNA into a polypeptide.

name: protoheme IX farnesyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protoheme IX + (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate + H2O = heme O + diphosphate.

name: mannan endo-1,6-alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the random hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-mannosidic linkages in unbranched (1->6)-mannans.

name: N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminide beta-(1,3)-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + UDP-alpha-D-galactose = a beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + H+ + UDP.

name: melatonin receptor activity
definition: Combining with melatonin, N-acetyl-5-methoxytryptamine, to initiate a change in cell activity. Melatonin is a neuroendocrine substance that stimulates the aggregation of melanosomes in melanophores, thus lightening the skin.

name: benzodiazepine receptor activity
definition: Combining with benzodiazepines, a class of drugs with hypnotic, anxiolytic, anticonvulsive, amnestic and myorelaxant properties, to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: monoamine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of monoamines, organic compounds that contain one amino group that is connected to an aromatic ring by an ethylene group (-CH2-CH2-), from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: sucrose:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: sucrose(out) + H+(out) = sucrose(in) + H+(in).

name: sodium:iodide symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: iodide(out) + Na+(out) = iodide(in) + Na+(in).

name: bile acid:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: bile acid(out) + Na+(out) = bile acid(in) + Na+(in).

name: monoatomic anion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a negatively charged ion from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: sodium:bicarbonate symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: Na+(out) + HCO3-(out) = Na+(in) + HCO3-(in).

name: sodium:potassium:chloride symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: Na+(out) + K+(out) + Cl-(out) = Na+(in) + K+(in) + Cl-(in).

name: sulfate:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: sulfate(out) + H+(out) = sulfate(in) + H+(in).

name: sucrose transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of sucrose from one side of a membrane to the other. Sucrose is the disaccharide O-beta-D-fructofuranosyl-(2->1)-alpha-D-glucopyranoside, a sweet-tasting, non-reducing sugar isolated industrially from sugar beet or sugar cane.

name: hexose uniporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: hexose(out) = hexose(in).

name: folic acid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of folic acid (pteroylglutamic acid) from one side of a membrane to the other. Folic acid is widely distributed as a member of the vitamin B complex and is essential for the synthesis of purine and pyrimidines.

name: folate:monoatomic anion antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: Folate derivative (out) + anion (in) = folate derivative (in) + anion (out). The Reduced Folate Carrier (RCF(SLC19A1) acts by an antiport mechanism. RCF carries several folate derivatives: MTX, PMX, ratitrexed, pralatrexate, 5-methyl THF, and 5-formyl THF.

name: ammonium channel activity
definition: Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of ammonium through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel.

name: L-ascorbate:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: L-ascorbate(out) + Na+(out) = L-ascorbate(in) + Na+(in).

name: acetyl-CoA transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of acetyl-CoA from one side of a membrane to the other. Acetyl-CoA is a derivative of coenzyme A in which the sulfhydryl group is acetylated; it is a metabolite derived from several pathways (e.g. glycolysis, fatty acid oxidation, amino-acid catabolism) and is further metabolized by the tricarboxylic acid cycle. It is a key intermediate in lipid and terpenoid biosynthesis.

name: sodium-dependent multivitamin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: multivitamin(out) + Na+(out) = multivitamin(in) + Na+(in). Multivitamins include pantothenate, biotin and lipoate.

name: phosphatidylcholine intramembrane carrier activity
definition: Enables the transport of phosphatidylcholine from a region of a membrane to a different region on the same membrane.

name: phosphatidylinositol transfer activity
definition: Removes phosphatidylinositol from a membrane or a monolayer lipid particle, transports it through the aqueous phase while protected in a hydrophobic pocket, and brings it to an acceptor membrane or lipid particle.

name: taste receptor activity
definition: Combining with soluble compounds to initiate a change in cell activity. These receptors are responsible for the sense of taste.

name: G protein-coupled peptide receptor activity
definition: Combining with a peptide and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: riboflavin kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + riboflavin = ADP + FMN + 2 H+.

name: N-acetyllactosaminide beta-1,3-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine = an N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + H+ + UDP.

name: oxidized purine nucleobase lesion DNA N-glycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of oxidized purine bases by cleaving the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the oxidized purine and the deoxyribose sugar. The reaction involves the formation of a covalent enzyme-substrate intermediate. Release of the enzyme and free base by a beta-elimination or a beta, gamma-elimination mechanism results in the cleavage of the DNA backbone 3' of the apurinic (AP) site.

name: JUN kinase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the phosphorylation of tyrosine and threonine residues in a c-Jun NH2-terminal kinase (JNK), a member of a subgroup of mitogen-activated protein kinases (MAPKs), which signal in response to cytokines and exposure to environmental stress. JUN kinase kinase (JNKK) is a dual-specificity protein kinase kinase and requires activation by a serine/threonine kinase JUN kinase kinase kinase.

name: P-type cadmium transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Cd2+(in) = ADP + phosphate + Cd2+(out).

name: P-type proton-exporting transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of protons from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + H+(in) = ADP + phosphate + H+(out). These transporters use a phosphorylative mechanism, which have a phosphorylated intermediate state during the ion transport cycle.

name: P-type sodium transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Na+(in) = ADP + phosphate + Na+(out); by a phosphorylative mechanism.

name: P-type potassium transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + K+(out) = ADP + phosphate + K+(in).

name: ABC-type guanine transporter activity
definition: Catalyses the reaction: ATP + H2O + guanine(out) = ADP + phosphate + guanine(in).

name: ABC-type xenobiotic transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + xenobiotic(in) = ADP + phosphate + xenobiotic(out).

name: protein-exporting ATPase activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + protein+(in) = ADP + phosphate + protein+(out); drives the concomitant secretion of proteins.

name: mitochondrial protein-transporting ATPase activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate; drives the transport of proteins into the mitochondrion via the mitochondrial inner membrane translocase complex.

name: microtubule severing ATPase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate. Catalysis of the severing of a microtubule at a specific spot along its length, coupled to the hydrolysis of ATP.

name: minus-end-directed microtubule motor activity
definition: A motor activity that generates movement along a microtubule toward the minus end, driven by ATP hydrolysis.

name: plus-end-directed microtubule motor activity
definition: A motor activity that generates movement along a microtubule toward the plus end, driven by ATP hydrolysis.

name: JUN kinase phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: JUN kinase serine/threonine/tyrosine phosphate + H2O = JUN kinase serine/threonine/tyrosine + phosphate.

name: calcium-dependent protein serine/threonine phosphatase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates of the activity of the enzyme calcium-dependent protein serine/threonine phosphatase.

name: cAMP-dependent protein kinase regulator activity
definition: Modulation of the activity of the enzyme cAMP-dependent protein kinase.

name: phosphorylase kinase regulator activity
definition: Modulation of the activity of the enzyme phosphorylase kinase.

name: alkylglycerone-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-acyl-glycerone 3-phosphate + a long-chain alcohol = 1-alkyl-glycerone 3-phosphate + a long-chain acid anion.

name: diuretic hormone activity
definition: The action characteristic of a diuretic hormone, a peptide hormone that, upon receptor binding, regulates water balance and fluid secretion.

name: ubiquitin-like modifier activating enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the activation of small proteins, such as ubiquitin or ubiquitin-like proteins, through the formation of an ATP-dependent high-energy thiolester bond.

name: rRNA methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to a nucleoside residue in an rRNA molecule. The methyl group can be transfered to the nucleobase or to the ribose group of the nucleoside.

name: rRNA (uridine-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a uridine in rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 2'-O-methyluridine in rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

name: cysteine-type endopeptidase activator activity involved in apoptotic process
definition: Binds to and increases the rate of proteolysis catalyzed by a cysteine-type endopeptidase involved in the apoptotic process.

name: DNA topoisomerase type II (double strand cut, ATP-hydrolyzing) inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of ATP-hydrolyzing DNA topoisomerase. ATP-hydrolyzing DNA topoisomerase catalyzes the DNA topological transformation by transiently cleaving a pair of complementary DNA strands to form a gate through which a second double-stranded DNA segment is passed, after which the severed strands in the first DNA segment are rejoined; product release is coupled to ATP binding and hydrolysis; changes the linking number in multiples of 2.

name: penicillin binding
definition: Binding to penicillin, an antibiotic that contains the condensed beta-lactamthiazolidine ring system.

name: 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate + H2O = 2-oxobutanate + NH4.

name: 1-deoxy-D-xylulose-5-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + H+ + pyruvate = 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate + CO2.

name: 1-phosphofructokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-fructose 1-phosphate = ADP + D-fructose 1,6-bisphosphate.

name: 2',3'-cyclic-nucleotide 2'-phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside 2',3'-cyclic phosphate + H2O = nucleoside 3'-phosphate.

name: RNA 2',3'-cyclic 3'-phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis the reaction: a 3'-end 2',3'-cyclophospho-ribonucleotide-RNA + H2O = a 3'-end 2'-phospho-ribonucleotide-RNA + H+.

name: 2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridine-2,6-dicarboxylate N-succinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinate + H2O + succinyl-CoA = L-2-succinylamino-6-oxopimelate + CoA.

name: 2,3-dihydro-2,3-dihydroxybenzoate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2S,3S)-2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydrobenzoate + NAD+ = 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate + H+ + NADH.

name: 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate--[aryl-carrier protein] ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate + ATP + holo-[ACP] = 2,3-dihydroxybenzoyl-[ACP] + AMP + diphosphate.

name: 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: a 4,5-saturated-(2E)-enoyl-CoA + NADP+ = a (2E,4E)-dienoyl-CoA + H+ + NADPH, and a (2E,4Z)-dienoyl-CoA + H+ + NADPH = a 4,5-saturated-(2E)-enoyl-CoA + NADP+.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxygalactonokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-galactonate + ATP = 6-phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-galactonate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxyglucarate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-glucarate = pyruvate + tartronate semialdehyde.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxygluconokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + ATP = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phospho-D-gluconate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phosphogalactonate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-galactonate = D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + pyruvate.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-phosphogluconate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate 6-phosphate = pyruvate + D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate.

name: 3-deoxy-8-phosphooctulonate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-arabinose 5-phosphate + H2O + phosphoenolpyruvate = 8-phospho-3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonate + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: 2-dehydropantoate 2-reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-pantoate + NADP+ = 2-dehydropantoate + H+ + NADPH.

name: 2-deoxy-D-gluconate 3-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-deoxy-D-gluconate + NAD+ = 3-dehydro-2-deoxy-D-gluconate + NADH + H+.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-oxopropionate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-glycerate + NADP+ = 2-hydroxy-3-oxopropanoate + NADPH + H+.

name: 2-octaprenyl-6-methoxyphenol hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-methoxy-6-(all-trans-octaprenyl)phenol + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 2-methoxy-6-all-trans-octaprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol + H2O + NADP+.

name: 3-demethoxyubiquinol 3-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 6-methoxy-3-methyl-2-all-trans-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol + donor-H2 + O2 = acceptor + a 3-demethylubiquinol + H2O.

name: 2-oxoglutarate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + H+ = CO2 + succinate semialdehyde.

name: 2-oxopent-4-enoate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxy-2-oxopentanoate = 2-oxopent-4-enoate + H2O.

name: 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclodiphosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2-phosphate = 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclic diphosphate + CMP.

name: 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone-4-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribulose 5-phosphate = (2S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutyl phosphate + formate + H+.

name: 3,4-dihydroxyphenylacetate 2,3-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,4-dihydroxyphenylacetate + O2 = 5-formyl-2-hydroxyhepta-2,4-dienedioate + H+.

name: 3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)propionate hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)propionate + NADH + oxygen + H+ = 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propionate + NAD+ + H2O.

name: 3-deoxy-manno-octulosonate cytidylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonate = diphosphate + CMP-3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonate.

name: 3-hydroxybutyryl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA + NADP+ = 3-acetoacetyl-CoA + NADPH + H+.

name: 3-hydroxybutyryl-CoA epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA = (R)-3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-polyprenylbenzoate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 4-hydroxy-3-(all-trans-polyprenyl)benzoate + H+ = a 2-(all-trans-polyprenyl)phenol + CO2.

name: 3-phenylpropionate dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phenylpropanoate + NADH + O2 + H+ = 3-(cis-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dien-1-yl)propanoate + NAD+.

name: 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate = 4-aminobenzoate + H+ + pyruvate.

name: 4-deoxy-L-threo-5-hexosulose-uronate ketol-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucuronate = 3-deoxy-D-glycero-2,5-hexodiulosonate.

name: (R,S)-4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate = pyruvate + glyoxylate. Can act on both the (4R) and the (4S) enantiomers of 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate.

name: 4-hydroxy-2-oxovalerate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxy-2-oxopentanoate = acetaldehyde + pyruvate.

name: 5-amino-6-(5-phosphoribosylamino)uracil reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-amino-6-(5-phosphoribitylamino)uracil + NADP+ = 5-amino-6-(5-phosphoribosylamino)uracil + H+ + NADPH.

name: 5-carboxymethyl-2-hydroxymuconate delta-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-carboxymethyl-2-hydroxymuconate = 5-carboxy-2-oxohept-3-enedioate.

name: methionine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (6S)-5-methyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + L-homocysteine = (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + L-methionine.

name: 6-phospho-beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-phospho-beta-D-glucoside-(1,4)-D-glucose + H2O = D-glucose 6-phosphate + glucose.

name: inositol hexakisphosphate 4-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: myo-inositol hexakisphosphate + H2O = 1-myo-inositol 1,2,3,4,5-pentakisphosphate + phosphate.

name: cholate 7-alpha-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholate + NAD+ = -3alpha,12-alpha-dihydroxy-7-oxo--5beta-cholanate + H+ + NADH.

name: 8-amino-7-oxononanoate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-alanine + H+ + pimelyl-CoA = 8-amino-7-oxononanoate + CO2 + CoA.

name: ADP-glyceromanno-heptose 6-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ADP-D-glycero-D-manno-heptose = ADP-L-glycero-D-manno-heptose.

name: ADP-heptose-lipopolysaccharide heptosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: heptosyl-KDO2-lipid A + ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose = heptosyl2-KDO2-lipid A + ADP + H+.

name: AMP nucleosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AMP + H2O = D-ribose 5-phosphate + adenine.

name: CDP-diacylglycerol diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CDP-diacylglycerol + H2O = a phosphatidate + CMP + 2 H+.

name: D-alanine-D-alanine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 D-alanine + ATP = D-alanyl-D-alanine + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: D-amino-acid dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a D-alpha-amino acid + a quinone + H2O = a 2-oxocarboxylate + a quinol + NH4+.

name: dihydroneopterin triphosphate 2'-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7,8-dihydroneopterin 3'-triphosphate = 7,8-dihydromonapterin 3'-triphosphate.

name: D-lactate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactate + NAD+ = H+ + NADH + pyruvate.

name: D-serine ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-serine = pyruvate + NH4+.

name: DNA-3-methyladenine glycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: DNA containing 3-methyladenine + H2O = DNA with abasic site + 3-methyladenine. This reaction is the hydrolysis of DNA by cleavage of the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the damaged DNA 3-methyladenine and the deoxyribose sugar to remove the 3-methyladenine, leaving an abasic site.

name: alkanesulfonate monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alkanesulfonate + O2 + FMNH2 = an aldehyde + sulfite + H2O + FMN.

name: GDP-mannose mannosyl hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-alpha-D-mannose + H2O = GDP + D-mannose + H+.

name: GTP diphosphokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + GTP = AMP + guanosine 3'-diphosphate 5'-triphosphate.

name: L(+)-tartrate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tartrate = H2O + oxaloacetate.

name: L-allo-threonine aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-allo-threonine = glycine + acetaldehyde.

name: L-arabinose isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arabinose = L-ribulose.

name: L-aspartate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate + O2 = iminosuccinate + H2O2. Can also use fumatate as electron acceptor under anaerobic conditions, yielding succinate.

name: L-carnitine CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: (E)-4-(trimethylammonio)but-2-enoyl-CoA + L-carnitine = (E)-4-(trimethylammonio)but-2-enoate + L-carnitinyl-CoA and 4-trimethylammoniobutanoyl-CoA + L-carnitine = 4-trimethylammoniobutanoate + L-carnitinyl-CoA.

name: L-fucose isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-fucose = L-fuculose.

name: L-fuculokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-fuculose + ATP = L-fuculose 1-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: L-fuculose-phosphate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-fuculose 1-phosphate = (S)-lactaldehyde + glycerone phosphate.

name: L-rhamnose isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-rhamnose = L-rhamnulose.

name: ribulokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L(or D)-ribulose = ADP + L(or D)-ribulose 5-phosphate.

name: L-ribulose-phosphate 4-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ribulose 5-phosphate = D-xylulose 5-phosphate.

name: L-threonine 3-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-threonine + NAD+ = (2S)-2-amino-3-oxobutanoate + NADH + H+.

name: L-xylulokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-xylulose = ADP + L-xylulose 5-phosphate.

name: N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanine amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the link between N-acetylmuramoyl residues and L-amino acid residues in certain bacterial cell-wall glycopeptides.

name: N-acetylneuraminate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetylneuraminate = N-acetyl-D-mannosamine + pyruvate.

name: N-ethylmaleimide reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-ethylmaleimide + NADPH + 2 H+ = N-ethylsuccinimide + NADP+.

name: proton-translocating NAD(P)+ transhydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+(in) + NAD+ + NADPH = H+(out) + NADH + NADP+.

name: FMN reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: FMNH2 + NAD(P)+ = FMN + NAD(P)H + H+. This reaction can utilize NADH and NADPH with similar reaction rates.

name: NADPH dehydrogenase (quinone) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADPH + H+ + a quinone = NADP+ + a quinol.

name: O-antigen ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a lipid-linked O antigen + a lipid A-core oligosaccharide = a lipopolysaccharide + a polyisoprenyl diphosphate.

name: O antigen polymerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the polymerization of o-antigen chains. O-antigens are tetra- and pentasaccharide repeat units of the cell walls of Gram-negative bacteria and are a component of lipopolysaccharide.

name: o-succinylbenzoate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-succinylbenzoate + ATP + CoA = 2-succinylbenzoyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate.

name: S-adenosylmethionine-dependent methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to a substrate.

name: UDP-2,3-diacylglucosamine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + UDP-2,3-bis(3-hydroxymyristoyl)glucosamine = 2,3-bis(3-hydroxymyristoyl)-beta-D-glucosaminyl 1-phosphate + UMP.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine 1-carboxyvinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphoenolpyruvate + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine = phosphate + UDP-N-acetyl-3-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-D-glucosamine.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine 2-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine = UDP-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine.

name: UDP-N-acetylmuramate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramate + NADP+ = UDP-N-acetyl-3-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-alpha-D-glucosamine + NADPH + H+.

name: UDP-N-acetylmuramate-L-alanine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-alanine + ATP + UDP-N-acetylmuramate = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanine.

name: UDP-N-acetylmuramoylalanine-D-glutamate ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glutamate + ATP + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanine = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate.

name: UDP-N-acetylmuramoylalanyl-D-glutamate-2,6-diaminopimelate ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-gamma-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminoheptanedioate.

name: UDP-N-acetylmuramoylalanyl-D-glutamyl-2,6-diaminopimelate-D-alanyl-D-alanine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminoheptanedioate + D-alanyl-D-alanine = ADP + phosphate + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-6-carboxy-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine.

name: UDP-galactopyranose mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-D-galactopyranose = UDP-D-galacto-1,4-furanose.

name: UDP-sugar diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-sugar + H2O = UMP + sugar 1-phosphate.

name: [acyl-carrier-protein] phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [acyl-carrier protein] + H2O = 4'-phosphopantetheine + apoprotein.

name: [citrate (pro-3S)-lyase] ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + acetate + (citrate (pro-3S)-lyase) (thiol form) = AMP + diphosphate + (citrate (pro-3S)-lyase) (acetyl form).

name: [isocitrate dehydrogenase (NADP+)] kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-seryl-[isocitrate dehydrogenase] = ADP + H+ + O-phospho-L-seryl-[isocitrate dehydrogenase].

name: [protein-PII] uridylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UTP + (protein-PII) = diphosphate + uridylyl-(protein-PII).

name: acetaldehyde dehydrogenase (acetylating, NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetaldehyde + CoA + NAD+ = acetyl-CoA + NADH + H+.

name: acetate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an acyl-CoA + acetate = a carboxylate + acetyl-CoA.

name: acetate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + acetate = ADP + acetyl phosphate.

name: acetylornithine deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N2-acetyl-L-ornithine + H2O = acetate + L-ornithine.

name: acyl-[acyl-carrier-protein]-phospholipid O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + O-(2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho)ethanolamine = [acyl-carrier protein] + O-(1-beta-acyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho)ethanolamine.

name: acyl-[acyl-carrier-protein]-UDP-N-acetylglucosamine O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a (3R)-hydroxyacyl-[ACP] + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine = a UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + holo-[ACP].

name: N-acylneuraminate cytidylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + N-acylneuraminate = diphosphate + CMP-N-acylneuraminate.

name: adenosylhomocysteine nucleosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H2O = adenine + S-D-ribosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: agmatinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: agmatine + H2O = putrescine + urea.

name: alanine racemase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-alanine = D-alanine.

name: D-allose 6-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-allose-6-phosphate = D-allulose-6-phosphate.

name: D-allose kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-allose = ADP + D-allose 6-phosphate.

name: alpha,alpha-phosphotrehalase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha,alpha-trehalose 6-phosphate + H2O = D-glucose + D-glucose 6-phosphate.

name: altronate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-altronate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + H2O.

name: arabinose isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-arabinose = D-ribulose.

name: L-arginine N-succinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: succinyl-CoA + L-arginine = N2-succinyl-L-arginine + CoA + H+.

name: arginine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + H+ = agmatine + CO2.

name: aromatic-amino-acid:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an L-alpha aromatic amino acid + 2-oxoglutarate = an aromatic oxo acid + L-glutamate.

name: arsenate reductase (glutaredoxin) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: arsenate + reduced glutaredoxin = arsenite + oxidized glutaredoxin. Glutaredoxin functions as the electron donor for arsenate reduction. The electron flow therefore is ( NADPH -> glutathione reductase (EC:1.6.4.2) -> ) glutathione -> glutaredoxin -> arsenate reductase, i.e. glutathione is reduced by glutathione reductase and glutaredoxin is reduced by glutathione.

name: NAD+ synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: deamido-NAD+ + NH4+ + ATP = AMP + diphosphate + NAD+ + H+.

name: bis(5'-nucleosyl)-tetraphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of P(1),P(4)-bis(5'-nucleosyl)tetraphosphate into two nucleotides.

name: aspartate ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate = fumarate + NH4+.

name: beta-aspartyl-peptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of a beta-linked aspartic residue from the N-terminus of a polypeptide.

name: beta-lactamase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a beta-lactam + H2O = a substituted beta-amino acid.

name: beta-phosphoglucomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-D-glucose 1-phosphate = beta-D-glucose 6-phosphate.

name: betaine-aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: betaine aldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = betaine + NADH + H+.

name: bis(5'-nucleosyl)-tetraphosphatase (symmetrical) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: P(1),P(4)-bis(5'-adenosyl) tetraphosphate + H2O = 2 ADP + 2 H+.

name: carbamate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydrogencarbonate + NH4+ + ATP = carbamoyl phosphate + ADP + H2O + H+.

name: aerobic carbon monoxide dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CO + a quinone + H2O = a quinol + CO2.

name: carboxymethylenebutenolidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-carboxymethylenebut-2-en-4-olide + H2O = 4 oxohex-2-enedioate.

name: carboxyvinyl-carboxyphosphonate phosphorylmutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-carboxyvinyl carboxyphosphonate = 3-(hydrohydroxyphosphoryl)pyruvate + CO2.

name: cardiolipin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylglycerol + phosphatidylglycerol = diphosphatidylglycerol (cardiolipin) + glycerol.

name: carnitine racemase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-carnitine = L-carnitine.

name: cellulase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-glucosidic linkages in cellulose, lichenin and cereal beta-D-glucans.

name: chloramphenicol O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chloramphenicol + acetyl-CoA = chloramphenicol 3-acetate + CoA.

name: choline dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A + choline = AH(2) + betaine aldehyde.

name: chorismate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chorismate = 4-hydroxybenzoate + pyruvate.

name: citrate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + citrate = acetate + (3S)-citryl-CoA.

name: citrate (pro-3S)-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: citrate = acetate + oxaloacetate.

name: citryl-CoA lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3S)-citryl-CoA = acetyl-CoA + oxaloacetate.

name: corrinoid adenosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 ATP + 2 corrinoid + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = 2 adenosylcorrinoid + 3 H+ + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] + 2 triphosphate. The corrinoid can be cob(II)yrinate a,c diamide, cob(II)inamide or cob(II)alamin.

name: cobalamin 5'-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosylcobinamide-GDP + alpha-ribazole-5'-phosphate = adenosylcobalamin-5'-phosphate + GMP.

name: cobinamide phosphate guanylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosylcobinamide phosphate + GTP + 2 H+ = adenosylcobinamide-GDP + diphosphate.

name: crossover junction DNA endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage at a junction such as a reciprocal single-stranded crossover between two homologous DNA duplexes (Holliday junction).

name: cupric reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 Cu2+ + NADH = 2 Cu+ + H+ + NAD+.

name: cyanate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyanate + hydrogencarbonate + 3 H+ = NH4+ + 2 CO2.

name: cyclopropane-fatty-acyl-phospholipid synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + phospholipid olefinic fatty acid = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + phospholipid cyclopropane fatty acid.

name: cysteine sulfinate desulfinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-sulfinoalanine = L-alanine + sulfite.

name: dATP diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dATP + H2O = dAMP + H+ + diphosphate.

name: dCTP deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dCTP + H2O + H+ = dUTP + NH4+.

name: dTDP-4-dehydrorhamnose 3,5-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-alpha-D-glucose = dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-L-mannose.

name: dTDP-4-dehydrorhamnose reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTDP-6-deoxy-L-mannose + NADP+ = dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-L-mannose + H+ + NADPH.

name: dGTPase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dGTP + H2O = 2'-deoxyguanosine + 2 H+ + triphosphate.

name: deoxyribonuclease IV (phage-T4-induced) activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage to 5'-phosphooligonucleotide end-products.

name: ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl-diphosphate synthase [(2E,6E)-farnesyl-diphosphate specific] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate + 8 isopentenyl diphosphate = di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + 8 diphosphate.

name: diaminohydroxyphosphoribosylaminopyrimidine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy-4-(5-phosphoribosylamino)-pyrimidine + H2O + H+ = 5-amino-6-(5-phosphoribosylamino)uracil + NH4.

name: diaminopimelate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + H+ = L-lysine + CO2.

name: diaminopimelate epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: LL-2,6-diaminopimelate = meso-2,6-diaminopimelate.

name: diaminopropionate ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-diaminopropanoate + H2O + H+ = pyruvate + 2 NH4+.

name: 4-hydroxy-tetrahydrodipicolinate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridine-2,6-dicarboxylate + NAD(P)+ + H2O = (2S,4S)-4-hydroxy-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: 4-hydroxy-tetrahydrodipicolinate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + pyruvate = (2S,4S)-4-hydroxy-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinate + H2O + H+.

name: dihydrofolate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + dihydropterate + L-glutamate = ADP + phosphate + dihydrofolate.

name: endochitinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of nonterminal (1->4)-beta linkages of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine (GlcNAc) polymers of chitin and chitodextrins. Typically, endochitinases cleave randomly within the chitin chain.

name: Enterobacter ribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage to 3'-phosphomononucleotides and 3'-phosphooligonucleotides with 2',3'-cyclic phosphate intermediates.

name: enterochelin esterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: enterobactin + 3 H2O = 3 N-23-dihydroxybenzoyl-L-serine + 3 H+.

name: ethanolamine ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ethanolamine = acetaldehyde + NH4+.

name: exodeoxyribonuclease V activity
definition: Catalysis of the exonucleolytic cleavage (in the presence of ATP) in either 5' to 3' or 3' to 5' direction to yield 5'-phosphooligonucleotides.

name: exodeoxyribonuclease VII activity
definition: Catalysis of the exonucleolytic cleavage in either 5' to 3' or 3' to 5' direction to yield 5'-phosphomononucleotides.

name: exoribonuclease II activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RNA + H2O = 5'-phosphomononucleotides. Cleaves RNA in the 3' to 5' direction.

name: ferredoxin-NAD+ reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + NAD+ + H+ = 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + NADH.

name: formate C-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + formate = CoA + pyruvate.

name: formate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: formate + NAD+ = CO2 + NADH.

name: formyltetrahydrofolate deformylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10-formyltetrahydrofolate + H2O = (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + formate + H+.

name: fructokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-fructose = ADP + D-fructose 6-phosphate.

name: fructuronate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannonate + NAD+ = D-fructuronate + H+ + NADH.

name: galactarate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: galactarate = 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucarate + H2O.

name: galactitol-1-phosphate 5-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: galactitol-1-phosphate + NAD+ = D-tagatose 6-phosphate + NADH + H+.

name: galactonate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galactonate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-galactonate + H2O.

name: galactoside O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + a beta-D-galactoside = CoA + a 6-acetyl-beta-D-galactoside.

name: aminoglycoside 2''-nucleotidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + aminoglycoside = diphosphate + 2''-nucleotidylaminoglycoside.

name: glucarate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucarate = 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucarate + H2O.

name: gluconate 2-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-gluconate + NADP+ = 2-dehydro-D-gluconate + NADPH + H+.

name: gluconate 5-dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-gluconate + NAD(P)+ = 5-dehydro-D-gluconate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: quinoprotein glucose dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose + ubiquinone = D-glucono-1,5-lactone + ubiquinol.

name: glucose-1-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + H2O = D-glucose + phosphate.

name: glucose-1-phosphate adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + ATP = ADP-glucose + diphosphate.

name: glucose-1-phosphate thymidylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + dTTP = diphosphate + dTDP-glucose.

name: glucuronate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucuronate = D-fructuronate. Also converts D-galacturonate to D-tagaturonate.

name: glutamate racemase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate = D-glutamate.

name: [glutamate-ammonia-ligase] adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + [L-glutamate:ammonia ligase (ADP-forming)] = diphosphate + adenylyl-[L-glutamate:ammonia ligase (ADP-forming)].

name: glutamyl-tRNA reductase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-4-amino-5-oxopentanoate + NADP+ + tRNA(Glu) = L-glutamyl-tRNA(Glu) + H+ + NADPH.

name: glutathionylspermidine amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N1-(gamma-L-glutamyl-L-cysteinyl-glycyl)-spermidine + H2O = gamma-L-glutamyl-L-cysteinyl-glycine + spermidine.

name: glutathionylspermidine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: gamma-L-glutamyl-L-cysteinyl-glycine + spermidine + ATP = N1-(gamma-L-glutamyl-L-cysteinyl-glycyl)-spermidine + ADP + phosphate.

name: glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (NADP+) (non-phosphorylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + H2O + NADP+ = 3-phospho-D-glycerate + 2 H+ + NADPH.

name: glycerate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glycerate + ATP = 3-phospho-D-glycerate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: glycerol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycerol + NAD+ = glycerone + H+ + NADH.

name: glycerophosphodiester phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a glycerophosphodiester + H2O = an alcohol + sn-glycerol 3-phosphate.

name: glycine C-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + glycine = L-2-amino-3-oxobutanoate + CoA.

name: guanine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanine + H2O + H+ = xanthine + NH4+.

name: guanosine-3',5'-bis(diphosphate) 3'-diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine 3',5'-bis(diphosphate) + H2O = diphosphate + GDP + H+.

name: guanosine-5'-triphosphate,3'-diphosphate diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine 5'-triphosphate,3'-diphosphate + H2O = guanosine 5'-diphosphate,3'-diphosphate + phosphate.

name: holo-[acyl-carrier-protein] synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CoA + substrate-serine = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + substrate-serine-4'-phosphopantetheine. The transfer of the 4'-phosphopantetheine (Ppant) co-factor from coenzyme A to the hydroxyl side chain of the serine residue of acyl- or peptidyl-carrier protein (ACP or PCP) to convert them from the apo to the holo form.

name: S-adenosylmethionine-homocysteine S-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + L-homocysteine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + L-methionine.

name: homoserine O-succinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-homoserine + succinyl-CoA = O-succinyl-L-homoserine + CoA.

name: P-type potassium:proton transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + H+(in) + K+(out) = ADP + phosphate + H+(out) + K+(in).

name: ferredoxin hydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 reduced ferredoxin + 2 H+ = 2 oxidized ferredoxin + H2.

name: hydroxymethylpyrimidine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-amino-5-hydroxymethyl-2-methylpyrimidine + ATP = 4-amino-2-methyl-5-phosphomethylpyrimidine + ADP + 2 H+.

name: hydroxypyruvate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxypyruvate = 2-hydroxy-3-oxopropanoate.

name: hygromycin-B 7''-O-phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + hygromycin B = 7''-O-phosphohygromycin B + ADP + 2 H+.

name: inosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + inosine = ADP + IMP.

name: integrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the integration of one DNA segment into another.

name: isochorismatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + isochorismate = 2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydrobenzoate + pyruvate.

name: isochorismate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chorismate = isochorismate.

name: kanamycin kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + kanamycin = ADP + 2 H+ + kanamycin 3'-phosphate.

name: lactaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactaldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = (S)-lactate + NADH + H+.

name: lactaldehyde reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: propane-1,2-diol + NAD+ = lactaldehyde + NADH + H+.

name: Kdo2-lipid IVA acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a fatty acyl-[ACP] + an alpha-Kdo-(2->4)-alpha-Kdo-(2->6)-lipid IVA = an alpha-Kdo-(2->4)-alpha-Kdo-(2->6)-(acyl)-lipid IVA + holo-[ACP].

name: leucyl-tRNA--protein transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-leucyl-tRNA(Leu) + N-terminal L-arginyl-[protein] = H+ + N-terminal L-leucyl-L-arginyl-[protein] + tRNA(Leu). Can also transfer the leucyl residue on an N-terminal L-lysyl residue.

name: lipid-A-disaccharide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a lipid X + a UDP-2-N,3-O-bis[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-alpha-D-glucosamine = a lipid A disaccharide + UDP + H+.

name: lipopolysaccharide N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + lipopolysaccharide = UDP + N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-lipopolysaccharide.

name: lipopolysaccharide 3-alpha-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + lipopolysaccharide = UDP + 1,3 alpha-D-galactosyl-lipopolysaccharide.

name: lipopolysaccharide glucosyltransferase I activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + lipopolysaccharide = UDP + D-glucosyl-lipopolysaccharide.

name: lipopolysaccharide heptosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a lipopolysaccharide + ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose = a heptosylated lipopolysaccharide + ADP + H+.

name: lipopolysaccharide-1,6-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + lipopolysaccharide = UDP + 1,6 alpha-D-galactosyl-lipopolysaccharide.

name: long-chain fatty acid [acyl-carrier-protein] ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain fatty acid + ATP + holo-[ACP] = a long-chain fatty acyl-[ACP] + AMP + diphosphate. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.

name: lysine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysine + H+ = cadaverine + CO2.

name: L-malate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate + a quinone = oxaloacetate + a quinol. Vitamin K (menaquinone) and several other quinones can act as acceptors.

name: maltose O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + maltose = CoA + acetyl-maltose.

name: mannitol-1-phosphate 5-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannitol 1-phosphate + NAD+ = D-fructose 6-phosphate + NADH + H+.

name: mannonate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannonate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + H2O.

name: mannose-1-phosphate guanylyltransferase (GDP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-mannose 1-phosphate + GDP + H+ = GDP-alpha-D-mannose + phosphate.

name: methylglyoxal synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycerone phosphate = methylglyoxal + phosphate.

name: methylthioadenosine nucleosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methylthioadenosine + H2O = adenine + 5-methylthio-D-ribose.

name: lytic endotransglycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endolytic cleavage of the (1->4)-beta-glycosidic linkage between N-acetylmuramic acid (MurNAc) and N-acetylglucosamine (GlcNAc) residues in peptidoglycan with concomitant formation of a 1,6-anhydrobond in the MurNAc residue.

name: peptidoglycan lytic transglycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of a peptidoglycan chain into a peptidoglycan chain with N-acetyl-1,6-anhydromuramyl-[peptide] at the reducing end + a peptidoglycan chain with N-acetylglucosamine at the non-reducing end. Includes endolytic transglycosylase activity that fragments the glycan chain internally and exolytic transgylcosylase activity that cleaves a terminal disaccharide from the end of the glycan strand.

name: inositol monophosphate 1-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 1-phosphate + H2O = myo-inositol + phosphate.

name: 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoyl-CoA synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-succinylbenzoyl-CoA + H+ = 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoyl-CoA + H2O.

name: nicotinamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinamide + H2O = nicotinate + NH4+.

name: ferredoxin-[NAD(P)H] reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: reduced ferredoxin + NAD(P)+ = oxidized ferredoxin + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: nicotinate N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + nicotinate = N-methylnicotinate + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: nicotinate-nucleotide-dimethylbenzimidazole phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole + nicotinate D-ribonucleotide = alpha-ribazole 5'-phosphate + H+ + nicotinate.

name: nitrate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nitrite + acceptor = nitrate + reduced acceptor.

name: nitric oxide dioxygenase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 NO + 2 O2 + NAD(P)H + H+ = 2 nitrate + NAD(P)+.

name: nitrite reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NH4+ + 3 NAD(P)+ + 2 H2O = nitrite + 3 NAD(P)H + 5 H+.

name: oxaloacetate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + oxaloacetate = CO2 + pyruvate.

name: oxalyl-CoA decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + oxalyl-CoA = CO2 + formyl-CoA.

name: palmitoleoyl [acyl-carrier-protein]-dependent acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a palmitoleoyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + alpha-KDO-(2->4)-alpha-KDO-(2->6)-lipid IVA = KDO2-(palmitoleoyl)-lipid IVA + a holo-[acyl-carrier protein].

name: penicillin amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: penicillin + H2O = a carboxylate + 6-aminopenicillanate.

name: peptidoglycan glycosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [GlcNAc-(1->4)-Mur2Ac(oyl-L-Ala-gamma-D-Glu-L-Lys-D-Ala-D-Ala)](n)-di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-Mur2Ac(oyl-L-Ala-gamma-D-Glu-L-Lys-D-Ala-D-Ala)-di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate = [GlcNAc-(1->4)-Mur2Ac(oyl-L-Ala-gamma-D-Glu-L-Lys-D-Ala-D-Ala)](n+1)-di-trans-octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + H+.

name: phenylacetaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-phenylacetaldehyde + H2O + NAD+ = 2-phenylacetate + 2 H+ + NADH.

name: phosphate acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + phosphate = CoA + acetyl phosphate.

name: phosphatidylglycerol-membrane-oligosaccharide glycerophosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylglycerol + membrane-derived-oligosaccharide D-glucose = 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + membrane-derived-oligosaccharide 6-(glycerophospho)-D-glucose.

name: phosphatidylglycerol-prolipoprotein diacylglyceryl transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of the diacylglyceryl group from phosphatidylglycerol to the sulfhydryl group of the prospective N-terminal cysteine residue in an unmodified prolipoprotein.

name: phosphatidylglycerophosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylglycerophosphate + H2O = phosphatidylglycerol + phosphate.

name: phospho-N-acetylmuramoyl-pentapeptide-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl phosphate + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine = Mur2Ac(oyl-L-Ala-gamma-D-Glu-L-Lys-D-Ala-D-Ala)-di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + UMP.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphate + oxaloacetate = phosphoenolpyruvate + HCO3-.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate-protein phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphoenolpyruvate + protein L-histidine = pyruvate + protein N(pi)-phospho-L-histidine.

name: phosphoglucosamine mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate = D-glucosamine 6-phosphate.

name: phosphoglycolate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-phosphoglycolate + H2O = glycolate + phosphate.

name: D-sedoheptulose 7-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-sedoheptulose-7-phosphate = D-alpha,beta-D-heptose 7-phosphate.

name: glycerophospholipid phospholipase A1 activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospholipid + H2O = a 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospholipid + a fatty acid + H+. Note that the substrate has a diacyl group attached to the glycerol group.

name: phosphomethylpyrimidine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + 4-amino-2-methyl-5-phosphomethylpyrimidine = ADP + 4-amino-2-methyl-5-diphosphomethylpyrimidine.

name: phosphopentomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 1-phosphate = D-ribose 5-phosphate. Also converts 2-deoxy-alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate into 2-deoxy-D-ribose 5-phosphate.

name: phosphoribulokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribulose 5-phosphate + ATP = D-ribulose 1,5-bisphosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: polyphosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + phosphate(n) = ADP + phosphate(n+1).

name: prephenate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + prephenate = (4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate + CO2 + NADH.

name: prophage integrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the integration of prophage DNA into a target DNA molecule, usually a bacterial chromosome, via a sequence-specific recombination event which involves the formation of an intasome, a DNA-protein-complex designed for site-specific recombination of the phage and host DNA.

name: propionate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + propanoate = ADP + propanoyl phosphate.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-carbohydrate phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + sugar(out) = protein histidine + sugar phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-glutamate O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + protein L-glutamate = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + protein L-glutamate 5-methyl ester; this reaction is the methylation of peptidyl-L-glutamate to form peptidyl-L-glutamate 5-methyl ester.

name: protein-glutamate methylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein L-glutamate O(5)-methyl ester + H2O = protein L-glutamate + methanol.

name: pyruvate, water dikinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + pyruvate = AMP + 2 H+ + phosphate + phosphoenolpyruvate.

name: quinolinate synthetase A activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: iminoaspartate + dihydroxy-acetone-phosphate = quinolinate + 2 H2O + phosphate.

name: rRNA (adenine-N6-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine in rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(6)-methyladenosine in rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: rRNA (guanine-N1-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + rRNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + rRNA containing N1-methylguanine.

name: rRNA (guanine-N2-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + rRNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + rRNA containing N2-methylguanine.

name: rhamnulokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-rhamnulose = ADP + L-rhamnulose 1-phosphate.

name: rhamnulose-1-phosphate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-rhamnulose 1-phosphate = glycerone phosphate + (S)-lactaldehyde.

name: ribonuclease E activity
