definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phthalate + NADH + O2 + H+ = cis-4,5-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,6-diene-1,2-dicarboxylate + NAD+.

name: 4-sulfobenzoate 3,4-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-sulfobenzoate + H+ + NADH + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + NAD+ + sulfite.

name: 4-chlorophenylacetate 3,4-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-chlorophenylacetate + NADH + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxyphenylacetate + chloride + NAD+.

name: benzoate 1,2-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzoate + NADH + O2 + H+ = (1R,6S)-1,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylate + NAD+.

name: toluene dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: toluene + NADH + O2 + H+ = (1S,2R)-3-methylcyclohexa-3,5-diene-1,2-diol + NAD+.

name: naphthalene 1,2-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: naphthalene + NADH + H+ + O2 = (1R,2S)-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol + NAD+.

name: 2-halobenzoate 1,2-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-halobenzoate + NADH + O2 + H+ = a halide anion + catechol + CO2 + NAD+.

name: 2-aminobenzenesulfonate 2,3-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-aminobenzenesulfonate + 2 H+ + NADH + O2 = 2,3-dihydroxybenzenesulfonate + NAD+ + NH4. 2,3-dihydroxybenzenesulfonate is also known as 3-sulfocatechol.

name: terephthalate 1,2-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: terephthalate + NADH + O2 + H+ = (3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,5-diene-1,4-dicarboxylate + NAD+.

name: 2-hydroxyquinoline 5,6-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: quinolin-2-ol + NADH + O2 + H+ = 5,6-dihydroquinoline-2,5,6-triol + NAD+.

name: phenylacetate 2-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-phenylacetate + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = (2-hydroxyphenyl)acetate + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: 4-nitrophenol 4-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: p-nitrophenol + O2 + NADPH = H2O + NADP+ + nitrite + p-benzoquinone.

name: dimethyl sulfide monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dimethyl sulfide + H+ + NADH + O2 = formaldehyde + H2O + methanethiol + NAD+.

name: alpha-pinene monooxygenase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-pinene + NADH + H+ + O2 = NAD+ + H2O + alpha-pinene oxide.

name: 1-hydroxy-2-naphthoate hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-hydroxy-2-naphthoate + O2 + NAD(P)H + 2 H+ = NAD(P)+ + H2O + CO2 + 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene.

name: toluene 4-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: toluene + H+ + NADH + O2 = 4-methylphenol + H2O + NAD+.

name: dibenzothiophene monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dibenzothiophene + 2 FMNH2 + 2 O2 = dibenzothiophene 5,5-dioxide + 2 FMN + 2 H2O + 2 H+.

name: toluene 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: toluene + H+ + NADH + O2 = 2-hydroxytoluene + H2O + NAD+.

name: alkene monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: propene + NADH + H+ + O2 = 1,2-epoxypropane + NAD+ + H2O.

name: methanesulfonate monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methanesulfonate + NADH + H+ + O2 = formaldehyde + NAD+ + sulfite + H2O.

name: toluene-sulfonate methyl-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: toluene-4-sulfonate + NADH + O2 = NAD+ + OH- + 4-sulfobenzyl alcohol.

name: salicylate 1-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: salicylate + NADH + H+ + O2 = catechol + NAD+ + H2O + CO2.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoate 3-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = protocatechuate + NADP+ + H2O.

name: orcinol 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADH + O2 + orcinol = 2,3,5-trihydroxytoluene + H2O + NAD+.

name: phenol 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenol + NADPH + H+ + O2 = catechol + NADP+ + H2O.

name: 2,6-dihydroxypyridine 3-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,6-dihydroxypyridine + H+ + NADH + O2 = 2,3,6-trihydroxypyridine + H2O + NAD+.

name: benzoate 4-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzoate + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 4-hydroxybenzoate + H2O + NADP+.

name: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate 1-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = homogentisate + NADP+ + H2O.

name: 2,4-dichlorophenol 6-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4-dichlorophenol + NADPH + H+ + O2 = 3,5-dichlorocatechol + NADP+ + H2O.

name: cyclohexanone monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexanone + NADPH + H+ + O2 = 6-hexanolide + NADP+ + H2O.

name: 3-hydroxybenzoate 4-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxybenzoate + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + H2O + NADP+.

name: 3-hydroxybenzoate 6-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxybenzoate + H+ + NADH + O2 = 2,5-dihydroxybenzoate + H2O + NAD+.

name: 4-aminobenzoate 1-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-aminobenzoate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = 4-hydroxyaniline + NADP+ + H2O + CO2.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoate 3-monooxygenase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + NAD(P)H + H+ + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + NAD(P)+ + H2O.

name: anthranilate 3-monooxygenase (deaminating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: anthranilate + 2 H+ + NADPH + O2 = 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate + NADP+ + NH4.

name: anthraniloyl-CoA monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-aminobenzoyl-CoA + 2 NADPH + 2 H+ + O2 = 2-amino-5-oxocyclohex-1-enecarboxyl-CoA + H2O + 2 NADP+.

name: (S)-limonene 3-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (4S)-limonene + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = (1S,6R)-isopiperitenol + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: (S)-limonene 6-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (4S)-limonene + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = (1S,5R)-carveol + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: (S)-limonene 7-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (4S)-limonene + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = (4S)-perillyl alcohol + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: pentachlorophenol monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pentachlorophenol + NADPH + H+ + O2 = tetrachlorohydroquinone + NADP+ + chloride.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoate 1-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = hydroquinone + NADP+ + H2O + CO2.

name: dibenzothiophene sulfone monooxygenase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dibenzothiophene 5,5-dioxide + FMNH2 + NADH + O2 = 2'-hydroxybiphenyl-2-sulfinate + FMN + H+ + H2O + NAD+.

name: camphor 5-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (+)-camphor + putidaredoxin + O2 = (+)-exo-5-hydroxycamphor + oxidized putidaredoxin + H2O.

name: 2,5-diketocamphane 1,2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1R,4R)-bornane-2,5-dione + FMNH2 + O2 = (1R,4R)-5-oxo-1,2-campholide + FMN + H+ + H2O.

name: alkane 1-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: octane + reduced rubredoxin + O2 = 1-octanol + oxidized rubredoxin + H2O.

name: biphenyl 2,3-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: biphenyl + NADH + H+ + O2 = (2R,3S)-3-phenylcyclohexa-3,5-diene-1,2-diol + NAD+. This reaction requires Fe2+.

name: 4-methoxybenzoate monooxygenase (O-demethylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-methoxybenzoate + AH(2) + O2 = 4-hydroxybenzoate + A + formaldehyde + H2O.

name: ethylbenzene hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A + ethylbenzene + H2O = (S)-1-phenylethanol + AH(2).

name: p-cymene methyl hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 H+ + O2 + p-cymene + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] = 4-isopropylbenzyl alcohol + H2O + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin].

name: 4-cresol dehydrogenase (hydroxylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-cresol + acceptor + H2O = 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde + reduced acceptor.

name: chloroethene reductive dehalogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AH2 + chloroethene = A + chloride + ethene + H+.

name: pyrogallol hydroxytransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2,3,5-tetrahydroxybenzene + 1,2,3-trihydroxybenzene = 1,3,5-trihydroxybenzene + 1,2,3,5-tetrahydroxybenzene.

name: thiol S-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a thiol = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a thioether.

name: acetone carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetone + ATP + CO2 + 2 H2O = acetoacetate + AMP + 4 H+ + 2 phosphate.

name: 6-aminohexanoate:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-aminohexanoate + 2-oxoglutarate = 6-oxohexanoate + L-glutamate.

name: phenol kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenol + X-phosphate = XH + phenylphosphate.

name: propionate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + propanoate = acetate + propanoyl-CoA.

name: glutaconate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-glutaconate + acetyl-CoA = (2E)-glutaconyl-CoA + acetate.

name: S-formylglutathione hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-formylglutathione + H2O = formate + glutathione + H+.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA thioesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA + H2O = 4-hydroxybenzoate + CoA + H+.

name: 2'-hydroxybiphenyl-2-sulfinate desulfinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-hydroxybiphenyl-2-sulfinate + H2O = biphenyl-2-ol + sulfite.

name: linear primary-alkylsulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a primary linear alkyl sulfate ester + H2O = a primary alcohol + H+ + sulfate.

name: limonene-1,2-epoxide hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: limonene-1,2-epoxide + H2O = limonene-1,2-diol. Other substrates include alicyclic and 1-methyl-substituted epoxides, such as 1-methylcyclohexene oxide, indene oxide and cyclohexene oxide.

name: biuret amidohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: biuret + H2O = urea-1-carboxylate + NH4+.

name: cyanuric acid amidohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyanurate + H2O = 1-carboxybiuret + H+.

name: ammeline aminohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ammeline + H2O = ammelide + NH4+. Also converts melamine to ammeline.

name: methenyltetrahydromethanopterin cyclohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methenyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + H2O = N(5)-formyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + H+.

name: thiocyanate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + 2 H+ + thiocyanate = carbonyl sulfide + NH4.

name: bromoxynil nitrilase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzonitrile + 2 H2O = 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzoate + NH4. Involved in the bacterial degradation of the herbicide bromoxynil.

name: aliphatic nitrilase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aliphatic nitrile + 2 H2O = a carboxylate + NH4+.

name: hydroxydechloroatrazine ethylaminohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-(ethylamino)-2-hydroxy-6-(isopropylamino)-1,3,5-triazine + H2O = N-isopropylammelide + ethylamine.

name: N-isopropylammelide isopropylaminohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-isopropylammelide + H2O = cyanuric acid + isopropylamine.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienoate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienoate + H2O = (2Z)-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate + acetate + H+.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-6-(2'-aminophenyl)hexa-2,4-dienoate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,4E)-6-(2-aminophenyl)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate + H2O = (2E)-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate + anthranilate + H+.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate + H2O = (2Z)-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate + H+ + succinate.

name: acetylpyruvate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetylpyruvate + H2O = acetate + H+ + pyruvate.

name: 2,6-dioxo-6-phenylhexa-3-enoate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,6-dioxo-6-phenylhexa-3-enoate + H2O = 2-oxopent-4-enoate + benzoate + H+.

name: 2-hydroxymuconate-semialdehyde hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate + H2O = 2-oxopent-4-enoate + formate + H+.

name: (S)-2-haloacid dehalogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2-haloacid + H2O = (R)-2-hydroxyacid + halide.

name: haloacetate dehalogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: haloacetate + H2O = glycolate + halide.

name: haloalkane dehalogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-haloalkane + H2O = a primary alcohol + halide.

name: 4-chlorobenzoyl-CoA dehalogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-chlorobenzoyl-CoA + H2O = 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA + chloride + H+.

name: atrazine chlorohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: atrazine + H2O = chloride + H+ + hydroxyatrazine.

name: cyclamate sulfohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexylsulfamate + H2O = cyclohexylamine + sulfate.

name: 4,5-dihydroxyphthalate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4,5-dihydroxyphthalate = 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + CO2.

name: gallate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: gallate + H+ = CO2 + pyrogallol.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + H+ = CO2 + phenol.

name: 5-oxopent-3-ene-1,2,5-tricarboxylate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-oxopent-3-ene-1,2,5-tricarboxylate = 2-oxohept-3-enedioate + CO2.

name: glutaconyl-CoA decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E)-glutaconyl-CoA + Na+(in) + H+ = (2E)-butenoyl-CoA + Na+(out) + CO2.

name: 4-(2-carboxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3Z)-4-(2-carboxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate + H2O = 2-formylbenzoate + pyruvate.

name: benzylsuccinate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: fumarate + toluene = 2-benzylsuccinate.

name: 6-hydroxycyclohex-1-ene-1-carboxyl-CoA hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-hydroxycyclohex-1-ene-1-carboxyl-CoA + H2O = 2,6-dihydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA.

name: 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-hydroxy-fatty acyl-CoA = a (2E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O.

name: trans-o-hydroxybenzylidenepyruvate hydratase-aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3E)-4-(2-hydroxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate + H2O = salicylaldehyde + pyruvate. A broad range of aldehydes and 4-substituted 2-oxobut-3-enoates are accepted as substrates.

name: phenylacetaldoxime dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (trans)-phenylacetaldoxime = H2O + phenylacetonitrile.

name: 2-oxo-hept-3-ene-1,7-dioate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-2-oxohept-3-ene-1,7-dioate + H2O = 2,4-dihydroxy-hept-trans-2-ene-1,7-dioate.

name: acetylene hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetaldehyde = acetylene + H2O.

name: lactoyl-CoA dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactoyl-CoA = acryloyl-CoA + H2O.

name: cyanamide hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: urea = cyanamide + H2O.

name: nitrile hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aliphatic amide = a nitrile + H2O.

name: cyclohexa-1,5-dienecarbonyl-CoA hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexa-1,5-diene-1-carbonyl-CoA + H2O = 6-hydroxycyclohex-1-enecarbonyl-CoA.

name: (hydroxyamino)benzene mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-phenylhydroxylamine = 2-aminophenol.

name: methionine gamma-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-methionine + H2O = methanethiol + 2-oxobutanoate + NH4+.

name: DDT-dehydrochlorinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,1,1-trichloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane = 1,1-dichloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethylene + chloride + H+.

name: dichloromethane dehalogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dichloromethane + H2O = 2 chloride + formaldehyde + 2 H+.

name: carbon phosphorus lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alkylphosphonic acid = R-CH3 + phosphate. Substrates include aminomethylphosphonic acid (AMPA) (forms methylamine), dimethylphosphinic acid (forms methylphosphonic acid), glyphosate (forms sarcosine) and methylphosphonic acid (forms phosphate).

name: alkylmercury lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alkylmercury + H+ = an alkane + Hg2+.

name: mandelate racemase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-mandelate = (R)-mandelate.

name: 2-hydroxychromene-2-carboxylate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxychromene-2-carboxylate = (3E)-4-(2-hydroxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate. (3E)-4-(2-hydroxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate is also known as trans-o-hydroxybenzylidenepyruvate.

name: styrene-oxide isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: styrene oxide = phenylacetaldehyde.

name: muconate cycloisomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,5-dihydro-5-oxofuran-2-acetate = cis,cis-hexadienedioate.

name: chloromuconate cycloisomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-chloro-2,5-dihydro-5-oxofuran-2-acetate = 3-chloro-cis,cis-muconate.

name: alpha-pinene-oxide decyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-pinene oxide = (Z)-2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienal.

name: dichloromuconate cycloisomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4-dichloro-2,5-dihydro-5-oxofuran-2-acetate = 2,4-dichloro-cis,cis-muconate.

name: 2-oxo-delta3-4,5,5-trimethylcyclopentenylacetyl-CoA synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxo-delta3-4,5,5-trimethylcyclopentenylacetate + ATP + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + 2-oxo-delta3-4,5,5-trimethylcyclopentenylacetyl-CoA.

name: benzoate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + benzoate + CoA = AMP + benzoyl-CoA + diphosphate.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + 4-hydroxybenzoate + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA.

name: anthranilate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + anthranilate + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + anthranilyl-CoA.

name: 4-chlorobenzoate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-chlorobenzoate + CoA + ATP = 4-chlorobenzoyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate. This reaction requires magnesium and is part of the bacterial 2,4-dichlorobenzoate degradation pathway.

name: phenyl-phosphate phosphatase/carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + H+ + phosphate = CO2 + H2O + phenyl phosphate.

name: guanyl nucleotide binding
definition: Binding to a guanyl nucleotide, consisting of guanosine esterified with (ortho)phosphate.

name: GMP binding
definition: Binding to GMP, guanosine monophosphate.

name: GDP binding
definition: Binding to GDP, guanosine 5'-diphosphate.

name: farnesoic acid O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesoate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = methyl (2E,6E)-farnesoate + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. Also converts juvenile hormone III carboxylate into juvenile hormone-III.

name: pyrimidine nucleotide binding
definition: Binding to a pyrimidine nucleotide, a pyrimidine nucleoside esterified with (ortho)phosphate.

name: DNA N-glycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of damaged bases by cleaving the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the target damaged DNA base and the deoxyribose sugar. The reaction releases a free base and leaves an apurinic/apyrimidinic (AP) site.

name: myristoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a myristoyl (CH3-[CH2]12-CO-) group to an acceptor molecule.

name: aryl-aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aromatic aldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = an aromatic acid + NADH + H+.

name: limonene monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of a monooxygenase reaction in which oxygen is incorporated into limonene.

name: phenanthrene-epoxide hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a phenanthrene dioxide + H2O = a dihydrodiolphenanthrene.

name: phenanthrene-9,10-epoxide hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenanthrene-9,10-oxide + H2O = trans-9,10-dihydrodiolphenanthrene.

name: hydrolase activity, acting on halide bonds, in C-halide compounds
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of any halide bond in substances containing halogen atoms in organic linkage.

name: choline monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: choline + 2 reduced ferredoxin + O2 + 2 H+ = betaine aldehyde hydrate + 2 oxidized ferredoxin + H2O.

name: glucosamine-1-phosphate N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + CoA + H+.

name: deoxyhypusine monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein N6-(4-aminobutyl)-L-lysine + donor-H2 + O2 = protein N6-((R)-4-amino-2-hydroxybutyl)-L-lysine + acceptor + H2O.

name: deoxynucleoside kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + 2'-deoxynucleoside = ADP + 2'-deoxynucleoside 5'-phosphate.

name: thioglucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a thioglucoside + H2O = a thiol + a sugar.

name: cytokinin dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N6-dimethylallyladenine + acceptor + H2O = adenine + 3-methylbut-2-enal + reduced electron acceptor.

name: inositol 3-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + myo-inositol = ADP + 1D-myo-inositol 3-phosphate.

name: 2-dehydropantolactone reductase (B-specific) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-pantolactone + NADP+ = 2-dehydropantolactone + NADPH + H+. The reaction is B-specific (i.e. the pro-S hydrogen is transferred from the 4-position of reduced nicotinamide cofactor) with respect to NADP+.

name: 2-hydroxyglutarate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glyoxylate + H2O + propanoyl-CoA = 2-hydroxyglutarate + CoA + H+.

name: 3-deoxy-manno-octulosonate-8-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 8-phospho-3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonate + H2O = 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonate + phosphate.

name: ADP-sugar pyrophosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ADP-sugar + H2O = AMP + alpha-D-aldose 1-phosphate.

name: aminobutyraldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-aminobutanal + NAD+ + H2O = 4-aminobutanoate + NADH + 2 H+.

name: arabinose-5-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-arabinose 5-phosphate = D-ribulose 5-phosphate + 2 H+.

name: (R)-aminopropanol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-1-aminopropan-2-ol + NAD+ = aminoacetone + H+ + NADH.

name: D-cysteine desulfhydrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-cysteine + H2O = hydrogen sulfide + pyruvate + NH4+ + H+.

name: 3-chloro-D-alanine dehydrochlorinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-chloro-D-alanine + H2O = chloride + pyruvate + NH4+ + H+.

name: D-ribulokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-ribulose = ADP + D-ribulose 5-phosphate.

name: galactose 1-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galactose + NAD+ = D-galactono-1,4-lactone + NADH + H+.

name: acetoin dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetoin + NAD+ = diacetyl + NADH + H+. This reaction is catalyzed in the reverse direction.

name: protein-disulfide reductase (glutathione) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 glutathione + protein-disulfide = glutathione disulfide+ protein-dithiol.

name: glycolate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A + glycolate = AH(2) + glyoxylate.

name: 3-(imidazol-5-yl)lactate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-(imidazol-5-yl)lactate + NADP+ = 3-(imidazol-5-yl)pyruvate + NADPH + H+.

name: isoamylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of alpha-(1,6)-D-glucosidic branch linkages in glycogen, amylopectin and their beta-limits dextrins.

name: mannokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-mannose = ADP + D-mannose 6-phosphate.

name: nicotinamide-nucleotide amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-nicotinamide D-ribonucleotide + H2O = nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + NH4+.

name: NMN nucleosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + nicotinamide mononucleotide = D-ribose 5-phosphate + H+ + nicotinamide.

name: diamine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alpha,omega-diamine + 2-oxoglutarate = an omega-aminoaldehyde + L-glutamate.

name: pyridoxamine:oxaloacetate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: oxaloacetate + pyridoxamine = L-aspartate + pyridoxal.

name: pyridoxamine-phosphate:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyridoxamine 5'-phosphate + 2-oxoglutarate = pyridoxal 5'-phosphate + D-glutamate.

name: pyruvate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyruvate + CoA + 2 oxidized ferredoxin = acetyl-CoA + CO2 + 2 reduced ferredoxin + 2 H+.

name: thiamine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + thiamine = ADP + 2 H+ + thiamine phosphate.

name: trans-2-enoyl-CoA reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + NADP+ = trans-2,3-dehydroacyl-CoA + NADPH + H+.

name: 2-polyprenylphenol 6-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-(all-trans-polyprenyl)phenol + NADPH + O2 + H+ = a 3-(all-trans-polyprenyl)benzene-1,2-diol + NADP+ + H2O.

name: methylglyoxal reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactaldehyde + NAD+ = methylglyoxal + NADH + H+.

name: (3R)-hydroxyacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a (3R)-hydroxyacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] = a (2E)-enoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] + H2O.

name: glyoxalase III activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methylglyoxal + H2O = D-lactate.

name: dihydroneopterin monophosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dihydroneopterin monophosphate = dihydroneopterin + phosphate.

name: dihydroneopterin triphosphate pyrophosphohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dihydroneopterin triphosphate = dihydroneopterin phosphate + diphosphate.

name: NADP phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + NADP+ = NAD+ + phosphate.

name: dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-D-glucose:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-D-glucose + 2-oxoglutarate = dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-D-glucose + L-glutamate.

name: dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxygalactose:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-alpha-D-galactose + 2-oxoglutarate = dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-alpha-D-glucose + L-glutamate.

name: halohydrin hydrogen-halide-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a halohydrin = an epoxide + a hydrogen halide.

name: histamine-gated chloride channel activity
definition: Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of a chloride ion through a transmembrane channel that opens when bound to histamine.

name: beta-1,4-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a mannose residue to an oligosaccharide, forming a beta-(1->4) linkage.

name: cellobiose transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of cellobiose from one side of a membrane to the other. Cellobiose, or 4-O-beta-D-glucopyranosyl-D-glucose, is a disaccharide that represents the basic repeating unit of cellulose.

name: galactosamine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of galactosamine from one side of a membrane to the other. Galactosamine is an aminodeoxysugar; D-galactosamine is a constituent of some glycolipids and glycosaminoglycans, commonly as its N-acetyl derivative.

name: transmembrane receptor protein phosphatase activity
definition: Combining with a signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: a phosphoprotein + H2O = a protein + phosphate.

name: transmembrane receptor protein kinase activity
definition: Combining with a signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: a protein + ATP = a phosphoprotein + ADP.

name: carbohydrate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group, usually from ATP, to a carbohydrate substrate molecule.

name: amino acid kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group, usually from ATP, to an amino acid substrate.

name: carbohydrate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carbohydrate phosphate + H2O = carbohydrate + phosphate.

name: nucleobase-containing compound kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group, usually from ATP or GTP, to a nucleobase, nucleoside, nucleotide or polynucleotide substrate.

name: nucleoside kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + nucleoside = ADP + nucleoside monophosphate.

name: kinase regulator activity
definition: Modulates the activity of a kinase, an enzyme which catalyzes of the transfer of a phosphate group, usually from ATP, to a substrate molecule.

name: phosphatase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of a phosphatase, an enzyme which catalyzes of the removal of a phosphate group from a substrate molecule.

name: kinase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a kinase, an enzyme which catalyzes of the transfer of a phosphate group, usually from ATP, to a substrate molecule.

name: kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a kinase.

name: phosphatase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a phosphatase.

name: phosphatase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a phosphatase.

name: deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of an acetyl group from a substrate molecule.

name: intermediate filament binding
definition: Binding to an intermediate filament, a distinct elongated structure, characteristically 10 nm in diameter, that occurs in the cytoplasm of higher eukaryotic cells. Intermediate filaments form a fibrous system, composed of chemically heterogeneous subunits and involved in mechanically integrating the various components of the cytoplasmic space.

name: centromeric DNA binding
definition: Binding to a centromere, a region of chromosome where the spindle fibers attach during mitosis and meiosis.

name: cyclohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of any non-peptide carbon-nitrogen bond in a cyclic amidine, a compound of the form R-C(=NH)-NH2, in a reaction that involves the opening of a ring.

name: deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of an amino group from a substrate, producing a substituted or nonsubstituted ammonia (NH4+/NH2R).

name: oxalate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of oxalate from one side of a membrane to the other. Oxalate, or ethanedioic acid, occurs in many plants and is highly toxic to animals.

name: toxin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a toxin from one side of a membrane to the other. A toxin is a poisonous compound (typically a protein) that is produced by cells or organisms and that can cause disease when introduced into the body or tissues of an organism.

name: ferric-vibriobactin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of ferric-vibriobactin ions from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: protein arginine N5-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to the delta-nitrogen atom of peptidyl-arginine residues. The reaction is S-adenosyl-L-methionine + [protein]-L-arginine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + [protein]-N5-methyl-L-arginine.

name: protein-cysteine S-myristoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a myristoyl (systematic name, tetradecanoyl) group to a sulfur atom on a cysteine residue of a protein molecule in the reaction: tetradecanoyl-CoA + L-cysteinyl-[protein] = CoA + S-tetradecanoyl-L-cysteinyl-[protein].

name: protein-cysteine S-palmitoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a palmitoyl (systematic name, hexadecanoyl) group to a sulfur atom on the cysteine of a protein molecule, in the reaction hexadecanoyl-CoA + L-cysteinyl-[protein] = CoA + S-hexadecanoyl-L-cysteinyl-[protein].

name: protein-cysteine S-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an acyl group to a sulfur atom on the cysteine of a protein molecule.

name: immunoglobulin receptor activity
definition: Combining with the Fc region of an immunoglobulin protein and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: IgA receptor activity
definition: Combining with an immunoglobulin of an IgA isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: IgE receptor activity
definition: Combining with an immunoglobulin of the IgE isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: high-affinity IgE receptor activity
definition: Combining with high affinity with an immunoglobulin of the IgE isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: low-affinity IgE receptor activity
definition: Combining with low affinity with an immunoglobulin of the IgE isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: IgG receptor activity
definition: Combining with an immunoglobulin of an IgG isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: high-affinity IgG receptor activity
definition: Combining with high affinity with an immunoglobulin of an IgG isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: low-affinity IgG receptor activity
definition: Combining with low affinity with an immunoglobulin of an IgG isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: FAT10 transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of FAT10 from one protein to another via the reaction X-FAT10 + Y = Y-FAT10 + X, where both X-FAT10 and Y-FAT10 are covalent linkages.

name: Atg8-family ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the covalent attachment of the ubiquitin-like protein Atg8 family modifier to phosphatidylethanolamine or phosphatidylserine on a membrane.

name: Atg12 transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of ATG12 from one protein to another via the reaction X-ATG12 + Y = Y-ATG12 + X, where both X-ATG12 and Y-ATG12 are covalent linkages.

name: Atg12 activating enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the activation of the small ubiquitin-related modifier APG12, through the formation of an ATP-dependent high-energy thiolester bond.

name: Atg8 activating enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the activation of the small ubiquitin-related modifier APG8, through the formation of an ATP-dependent high-energy thiolester bond.

name: FAT10 activating enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the activation of the small ubiquitin-related modifier FAT10, through the formation of an ATP-dependent high-energy thiolester bond.

name: NEDD8 activating enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the initiation of the NEDD8 (RUB1) conjugation cascade.

name: ISG15 activating enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the activation of the small ubiquitin-related modifier ISG15, through the formation of an ATP-dependent high-energy thiolester bond.

name: ubiquitin-like protein peptidase activity
definition: An isopeptidase activity that cleaves ubiquitin or ubiquitin-like proteins (ULP; e.g. ATG8, ISG15, NEDD8, SUMO) from target proteins.

name: deNEDDylase activity
definition: An isopeptidase activity that cleaves NEDD8 from a target protein to which it is conjugated.

name: ISG15-specific peptidase activity
definition: A thiol-dependent isopeptidase activity that cleaves ISG15 from a target protein to which it is conjugated.

name: protein-phosphatidylethanolamide deconjugating activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [protein]-C-terminal L-amino acid-glycyl-phosphatidylethanolamide + H2O = [protein]-C-terminal L-amino acid-glycine + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine. An example of this reaction is the removal of ATG8 from membranes to which it is covalently linked to a phosphatidylethanolamid via its terminal glycine residue.

name: ubiquitin-like protein transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin-like from one protein to another via the reaction X-ULP + Y = Y-ULP + X, where both X-ULP and Y-ULP are covalent linkages. ULP represents a ubiquitin-like protein.

name: NEDD8 transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of NEDD8 from one protein to another via the reaction X-NEDD8 + Y = Y-NEDD8 + X, where both X-NEDD8 and Y-NEDD8 are covalent linkages.

name: SUMO transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of SUMO from one protein to another via the reaction X-SUMO + Y = Y-SUMO + X, where both X-SUMO and Y-SUMO are covalent linkages.

name: procollagen-proline 3-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: procollagen L-proline + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = procollagen trans-3-hydroxy-L-proline + succinate + CO2.

name: procollagen-proline dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: procollagen L-proline + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = procollagen trans-hydroxy-L-proline + succinate + CO2.

name: tubulin N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + (alpha-tubulin) L-lysine = CoA + (alpha-tubulin) N6-acetyl-L-lysine. In most organisms it acetylates L-lysine at position 40 of alpha- tubulin.

name: bromide peroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 R-H + 2 bromide + H2O2 = 2 R-Br + 2 H2O. Enzymes with this activity often accept other halide ions as substrates, including chloride and iodide.

name: aspartoacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acyl-L-aspartate + H2O = a fatty acid anion + L-aspartate.

name: polyamine binding
definition: Binding to a polyamine, an organic compound containing two or more amino groups.

name: spermidine binding
definition: Binding to spermidine, N-(3-aminopropyl)-1,4-diaminobutane.

name: putrescine binding
definition: Binding to putrescine, 1,4-diaminobutane, the polyamine formed by decarboxylation of ornithine and the metabolic precursor of spermidine and spermine.

name: cocaine binding
definition: Binding to cocaine (2-beta-carbomethoxy-3-beta-benzoxytropane), an alkaloid obtained from dried leaves of the South American shrub Erythroxylon coca or by chemical synthesis.

name: oxygen binding
definition: Binding to oxygen (O2).

name: oxygen sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of oxygen (O2).

name: aspartic-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of aspartic-type endopeptidases.

name: ATPase-coupled monoatomic cation transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + cation(out) = ADP + phosphate + cation(in).

name: ice nucleation activity
definition: Catalysis of the formation of ice crystals in extracellular fluid at relatively high temperatures (up to -2 degrees Celsius) to protect the organism from damage by intracellular ice formation. This process is commonly found in certain bacteria, such as Pseudomonas syringae, and plays roles in environmental adaptation and plant pathogenesis.

name: phospholipase A2 inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of phospholipase A2.

name: growth factor binding
definition: Binding to a growth factor, proteins or polypeptides that stimulate a cell or organism to grow or proliferate.

name: isoprenoid binding
definition: Binding to an isoprenoid compound, isoprene (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene) or compounds containing or derived from linked isoprene (3-methyl-2-butenylene) residues.

name: retinol binding
definition: Binding to retinol, vitamin A1, 2,6,6-trimethyl-1-(9'-hydroxy-3',7'-dimethylnona-1',3',5',7'-tetraenyl)cyclohex-1-ene, one of the three components that makes up vitamin A. Retinol is an intermediate in the vision cycle and it also plays a role in growth and differentiation.

name: vitamin binding
definition: Binding to a vitamin, one of a number of unrelated organic substances that occur in many foods in small amounts and that are necessary in trace amounts for the normal metabolic functioning of the body.

name: rRNA binding
definition: Binding to a ribosomal RNA.

name: calcium channel inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents, or reduces the activity of a calcium channel.

name: IgA binding
definition: Binding to an immunoglobulin of an IgA isotype.

name: IgE binding
definition: Binding to an immunoglobulin of the IgE isotype.

name: IgG binding
definition: Binding to an immunoglobulin of an IgG isotype.

name: immunoglobulin binding
definition: Binding to an immunoglobulin.

name: chloride channel inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents, or reduces the activity of a chloride channel.

name: potassium channel inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents, or reduces the activity of a potassium channel.

name: sodium channel inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents, or reduces the activity of a sodium channel.

name: 6-aminohexanoate-cyclic-dimer hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,8-diazacyclotetradecane-2,9-dione + H2O = N-(6-aminohexanoyl)-6-aminohexanoate.

name: 6-aminohexanoate-dimer hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-(6-aminohexanoyl)-6-aminohexanoate + H2O = 2 6-aminohexanoate.

name: protein kinase regulator activity
definition: Modulates the activity of a protein kinase, an enzyme which phosphorylates a protein.

name: protein phosphatase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of a protein phosphatase.

name: kinesin binding
definition: Interacting selectively and non-covalently and stoichiometrically with kinesin, a member of a superfamily of microtubule-based motor proteins that perform force-generating tasks such as organelle transport and chromosome segregation.

name: enzyme binding
definition: Binding to an enzyme, a protein with catalytic activity.

name: kinase binding
definition: Binding to a kinase, any enzyme that catalyzes the transfer of a phosphate group.

name: protein kinase binding
definition: Binding to a protein kinase, any enzyme that catalyzes the transfer of a phosphate group, usually from ATP, to a protein substrate.

name: phosphatase binding
definition: Binding to a phosphatase.

name: protein phosphatase binding
definition: Binding to a protein phosphatase.

name: protein domain specific binding
definition: Binding to a specific domain of a protein.

name: syntaxin binding
definition: Binding to a syntaxin, a SNAP receptor involved in the docking of vesicles.

name: structural constituent of myelin sheath
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the myelin sheath of a nerve.

name: cyclin-dependent protein kinase regulator activity
definition: Modulation of the activity of the enzyme cyclin-dependent protein kinase activating kinase.

name: SUMO activating enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the activation of the proteolytically processed small ubiquitin-related modifier SUMO, through the formation of an ATP-dependent high-energy thiolester bond.

name: cytokine binding
definition: Binding to a cytokine, any of a group of proteins that function to control the survival, growth and differentiation of tissues and cells, and which have autocrine and paracrine activity.

name: chemokine binding
definition: Binding to a chemokine. Chemokines are a family of small chemotactic cytokines; their name is derived from their ability to induce directed chemotaxis in nearby responsive cells. All chemokines possess a number of conserved cysteine residues involved in intramolecular disulfide bond formation. Some chemokines are considered pro-inflammatory and can be induced during an immune response to recruit cells of the immune system to a site of infection, while others are considered homeostatic and are involved in controlling the migration of cells during normal processes of tissue maintenance or development. Chemokines are found in all vertebrates, some viruses and some bacteria.

name: C-C chemokine binding
definition: Binding to a C-C chemokine; C-C chemokines do not have an amino acid between the first two cysteines of the characteristic four-cysteine motif.

name: C-X-C chemokine binding
definition: Binding to a C-X-C chemokine; C-X-C chemokines have a single amino acid between the first two cysteines of the characteristic four cysteine motif.

name: interleukin-8 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-8.

name: C-X3-C chemokine binding
definition: Binding to a C-X3-C chemokine; C-X3-C chemokines have three amino acids between the first two cysteines of the characteristic four-cysteine motif.

name: interferon binding
definition: Binding to an interferon, a protein produced by the immune systems of many animals in response to a challenge by a foreign agent.

name: type I interferon binding
definition: Binding to a type I interferon. Type I interferons include the interferon-alpha, beta, delta, epsilon, zeta, kappa, tau, and omega gene families.

name: type II interferon binding
definition: Binding to type II interferon, also known as interferon-gamma.

name: interleukin-1 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-1.

name: interleukin-10 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-10.

name: interleukin-11 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-11.

name: interleukin-12 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-12.

name: interleukin-13 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-13.

name: interleukin-17 binding
definition: Binding to a member of the interleukin-17 family of cytokines.

name: interleukin-2 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-2.

name: interleukin-21 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-21.

name: interleukin-3 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-3.

name: interleukin-4 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-4.

name: interleukin-5 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-5.

name: interleukin-6 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-6.

name: interleukin-7 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-7.

name: interleukin-9 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-9.

name: diacylglycerol binding
definition: Binding to a diacylglycerol, a diester of glycerol and two fatty acids.

name: heme binding
definition: Binding to a heme, a compound composed of iron complexed in a porphyrin (tetrapyrrole) ring.

name: passive transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a single solute from one side of a membrane to the other by a mechanism involving conformational change, either by facilitated diffusion or in a membrane potential dependent process if the solute is charged.

name: active transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a specific substance or related group of substances from one side of a membrane to the other, up the solute's concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction.

name: mobile ion carrier activity
definition: Small molecule produced by bacteria that carries an ion across the membrane by enclosing the ion and travelling with the ion across the membrane. It does not form a fully open pore across the membrane.

name: membrane potential driven uniporter activity
definition: Enables the active transport of a solute across a membrane by a mechanism involving conformational change, where energy for active transport is derived from membrane potential if the solute is charged.

name: sodium ion uniporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the active transport of a sodium ion across a membrane by a mechanism involving conformational change, where energy for active transport is derived from membrane potential if the solute is charged.

name: potassium ion uniporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the active transport of a potassium ion across a membrane by a mechanism involving conformational change, where energy for active transport is derived from membrane potential if the solute is charged.

name: solute:potassium antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the active transport of a potassium ion across a membrane by a mechanism whereby two or more species are transported in opposite directions in a tightly coupled process not directly linked to a form of energy other than chemiosmotic energy.

name: transmitter-gated monoatomic ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a specific neurotransmitter has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: wide pore channel activity
definition: Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of propanediol through a large pore, un-gated channel. Examples include gap junctions, which transport substances from one cell to another; and porins which transport substances in and out of bacteria, mitochondria and chloroplasts.

name: narrow pore, gated channel activity
definition: Enables the transport of a solute across a membrane via a narrow pore channel that opens in response to a particular stimulus.

name: voltage-gated channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a solute by a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

name: ligand-gated channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a solute by a channel that opens when a specific ligand has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: transmitter-gated channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a solute by a channel that opens when a specific neurotransmitter has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: gated channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a solute by a channel that opens in response to a specific stimulus.

name: monoatomic ion-gated channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a solute by a channel that opens in response to a specific ion stimulus.

name: leak channel activity
definition: Enables the transport of a solute across a membrane via a narrow pore channel that is open even in an unstimulated or 'resting' state.

name: potassium ion leak channel activity
definition: Enables the transport of a potassium ion across a membrane via a narrow pore channel that is open even in an unstimulated or 'resting' state.

name: narrow pore channel activity
definition: Enables the transport of a solute across a membrane via a narrow pore channel that may be gated or ungated.

name: voltage-gated monoatomic cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a cation by a voltage-gated channel. A cation is a positively charged ion. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

name: acetylcholine-gated monoatomic cation-selective channel activity
definition: Selectively enables the transmembrane transfer of a cation by a channel that opens upon binding acetylcholine.

name: glutamate-gated calcium ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion by a channel that opens when glutamate has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: serotonin-gated monoatomic cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a cation by a channel that opens when serotonin has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: GABA-gated chloride ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a chloride ion by a channel that opens when GABA has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: glycine-gated chloride ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a chloride ion by a channel that opens when glycine has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: active monoatomic ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of an ion from one side of a membrane to the other up the solute's concentration gradient. This is carried out by binding the solute and undergoing a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-glucose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + glucose(out) = protein histidine + glucose phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-sorbitol phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + sorbitol(out) = protein histidine + sorbitol phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a substance, usually a specific substance or a group of related substances, from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: alanine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of alanine from one side of a membrane to the other. Alanine is 2-aminopropanoic acid.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-lactose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + lactose(out) = protein histidine + lactose phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-mannose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane according to the reaction: D-mannose(out) + N(pros)-phospho-L-histidyl-[protein] = D-mannose 6-phosphate(in) + L-histidyl-[protein]. This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-sorbose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + sorbose(out) = protein histidine + sorbose phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-mannitol phosphotransferase system transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + mannitol(out) = protein histidine + mannitol phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-maltose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + maltose(out) = protein histidine + maltose phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-cellobiose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane according to the reaction: D-cellobiose(out) + N(pros)-phospho-L-histidyl-[protein] = 6-phospho-beta-D-glucosyl-(1->4)-D-glucose(in) + L-histidyl-[protein]. This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-galactitol phosphotransferase system transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + galactitol(out) = protein histidine + galactitol phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-galactosamine phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + galactosamine(out) = protein histidine + galactosamine phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-fructose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + fructose(out) = protein histidine + fructose phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-sucrose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + sucrose(out) = protein histidine + sucrose phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-trehalose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + trehalose(out) = protein histidine + trehalose phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-N-acetylglucosamine phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane by the reaction: N(pros)-phospho-L-histidyl-[protein] + N-acetyl-D-glucosamine(out) = L-histidyl-[protein] + N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-N-acetylgalactosamine phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + N-acetylgalactosamine(out) = protein histidine + N-acetylgalactosamine phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-beta-glucoside phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + beta-glucoside(out) = protein histidine + beta-glucoside phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: zinc efflux transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a zinc ion or zinc ions from the inside of the cell to the outside of the cell across a membrane.

name: macromolecule transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a macromolecule from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: bacteriocin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a bacteriocin from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: channel-forming ionophore activity
definition: Enables transport of a solute across a membrane. This kind of transporter interacts much more weakly with the solute than the carrier does. It is an aqueous pore that extends across the membrane. It may change from closed to open and back. It transports faster than a carrier. It is always passive.

name: low-affinity tryptophan transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the low-affinity transfer of L-tryptophan from one side of a membrane to the other. Tryptophan is 2-amino-3-(1H-indol-3-yl)propanoic acid. In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations.

name: intermediate conductance calcium-activated potassium channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of potassium by a channel with a unit conductance of 20 to 85 picoSiemens that opens in response to stimulus by internal calcium ions. Intermediate conductance calcium-activated potassium channels are more sensitive to calcium than are large conductance calcium-activated potassium channels. Transport by a channel involves catalysis of facilitated diffusion of a solute (by an energy-independent process) involving passage through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel, without evidence for a carrier-mediated mechanism.

name: MHC protein complex binding
definition: Binding to a major histocompatibility complex.

name: MHC class I protein complex binding
definition: Binding to a class I major histocompatibility complex.

name: MHC class Ib protein complex binding
definition: Binding to a class Ib major histocompatibility complex.

name: MHC class II protein complex binding
definition: Binding to a class II major histocompatibility complex.

name: MHC class I protein binding, via antigen binding groove
definition: Binding to a major histocompatibility complex class I molecules via the antigen binding groove.

name: MHC class I protein binding, via lateral surface
definition: Binding to a major histocompatibility complex class I molecules via the lateral surface.

name: MHC class Ib protein binding
definition: Binding to a major histocompatibility complex class Ib molecules.

name: MHC class Ib protein binding, via antigen binding groove
definition: Binding to a major histocompatibility complex class Ib molecules via the antigen binding groove.

name: MHC class Ib protein binding, via lateral surface
definition: Binding to a major histocompatibility complex class Ib molecules via the lateral surface.

name: extracellular matrix structural constituent conferring tensile strength
definition: A constituent of the extracellular matrix that enables the matrix to resist longitudinal stress.

name: extracellular matrix structural constituent conferring compression resistance
definition: A constituent of the extracellular matrix that enables the matrix to resist compressive forces; often a proteoglycan.

name: extracellular matrix constituent conferring elasticity
definition: A component of the extracellular matrix that enables the matrix to recoil after transient stretching.

name: aliphatic amine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aliphatic amine + an acceptor (A) + H2O = an aldehyde + a reduced acceptor (AH2) + NH4+.

name: aralkylamine dehydrogenase (azurin) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aralkylamine + H2O + 2 oxidized [azurin] = an aromatic aldehyde + 2 H+ + NH4+ + 2 reduced [azurin].

name: L-malate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate + NAD+ = oxaloacetate + NADH + H+.

name: HLA-A specific inhibitory MHC class I receptor activity
definition: Combining with a MHC class I molecule of the HLA-A subclass to mediate signaling that inhibits activation of a lymphocyte.

name: HLA-A specific activating MHC class I receptor activity
definition: Combining with a MHC class I molecule of the HLA-A subclass to mediate signaling that activates a lymphocyte.

name: HLA-B specific inhibitory MHC class I receptor activity
definition: Combining with a MHC class I molecule of the HLA-B subclass to mediate signaling that inhibits activation of a lymphocyte.

name: HLA-C specific inhibitory MHC class I receptor activity
definition: Combining with a MHC class I molecule of the HLA-C subclass to mediate signaling that inhibits activation of a lymphocyte.

name: glial cell-derived neurotrophic factor receptor binding
definition: A growth factor that binds selectively and non-covalently to glial cell-derived neurotrophic factor receptors.

name: alpha-1,6-mannosylglycoprotein 6-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,2-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,3(6)-(N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,2-alpha-D-mannosyl,1,6(3))-beta-D-mannosyl-1,4-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-R = UDP + N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,2-(N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,6)-1,2-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,3(6)-(N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,2-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,6(3))-beta-D-mannosyl-1,4-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-R. Only branched mannose glycopeptides with non-reducing N-acetylglucosamine terminal residues act as acceptors.

name: manganese ion binding
definition: Binding to a manganese ion (Mn).

name: molybdenum ion binding
definition: Binding to a molybdenum ion (Mo).

name: benzodiazepine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a peripheral benzodiazepine receptor (PBR).

name: protein xylosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a beta-D-xylosyl residue from UDP-D-xylose to the serine hydroxyl group of an acceptor protein substrate.

name: signaling receptor complex adaptor activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that provides a physical support for the assembly of a multiprotein receptor signaling complex.

name: synaptic receptor adaptor activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that provides a physical support bridging a synaptic signaling receptor and a downstream signaling molecule.

name: PDZ domain binding
definition: Binding to a PDZ domain of a protein, a domain found in diverse signaling proteins.

name: low-density lipoprotein particle binding
definition: Binding to a low-density lipoprotein particle, a lipoprotein particle that is rich in cholesterol esters and low in triglycerides, is typically composed of APOB100 and APOE, and has a density of 1.02-1.06 g/ml and a diameter of between 20-25 nm.

name: pyridoxal phosphate binding
definition: Binding to pyridoxal 5' phosphate, 3-hydroxy-5-(hydroxymethyl)-2-methyl4-pyridine carboxaldehyde 5' phosphate, the biologically active form of vitamin B6.

name: voltage-gated proton channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a proton by a voltage-gated channel. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

name: troponin C binding
definition: Binding to troponin C, the calcium-binding subunit of the troponin complex.

name: nitric oxide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of nitric oxide, nitrogen monoxide, from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: cyanide hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: formamide = H2O + hydrogen cyanide.

name: extracellular matrix constituent, lubricant activity
definition: Functions as a lubricant for an extracellular matrix, such as a mucous membrane.

name: semaphorin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a semaphorin receptor.

name: apolipoprotein receptor activity
definition: Combining with an apolipoprotein to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: lipoprotein particle receptor activity
definition: Combining with a lipoprotein particle and delivering the lipoprotein particle into the cell via endocytosis. A lipoprotein particle, also known as a lipoprotein, is a clathrate complex consisting of a lipid enwrapped in a protein host without covalent binding in such a way that the complex has a hydrophilic outer surface consisting of all the protein and the polar ends of any phospholipids.

name: very-low-density lipoprotein particle receptor activity
definition: Combining with a very-low-density lipoprotein particle and delivering the very-low-density lipoprotein into the cell via endocytosis.

name: deoxynucleotide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalyzes transport of all four deoxy (d) NDPs, and, less efficiently, the corresponding dNTPs, in exchange for dNDPs, ADP, or ATP.

name: enzyme regulator activity
definition: A molecular function regulator that modulates a catalytic activity.

name: nitric-oxide synthase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of nitric oxide synthase.

name: carbohydrate binding
definition: Binding to a carbohydrate, which includes monosaccharides, oligosaccharides and polysaccharides as well as substances derived from monosaccharides by reduction of the carbonyl group (alditols), by oxidation of one or more hydroxy groups to afford the corresponding aldehydes, ketones, or carboxylic acids, or by replacement of one or more hydroxy group(s) by a hydrogen atom. Cyclitols are generally not regarded as carbohydrates.

name: polysaccharide binding
definition: Binding to a polysaccharide, a polymer of many (typically more than 10) monosaccharide residues linked glycosidically.

name: cellulose binding
definition: Binding to cellulose.

name: guanylate cyclase regulator activity
definition: Modulates the activity of guanylate cyclase.

name: guanylate cyclase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of guanylate cyclase.

name: guanylate cyclase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of guanylate cyclase.

name: quinate 3-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (-)-quinate + NAD+ = (-)-3-dehydroquinate + NADH + H+.

name: glyoxylate reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycolate + NADP+ = glyoxylate + NADPH + H+.

name: methylenetetrahydromethanopterin dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydromethanopterin + coenzyme F420 + 2 H+ = 5,10-methenyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + reduced coenzyme F420.

name: tetrahydromethanopterin S-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-methyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + coenzyme M + 2 Na+(in) = 5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + methyl-coenzyme M + 2 Na+(out). 2-(methylthio)ethanesulfonate is also known as methyl-CoM.

name: formylmethanofuran-tetrahydromethanopterin N-formyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + N-formylmethanofuran + H+ = N(5)-formyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + methanofuran.

name: 5-formyltetrahydrofolate cyclo-ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-formyltetrahydrofolate + ATP = 5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolate + ADP + H+ + phosphate.

name: melanin-concentrating hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with the cyclic peptide hormone melanin-concentrating hormone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: LIM domain binding
definition: Binding to a LIM domain (for Lin-11 Isl-1 Mec-3) of a protein, a domain with seven conserved cysteine residues and a histidine, that binds two zinc ions and acts as an interface for protein-protein interactions.

name: LRR domain binding
definition: Binding to a LRR domain (leucine rich repeats) of a protein.

name: clathrin binding
definition: Binding to a clathrin heavy or light chain, the main components of the coat of coated vesicles and coated pits, and which also occurs in synaptic vesicles.

name: structural constituent of skin epidermis
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of an epidermal cutaneous structure.

name: structural constituent of cutaneous appendage
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of cutaneous epidermal structures such as hairs, scales, or feathers.

name: nuclear estrogen receptor activity
definition: A nuclear receptor activity regulated by estrogen binding and modulating the transcription of specific gene sets transcribed by RNA polymerase II.

name: sphingolipid activator protein activity
definition: Any of a group of peptide cofactors of enzymes for the lysosomal degradation of sphingolipids. They stimulate various enzymes, including glucosylceramidase, galactosylceramidase, cerebroside-sulfatase, alpha-galactosidase, beta-galactosidase, and sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase.

name: protein serine/threonine kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a protein serine/threonine kinase.

name: protein tyrosine kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a protein tyrosine kinase.

name: transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase.

name: receptor signaling protein tyrosine kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a receptor signaling protein tyrosine kinase.

name: protein kinase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a protein kinase, an enzyme which phosphorylates a protein.

name: protein tyrosine kinase activator activity
definition: Increases the activity of a protein tyrosine kinase, an enzyme which phosphorylates a tyrosyl phenolic group on a protein.

name: transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase.

name: receptor signaling protein tyrosine kinase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a receptor signaling protein tyrosine kinase.

name: heparanase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-glycosidic bonds of heparan sulfate chains in heparan sulfate proteoglycan.

name: nuclear estrogen receptor binding
definition: Binding to a nuclear estrogen receptor.

name: cyclin binding
definition: Binding to cyclins, proteins whose levels in a cell varies markedly during the cell cycle, rising steadily until mitosis, then falling abruptly to zero. As cyclins reach a threshold level, they are thought to drive cells into G2 phase and thus to mitosis.

name: DNA polymerase processivity factor activity
definition: An enzyme regulator activity that increases the processivity of polymerization by DNA polymerase, by allowing the polymerase to move rapidly along DNA while remaining topologically bound to it.

name: CMP-N-acetylneuraminate monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = CMP-N-glycoloyl-beta-neuraminate + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + H2O.

name: fatty-acyl-ethyl-ester synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain-acyl ethyl ester + H2O = a long-chain carboxylic acid + ethanol.

name: hyaluronate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hyaluronate(n) = n 3-(4-deoxy-beta-D-gluc-4-enuronosyl)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + H2O.

name: chondroitin AC lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the eliminative degradation of polysaccharides containing 1,4-beta-D-hexosaminyl and 1,3-beta-D-glucuronosyl linkages to disaccharides containing 4-deoxy-beta-D-gluc-4-enuronosyl groups.

name: 1-alpha,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 24-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydroxylation of C-24 of 1-alpha,25-hydroxycholecalciferol (25-hydroxyvitamin D3; calcitriol).

name: vitamin D 25-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: calciol (vitamin D3) + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = calcidiol + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O + H+.

name: structural constituent of tooth enamel
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of tooth enamel.

name: protein phosphatase 2B binding
definition: Binding to a protein phosphatase 2B.

name: syntaxin-3 binding
definition: Binding to a syntaxin-3 SNAP receptor.

name: iron-responsive element binding
