name: dihydrolipoamide branched chain acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-dihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + 2-methylpropanoyl-CoA = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-2-methylpropanoyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + CoA. In addition to transferring the 2-methylpropanoyl group when acting on the oxoacid corresponding with valine, this activity also transfers the 3-methylbutanoyl and S-2-methylbutanoyl groups when acting on the oxo acids corresponding with leucine and isoleucine.

name: alpha-ribazole phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-ribazole 5'-phosphate + H2O = alpha-ribazole + phosphate.

name: adenosylcobinamide hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosylcobinamide + H2O = (R)-1-aminopropan-2-ol + adenosylcobyrate.

name: adenosylcobinamide-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: ATP + adenosylcobyric acid + (R)-1-aminopropan-2-yl phosphate = ADP + phosphate + adenosylcobinamide phosphate, and ATP + adenosylcobyric acid + (R)-1-aminopropan-2-ol = ADP + phosphate + adenosylcobinamide.

name: acetate-CoA ligase (ADP-forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + acetate + CoA = ADP + phosphate + acetyl-CoA.

name: 2-methylbutanoate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + 2-methylbutanoate + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + 2-methylbutanoyl-CoA.

name: archaetidylserine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CDP-digeranylgeranylglycerol + L-serine = archaetidylserine + CMP.

name: UTP:glucose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of UTP:glucose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase.

name: T/G mismatch-specific endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the repair of T/G mismatches arising from deamination of 5-methylcytosine in DNA by nicking double-stranded DNA within the sequence CT(AT)GN or NT(AT)GG next to the mismatched thymidine residue. The incision is mismatch-dependent and strand-specific, in favor of the G-containing strand. The incision serves as a starting point for subsequent excision repair by DNA polymerase I, which excises thymidine and reinserts cytidine.

name: Sep-tRNA:Cys-tRNA synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + hydrogen sulfide + O-phospho-L-seryl-tRNA(Cys) = L-cysteinyl-tRNA(Cys) + phosphate.

name: pyrrolysyl-tRNA synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-pyrrolysine + tRNA(Pyl) = AMP + diphosphate + L-pyrrolysyl-tRNA(Pyl).

name: S-ribosylhomocysteine lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-(5-deoxy-D-ribos-5-yl)-L-homocysteine = (S)-4,5-dihydroxypentane-2,3-dione + L-homocysteine.

name: demethylmenaquinone methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-demethylmenaquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a menaquinol + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. Reaction substrates can have varying polyprenyl side chain length.

name: cytidine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + cytidine = ADP + CMP.

name: acyl-phosphate glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl phosphate + sn-glycerol 3-phosphate = 1-acyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + orthophosphate.

name: coenzyme F420-0 gamma-glutamyl ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: (1) GTP + F420-0 + L-glutamate = GDP + phosphate + F420-1, and (2) GTP + F420-1 + L-glutamate = GDP + phosphate + gamma-F420-2. This is the GTP-dependent successive addition of two L-glutamates to the L-lactyl phosphodiester of 7,8-didemethyl-8-hydroxy-5-deazariboflavin (F420-0) to form F420-0-glutamyl-glutamate (F420-2), with a gamma-linkage between the two glutamates.

name: coenzyme F420-2 alpha-glutamyl ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: coenzyme F420-2 + L-glutamate + GTP = coenzyme F420-3 + GDP + orthophosphate.

name: cobalt-precorrin-6B C5-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosylmethionine + cobalt-precorrin 6B = S-adenosylhomocysteine + cobalt-precorrin 7.

name: cobalt-precorrin-7 C15-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cobalt-precorrin 7 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = cobalt-precorrin 8 + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + CO2.

name: cobalt-precorrin-8 methylmutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cobalt-precorrin 8 = cobyrinate.

name: cobalt-precorrin-5A acetaldehyde-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cobalt-precorrin 5A + H2O = cobalt-precorrin 5B + acetaldehyde + H+.

name: cobalt-precorrin-5B C1-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cobalt-precorrin 5B + S-adenosylmethionine = S-adenosylhomocysteine + cobalt-precorrin 6A.

name: cobalt-factor II C20-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + cobalt-factor II = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + cobalt-factor III.

name: cobalt-precorrin-3 C17-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cobalt-precorrin 3 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = cobalt-precorrin 4 + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: cinnamoyl-CoA:phenyllactate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (E)-cinnamoyl-CoA + (R)-3-phenyllactate = (R)-3-phenyllactoyl-CoA + (E)-cinnamate.

name: cinnamate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phenylpropanoate + NAD+ = (E)-cinnamate + NADH + H+.

name: dimethylamine methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dimethylamine + a dimethylamine corrinoid protein = a methylated dimethylamine corrinoid protein + methylamine.

name: enamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,4,5,6-tetrahydro-6-oxonicotinate + 2 H2O = 2-formylglutarate + NH4.

name: beta-ribofuranosylaminobenzene 5'-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + H+ = 4-(beta-D-ribofuranosyl)phenol 5'-phosphate + CO2 + diphosphate. Both 4-hydroxybenzoate and 4-aminobenzoate may be used as substrates, but only the former is known to be produced by methanogenic archaea.

name: formate dehydrogenase (coenzyme F420) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: formate + 2 H+ + oxidized coenzyme F420-(gamma-L-Glu)(n) = CO2 + reduced coenzyme F420-(gamma-L-Glu)(n).

name: glyceraldehyde oxidoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A + D-glyceraldehyde + H2O = (R)-glycerate + AH2 + H+.

name: glyceraldehyde dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde + H2O + NADP+ = D-glycerate + NADPH + H+.

name: glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (ferredoxin) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate + H2O + 2 oxidized ferredoxin = 3-phospho-D-glycerate + 2 H+ + 2 reduced ferredoxin.

name: glycerate 2-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glycerate + ATP = 2-phospho-D-glycerate + ADP.

name: glycine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: (1) glycine + H2O + O2 = glyoxylate + NH4+ + H2O2; (2) D-alanine + H2O + O2 = pyruvate + NH4+ + H2O2; (3) sarcosine + H2O + O2 = glyoxylate + methylamine + H2O2; (4) N-ethylglycine + H2O + O2 = glyoxylate + ethylamine + H2O2.

name: 6-phospho-3-hexuloisomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-arabino-hex-3-ulose 6-phosphate = beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate.

name: hexulose-6-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribulose 5-phosphate + formaldehyde = D-arabino-3-hexulose 6-phosphate.

name: hydrogenobyrinic acid a,c-diamide synthase (glutamine-hydrolysing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 L-glutamine + 2 ATP + 2 H2O + hydrogenobyrinate = 2 L-glutamate + 2 ADP + 4 H+ + hydrogenobyrinate a,c-diamide + 2 phosphate.

name: hydroxyneurosporene-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: demethylspheroidene + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + spheroidene.

name: imidazolone hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: imidazol-4-one + H2O = N-formimidoylglycine.

name: indolepyruvate ferredoxin oxidoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (indol-3-yl)pyruvate + CoA + oxidized ferredoxin = S-2-(indol-3-yl)acetyl-CoA + CO2 + reduced ferredoxin.

name: 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate dehydrogenase (ferredoxin) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + CoA + oxidized ferredoxin = S-(2-methylpropanoyl)-CoA + CO2 + reduced ferredoxin.

name: lyso-ornithine lipid acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: lyso-ornithine lipid + acyl-[acyl-carrier protein] = ornithine lipid + [acyl-carrier protein].

name: ornithine-acyl [acyl carrier protein] N-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3R)-3-hydroxyacyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + L-ornithine = lyso-ornithine lipid + [acyl-carrier protein]. The enzyme, found in bacteria, catalyzes the first step in the biosynthesis of ornithine lipids.

name: phosphate:acyl-[acyl carrier protein] acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a fatty acyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + orthophosphate = acyl phosphate + [acyl-carrier protein].

name: phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate) + H2O = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol) + phosphate.

name: phosphatidylinositol-3,5-bisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-3,5-bisphosphate) + H2O = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-3-phosphate) + phosphate.

name: phospholactate guanylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-phospho-(S)-lactate + GTP = lactyl-2-diphospho-5'-guanosine + diphosphate.

name: phosphoribosylglycinamide formyltransferase 2 activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + formate + N1-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)glycinamide = ADP + H+ + N2-formyl-N1-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)glycinamide + phosphate.

name: phosphoserine-tRNA(Cys) ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tRNA(Cys) + O-phospho-L-serine + ATP = AMP + diphosphate + phosphoseryl-tRNA(Cys).

name: phosphosulfolactate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R)-O-phospho-3-sulfolactate = phosphoenolpyruvate + sulfite.

name: precorrin-3B synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADH + O2 + precorrin-3A = H2O + NAD+ + precorrin-3B.

name: precorrin-6A synthase (deacetylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + H2O + precorrin-5 = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + acetate + 2 H+ + precorrin-6X.

name: propionyl-CoA:succinate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: succinate + propionyl-CoA = succinyl-CoA + propionate.

name: ribonuclease M5 activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA, removing 21 and 42 nucleotides, respectively, from the 5'- and 3'-termini of a 5S-rRNA precursor.

name: spheroidene monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: spheroidene + O2 = spheroidenone + H2O.

name: succinylglutamate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-succinyl-L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + H2O + NAD+ = N-succinyl-L-glutamate + 2 H+ + NADH.

name: succinylornithine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(2)-succinyl-L-ornithine + 2-oxoglutarate = N-succinyl-L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + L-glutamate.

name: tRNA (adenine(57)-N1)/(adenine(58)-N1)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine57/adenosine58 in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N1-methyladenosine57/N1-methyladenosine58 in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA 2-selenouridine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridine + selenophosphate = 5-methylaminomethyl-2-selenouridine + phosphate (at the wobble position in tRNA).

name: tRNA-specific adenosine-37 deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine-37 + H2O = inosine-37 + NH4+, in a tRNA-Ala molecule.

name: thiosulfate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-decylubiquinone + 2 thiosulfate = 6-decylubiquinol + tetrathionate.

name: [methyl-Co(III) methylamine-specific corrinoid protein]:coenzyme M methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [methyl-Co(III) methylamine-specific corrinoid protein] + coenzyme M = [Co(I) methylamine-specific corrinoid protein] + H+ + methyl-coenzyme M. This reaction is the transfer of the methyl group from the methylated corrinoid cofactor of a methylamine corrinoid protein to coenzyme M.

name: trimethylamine methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Co(I)-[trimethylamine-specific corrinoid protein] + H+ + trimethylamine = dimethylamine + methyl-Co(III)-[trimethylamine-specific corrinoid protein].

name: xanthine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: xanthine + H2O = 4-ureido-5-imidazole carboxylate.

name: L-valine dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-valine + NAD+ + H2O = 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + NH4+ + NADH + H+.

name: phosphatidylethanolamine:Kdo2-lipid A phosphoethanolamine transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Kdo2-lipid A + phosphatidylethanolamine = phosphoethanolamine-Kdo2-lipid A + diacylglycerol.

name: lipid A phosphate methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group from S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) to the 1-phosphate group of lipid A.

name: Kdo transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: (KDO)-lipid IVA + CMP-3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonate = KDO2-lipid IVA + CMP, and lipid IVA + CMP-3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonate = (KDO)-lipid IVA + CMP.

name: ADP-specific glucokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ADP + D-glucose = AMP + D-glucose 6-phosphate.

name: ADP-specific phosphofructokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ADP + D-fructose 6-phosphate = AMP + D-fructose 1,6-bisphosphate.

name: Ras palmitoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: palmitoyl-CoA + protein-cysteine = S-palmitoyl protein + CoA, specific for Ras proteins.

name: monomethylamine methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Co(I)-[methylamine-specific corrinoid protein] + methylamine + H+ = methyl-Co(III)-[methylamine-specific corrinoid protein] + NH4+.

name: cyclic nucleotide-gated mechanosensitive monoatomic ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an monoatomic ion by a channel that opens in response to a mechanical stress and when a cyclic nucleotide has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: cyclic nucleotide-activated monoatomic ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a cyclic nucleotide has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: anti-sigma factor antagonist activity
definition: The function of binding to an anti-sigma factor and stopping, preventing or reducing the rate of its activity.

name: N-acetylornithine carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(2)-acetyl-L-ornithine + carbamoyl phosphate = N(2)-acetyl-L-citrulline + H+ + phosphate.

name: arginine:ornithine antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: arginine(out) + ornithine(in) = arginine(in) + ornithine(out).

name: cyanophycin synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the ATP-dependent polymerization of arginine and aspartate to multi-L-arginyl-poly-L-aspartic acid (cyanophycin; a water-insoluble reserve polymer).

name: agmatine:putrescine antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: agmatine(out) + putrescine(in) = agmatine(in) + putrescine(out).

name: arginine:agmatine antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: arginine(out) + agmatine(in) = arginine(in) + agmatine(out).

name: 4-hydroxy-2-ketopimelate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxy-2-ketopimelate = succinate semialdehyde + pyruvate.

name: indoleacetamide hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: iH2O + indole-3-acetamide = (indol-3-yl)acetate + NH4+. Indole-3-acetamide is known as IAM and indole-3-acetate as IAA.

name: methionine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of methionine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: adenylyl-sulfate reductase (thioredoxin) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AMP + sulfite + thioredoxin disulfide = 5'-adenylyl sulfate + thioredoxin.

name: 7-cyano-7-deazaguanine tRNA-ribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tRNA guanine + 7-cyano-7-deazaguanine = tRNA 7-cyano-7-deazaguanine + guanine.

name: N-acetyl-gamma-aminoadipyl-phosphate reductase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(2)-acetyl-L-aminoadipate-semialdehyde + NADP+ + phosphate = N(2)-acetyl-L-gamma-aminoadipyl phosphate + NADPH.

name: lysine:cadaverine antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: lysine(out) + cadaverine(in) = lysine(in) + cadaverine(out).

name: pyruvate-flavodoxin oxidoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyruvate + CoA + oxidized flavodoxin = acetyl-CoA + CO2 + reduced flavodoxin.

name: acireductone synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions:5-methylsulfanyl-2,3-dioxopentyl phosphate + H2O = 1,2-dihydroxy-5-(methylsulfanyl)pent-1-en-3-one + phosphate.

name: 2-ketobutyrate formate-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxobutanoate + coenzyme A = propionyl-CoA + formate.

name: D-threonine aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-threonine (or D-allo-threonine) = glycine + acetaldehyde.

name: galactosamine-6-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galactosamine 6-phosphate + H2O = D-tagatose 6-phosphate + NH4+.

name: glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (NAD+) (non-phosphorylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + NAD+ + H2O = 3-phospho-D-glycerate + NADH + H+.

name: glycolate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of glycolate from one side of a membrane to the other. Glycolate is the smallest alpha-hydroxy acid (AHA).

name: crotonyl-CoA reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: butanoyl-CoA + NADP+ = (2E)-butenoyl-CoA + NADPH + H+. (2E)-butenoyl-CoA is also called crotonyl-CoA.

name: mesaconyl-CoA hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydration of mesaconyl-CoA to beta-methylmalyl-CoA.

name: malate:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: malate(out) + Na+(out) = malate(in) + Na+(in).

name: malolactic enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate + H+ = (S)-lactate + CO2.

name: CO-methylating acetyl-CoA synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Co(I)-[corrinoid Fe-S protein] + acetyl-CoA + H+ = methyl-Co(III)-[corrinoid Fe-S protein] + CO + CoA.

name: anaerobic carbon-monoxide dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CO + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + H2O = 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + CO2 + 2 H+.

name: structural constituent of carboxysome shell
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a carboxysome shell, an organelle found in all cyanobacteria and some chemoautotrophs, consisting of a proteinaceous coat and enzymes for the fixation of CO2.

name: melibiose:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: melibiose(out) + Na+(out) = melibiose(in) + Na+(in).

name: N-acetylgalactosamine-6-sulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the 6-sulfate groups of the N-acetyl-D-galactosamine 6-sulfate units of chondroitin sulfate and of the D-galactose 6-sulfate units of keratan sulfate.

name: glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (phosphorylating, [NAD(P)+] ) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + phosphate + NAD(P)+ = 3-phospho-D-glyceroyl phosphate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: methylglyoxal reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: lactaldehyde + NADP+ = methylglyoxal + NADPH + H+.

name: acetate:monoatomic cation symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of acetate from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: acetate(out) + cation(out) = acetate(in) + cation(in).

name: acetyl-CoA synthetase acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the acetylation of a lysine of the enzyme acetyl-CoA ligase, using acetyl-CoA as substrate. In Bacillus subtilis, this is Lys609, but it may correspond to another position in orthologs. This acetylation results in inhibition of acetyl-CoA synthetase.

name: cyclomaltodextrin glucanotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cyclization of part of a 1,4-alpha-D-glucan chain by formation of a 1,4-alpha-D-glucosidic bond.

name: glucan 1,6-alpha-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in (1->6)-alpha-D-glucans and derived oligosaccharides.

name: glucan 1,4-alpha-maltohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->4)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in polysaccharides so as to remove successive alpha-maltose residues from the non-reducing ends of the chains.

name: 2,3-dihydroxybiphenyl 1,2-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-dihydroxybiphenyl + O2 = 2-hydroxy-6-phenylhexa-2,4-dienoic acid.

name: phosphoserine:homoserine phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphoryl group from phosphoserine to homoserine to form phosphohomoserine.

name: isochorismate pyruvate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isochorismate = salicylate + pyruvate.

name: L-seryl-tRNA(Thr) hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of misacylated Ser-tRNA(Thr).

name: Ala-tRNA(Pro) deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of misacylated Ala-tRNA(Pro).

name: Cys-tRNA(Pro) deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteinyl-tRNA(Pro) + H2O = tRNA(Pro) + L-cysteine + H+.

name: Ser(Gly)-tRNA(Ala) hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of misacylated Ser-tRNA(Ala) and Gly-tRNA(Ala).

name: N-acetylcitrulline deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-L-citrulline + H2O = citrulline + acetate.

name: ATP:coenzyme F420 adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + factor gamma-F420-2 + H+ = coenzyme F390-A + diphosphate.

name: D-lysine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-lysine + 2-oxoglutarate = 6-amino-2-oxohexanoate + L-glutamate.

name: NAD(P)H sulfur oxidoreductase (CoA-dependent) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydrogen sulfide + NAD(P)+ = sulfur + NAD(P)H.

name: L-seryl-tRNA(Sec) kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-seryl-tRNA(Sec) = ADP + O-phospho-L-seryl-tRNA(Sec).

name: DNA-7-methylguanine glycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: DNA containing 7-methylguanine + H2O = DNA with abasic site + 7-methylguanine. This reaction is the hydrolysis of DNA by cleavage of the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the damaged DNA 7-methylguanine and the deoxyribose sugar to remove the 7-methylguanine, leaving an abasic site.

name: ribose 1,5-bisphosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-ribose 1,5-bisphosphate = D-ribulose 1,5-bisphosphate.

name: cadaverine aminopropyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cadaverine + S-adenosyl 3-(methylsulfanyl)propylamine = aminopropylcadaverine + H+ + S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine.

name: agmatine aminopropyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: agmatine + S-adenosyl 3-(methylsulfanyl)propylamine = H+ + N1-(3-aminopropyl)agmatine + S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine.

name: aminopropylagmatine ureohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N1-aminopropylagmatine + H2O = spermidine + urea.

name: suramin binding
definition: Binding to suramin, a naphthalenesulfonic acid compound which is used in the treatment of diseases caused by trypanosomes and worms.

name: 3-hydroxypropionyl-CoA synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxypropionate + ATP + CoA = 3-hydroxypropionyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate.

name: 3-hydroxypropionyl-CoA dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxypropionyl-CoA = acryloyl-CoA + H2O.

name: acryloyl-CoA reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acryloyl-CoA + NADPH + H+ = propionyl-CoA + NADP+.

name: acryloyl-CoA reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: propanoyl-CoA + NAD+ = acryloyl-CoA + H+ + NADH.

name: L-erythro-3-methylmalyl-CoA lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R,3S)-beta-methylmalyl-CoA = glyoxylate + propanoyl-CoA.

name: succinyl-CoA:(R)-citramalate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: succinyl-CoA + (R)-citramalate = succinate + (R)-citramalyl-CoA.

name: histone H3K9 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H3 L-lysine (position 9) = CoA + histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 9).

name: histone H3K18 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H3 L-lysine (position 18) = CoA + histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 18).

name: histone H3K23 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H3 L-lysine (position 23) = CoA + histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 23).

name: histone H4K5 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H4 L-lysine (position 5) = CoA + histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 5).

name: histone H4K8 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H4 L-lysine (position 8) = CoA + histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 8).

name: histone H4K12 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H4 L-lysine (position 12) = CoA + histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 12).

name: histone H2A acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H2A L-lysine = CoA + histone H2A N6-acetyl-L-lysine.

name: histone H2AK5 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H2A L-lysine (position 5) = CoA + histone H2A N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 5).

name: histone H2AK9 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H2A L-lysine (position 9) = CoA + histone H2A N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 9).

name: histone H2B acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H2B L-lysine = CoA + histone H2B N6-acetyl-L-lysine.

name: histone H2BK5 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H2B L-lysine (position 5) = CoA + histone H2B N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 5).

name: histone H2BK12 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H2B L-lysine (position 12) = CoA + histone H2B N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 12).

name: histone H3K4 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H3 L-lysine (position 4) = CoA + histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 4).

name: histone H3K27 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H3 L-lysine (position 27) = CoA + histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 27).

name: histone H3K36 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H3 L-lysine (position 36) = CoA + histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 36).

name: histone H4R3 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + (histone H4)-arginine (position 3) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + (histone H4)-N-methyl-arginine (position 3). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the arginine residue at position 3 of histone H4, producing histone H4R3me.

name: histone H3S28 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3-serine (position 28) + ATP = histone H3-phosphoserine (position 28) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the serine residue at position 28 of histone H3.

name: histone H4S1 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4-serine (position 1) + ATP = histone H4-phosphoserine (position 1) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the serine residue at position 1 of histone H4.

name: histone H2AS1 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H2A-serine (position 1) + ATP = histone H2A-phosphoserine (position 1) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the serine residue at position 1 of histone H2A.

name: histone H2BS14 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H2B-serine (position 14) + ATP = histone H2B-phosphoserine (position 14) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the serine residue at position 14 of histone H2B.

name: (3R)-citramalyl-CoA lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3R)-citramalyl-CoA = pyruvate + acetyl-CoA.

name: purine deoxyribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of deoxyribose exchange between purine deoxyribonucleoside as a donor and purine base as an acceptor.

name: L-arabinose 1-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arabinose + NADP+ = L-arabinono-1,4-lactone + NADPH + H+.

name: 2,5-dioxovalerate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,5-dioxopentanoate + NAD+ + H2O = 2-oxoglutarate + NADH + 2 H+.

name: L-xylulose reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: xylitol + NAD+ = L-xylulose + NADH + H+.

name: protein folding chaperone
definition: Binding to a protein or a protein-containing complex to assist the protein folding process.

name: Rel homology domain binding
definition: Binding to a Rel Homology Domain (RHD) of a protein. The RHD is found in a family of eukaryotic transcription factors, which includes NF-kappaB, Dorsal, Relish and NFAT.

name: zf-TRAF domain binding
definition: Binding to a TRAF-type zinc finger domain of a protein.

name: retinoic acid-responsive element binding
definition: Binding to a retinoic acid-responsive element, a variable direct repeat of the sequence PuGGTCA spaced by five nucleotides (DR5) found in the promoters of retinoic acid-responsive genes, to which retinoic acid receptors bind.

name: transmembrane transporter binding
definition: Binding to a transmembrane transporter, a protein or protein complex that enables the transfer of a substance, usually a specific substance or a group of related substances, from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: cytokinin binding
definition: Binding to a cytokinin, any of a class of adenine-derived compounds that can function in plants as growth regulators.

name: sequence-specific DNA binding, bending
definition: The activity of binding selectively and non-covalently to DNA in a sequence-specific manner and distorting the original structure of DNA, typically a straight helix, into a bend, or increasing the bend if the original structure was intrinsically bent due to its sequence.

name: RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding, bending
definition: Binding to a specific upstream regulatory DNA sequence (transcription factor recognition sequence or binding site) located in cis relative to the transcription start site (i.e., on the same strand of DNA) of a gene transcribed by RNA polymerase II, and distorting the original structure of DNA, typically a straight helix, into a bend, or increasing the bend if the original structure was intrinsically bent due to its sequence.

name: non-sequence-specific DNA binding, bending
definition: The activity of binding selectively and non-covalently to DNA in a sequence-independent manner and distorting the original structure of DNA, typically a straight helix, into a bend, or increasing the bend if the original structure was intrinsically bent due to its sequence.

name: small protein activating enzyme binding
definition: Binding to a small protein activating enzyme, such as ubiquitin-activating enzyme.

name: ubiquitin-like protein ligase binding
definition: Binding to a ubiquitin-like protein ligase, such as ubiquitin-ligase.

name: ubiquitin-like protein conjugating enzyme binding
definition: Binding to a ubiquitin-like protein conjugating enzyme such as ubiquitin conjugating enzyme.

name: glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor activity
definition: Combining with glucagon-like peptide 1 and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein.

name: very-long-chain fatty acyl-CoA oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a very-long-chain 2,3-saturated fatty acyl-CoA + O2 = a very-long-chain (2E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O2.

name: L-cystine L-cysteine-lyase (deaminating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cystine + H2O = S-sulfanyl-L-cysteine + pyruvate + NH4+.

name: DNA topoisomerase binding
definition: Binding to a DNA topoisomerase.

name: S100 protein binding
definition: Binding to a S100 protein. S100 is a small calcium and zinc binding protein produced in astrocytes that is implicated in Alzheimer's disease, Down Syndrome and ALS.

name: GTP cyclohydrolase binding
definition: Binding to a GTP cyclohydrolase.

name: cellotriose binding
definition: Binding to cellotriose.

name: cellodextrin binding
definition: Binding to a cellodextrin, a glucose polymer of 2 or more glucose monomers.

name: cellobiose binding
definition: Binding to cellobiose, a disaccharide that represents the basic repeating unit of cellulose.

name: cellotetraose binding
definition: Binding to a cellotetraose, an oligosaccharide consisting of four glucose residues resulting from hydrolysis of cellulose.

name: cellopentaose binding
definition: Binding to a cellopentaose, an oligosaccharide consisting of four glucose residues resulting from hydrolysis of cellulose.

name: laminaribiose binding
definition: Binding to laminaribiose, a disaccharide.

name: pectin binding
definition: Binding to pectin.

name: iron-sulfur-molybdenum cofactor binding
definition: Binding to iron molybdenum cofactor, the cofactor located at the active site of the molybdenum nitrogenase.

name: 17-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 17-beta-hydroxysteroid + NAD+ = a 17-oxosteroid + NADH + H+.

name: protein guanylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + protein = diphosphate + guanylyl-protein; mediates the addition of an guanylyl (guanosine 5'-monophosphate; GMP group) to specific residues of target proteins.

name: protein adenylylhydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenylyl-protein+ H2O = adenylate + protein; mediates the removal of an adenylyl (adenosine 5'-monophosphate; AMP group) from specific residues of target proteins.

name: ABC-type phytochelatin transporter activity
definition: Enables the directed movement of a phytochelatin from one side of a membrane to the other. Phytochelatins are a group of peptides that bind metals (Cd, Zn, Cu, Pb, Hg) in thiolate coordination complexes.

name: phosphocholine transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CDP-choline + protein-serine = CMP + protein-serine-choline phosphate.

name: phosphocholine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein-serine-choline phosphate + H2O = protein-serine + choline phosphate.

name: FMN transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the directed movement of flavine mononucleotide (FMN) from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: ACP phosphopantetheine attachment site binding
definition: Binding to the attachment site of the phosphopantetheine prosthetic group of an acyl carrier protein (ACP).

name: (R)-carnitine:4-(trimethylammonio)butanoate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: (R)-carnitine(out) + 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoate(in) = (R)-carnitine(in) + 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoate(out).

name: sodium:malonate symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: sodium(out)+ malonate(out) = sodium(in) + malonate(in).

name: sodium:galactoside symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: sodium(out)+ galactoside(out) = sodium(in) + galactoside(in).

name: GTP cyclohydrolase IV activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + H2O = 7,8-dihydroneopterin 2',3'-cyclic phosphate + diphosphate + formate + H+. This activity is part of the biosynthesis of methanopterin in Archaea, and requires Fe2+.

name: methylthiol:coenzyme M methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the overall reaction: methyl-Co(III) methylated-thiol-specific corrinoid protein + coenzyme M = Co(I) methylated--thiol-specific corrinoid protein + methyl-CoM.

name: dihydromethanopterin reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + acceptor = 7,8-dihydromethanopterin + reduced acceptor.

name: cysteate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-phospho-L-serine + sulfite + H+ = L-cysteate + phosphate.

name: geranylfarnesyl diphosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E,10E)-geranylgeranyl diphosphate + isopentenyl diphosphate = (2E,6E,10E,14E)-geranylfarnesyl diphosphate + diphosphate.

name: 7,8-dihydro-D-neopterin 2',3'-cyclic phosphate phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7,8-dihydro-D-neopterin 2',3'-cyclic phosphate + H2O = 7,8-dihydroneopterin 3'-phosphate or 7,8-dihydroneopterin 2'-phosphate + H+.

name: 7,8-didemethyl-8-hydroxy-5-deazariboflavin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-amino-5-(4-hydroxybenzyl)-6-(D-ribitylimino)-5,6-dihydrouracil + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5'-deoxyadenosine + 7,8-didemethyl-8-hydroxy-5-deazariboflavin + H+ + L-methionine + NH4+.

name: exoribonuclease activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of an exoribonuclease.

name: trehalose:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: trehalose(out) + H+(out) = trehalose(in) + H+(in).

name: 8-oxo-dGDP phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction 8-oxo-dGDP + H2O = 8-oxo-dGMP + phosphate.

name: 8-oxo-GDP phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction 8-oxo-GDP + H2O = 8-oxo-GMP + phosphate.

name: 8-hydroxy-dADP phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 8-hydroxy-dADP + H2O = 8-hydroxy-dAMP + phosphate.

name: hemi-methylated DNA-binding
definition: Binding to double-stranded hemi-methylated DNA at replication foci (one strand methylated, while the other strand is unmethylated). Methylation of cytosine or adenine in DNA is an important mechanism for establishing stable heritable epigenetic marks.

name: bone sialoprotein binding
definition: Binding to a bone sialoprotein, an extracellular matrix glycoprotein found on the surface of bones and dentin.

name: 3'-5'-exoribonuclease activity involved in mature miRNA 3'-end processing
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 3' terminus of an RNA molecule that contributes to forming distinct miRNA isoforms from a mature miRNA.

name: high-affinity nickel cation transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the high-affinity transfer of nickel (Ni) cations from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations.

name: ATPase activity, coupled to transmembrane movement of ions, rotational mechanism
definition: Enables the transfer of ions from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + ion(in) = ADP + phosphate + ion(out), by a rotational mechanism.

name: retroviral integrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the covalent insertion of double-stranded retroviral DNA into host DNA. Proceeds by an endonucleolytic cleavage at each 3'-OH extremity of the viral genome, named 3'-processing, followed by a strand transfer reaction leading to the insertion of the processed viral DNA into the target DNA by a trans-esterification mechanism.

name: retroviral 3' processing activity
definition: The catalysis of the removal of two di- or tri-nucleotides from each 3' end of double-stranded viral DNA, exposing recessed 3' hydroxyls.

name: gamma-glutamyl hercynylcysteine sulfoxide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: gamma-glutamyl cysteine + hercynine + O2 = gamma-glutamyl-hercynyl cysteine sulfoxide + H2O.

name: protein-containing complex binding
definition: Binding to a macromolecular complex.

name: DNA end binding
definition: Binding to DNA ends exposed by the creation of double-strand breaks (DSBs).

name: G protein-coupled purinergic nucleotide receptor activity
definition: Combining with a purine nucleotide and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: G protein-coupled UDP receptor activity
definition: Combining with a nucleotide and transmitting the signal to a heterotrimeric G-protein complex to initiate a change in cell activity, activated by UDP.

name: G protein-coupled UTP receptor activity
definition: Combining with a nucleotide and transmitting the signal to a heterotrimeric G-protein complex to initiate a change in cell activity, activated by UTP.

name: G protein-coupled ATP receptor activity
definition: Combining with ATP and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: azole:proton antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: H+(out) + azole(in) = H+(in) + azole(out). Azoles are heterocyclic compounds found in many biologically important substances.

name: bioactive lipid receptor activity
definition: Combining with a bioactive lipid and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex. A bioactive lipid is a lipid for which changes in lipid levels result in functional consequences in a variety of cellular processes.

name: N-acetylglucosamine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + ATP = N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: keratan sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + keratan = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + keratan 6'-sulfate.

name: pre-mRNA branch point binding
definition: Binding to a pre-mRNA branch point sequence, located upstream of the 3' splice site.

name: 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate 3,4-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate + O2 = 2-hydroxy-3-(3-oxoprop-1-enyl)but-2-enedioate + H+.

name: UDP phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP + H2O = UMP + phosphate.

name: poly(beta-D-mannuronate) lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: polysaccharides containing beta-D-mannuronate residues = oligosaccharides with 4-deoxy-alpha-L-erythro-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl end. This reaction is the eliminative cleavage of polysaccharides containing beta-D-mannuronate residues to give oligosaccharides with 4-deoxy-alpha-L-erythro-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl groups at their ends.

name: inositol phosphoceramide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phytoceramide + inositol phosphate = inositol phosphoceramide + diacylglycerol.

name: triplex DNA binding
definition: Binding to a DNA triple helix. The formation of triple helical DNA has been evoked in several cellular processes including transcription, replication, and recombination.

name: single-stranded DNA 5'-3' DNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of nucleotides (such as mononucleotides or dinucleotides) from a free 5' terminus of a single-stranded DNA molecule.

name: tripeptide aminopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a single N-terminal amino acid residue from a tripeptide.

name: antisigma factor binding
definition: Binding to an antisigma factor, a factor which inhibits the ability of the sigma factor to function as a transcriptional initiator.

name: myosin II binding
definition: Binding to a class II myosin, any member of the class of 'conventional' double-headed myosins that includes muscle myosin.

name: glutathione dehydrogenase (ascorbate) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dehydroascorbate + 2 glutathione = L-ascorbate + glutathione disulfide.

name: translation regulator activity
definition: Any molecular function involved in the regulation of initiation, activation, perpetuation, repression or termination of polypeptide synthesis at the ribosome.

name: translation factor activity, non-nucleic acid binding
definition: A translation regulator activity that does not involve binding to nucleic acids.

name: CXCR chemokine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a chemokine receptor in the CXCR family.

name: CXCR1 chemokine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a CXCR1 chemokine receptor.

name: CXCR2 chemokine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a CXCR2 chemokine receptor.

name: luciferin monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the generalized reaction: luciferin + O2 = oxidized luciferin + CO2 + light. There may be additional substrates and reactants involved in the reaction. The reaction results in light emission as luciferin returns to the ground state after enzymatic oxidation.

name: D-arabinose 1-dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-arabinose + NAD(P)+ = D-arabinono-1,4-lactone + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: alpha-catenin binding
definition: Binding to catenin complex alpha subunit.

name: gamma-catenin binding
definition: Binding to catenin complex gamma subunit.

name: cadherin binding
definition: Binding to cadherin, a type I membrane protein involved in cell adhesion.

name: stearoyl-[ACP] desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 H+ + O2 + octadecanoyl-[ACP] + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] = (9Z)-octadecenoyl-[ACP] + 2 H2O + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin].

name: tRNA 2-(methylsulfanyl)-N(6)-isopentenyladenosine(37) hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-methylsulfanyl-N(6)-dimethylallyladenosine(37) in tRNA + acceptor-H2 + O2 = N(6)-[(2E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl]-2-(methylsulfanyl)adenosine(37) in tRNA + acceptor + H2O.

name: choloylglycine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-alpha,7-alpha,12-alpha-trihydroxy-5-beta-cholan-24-oylglycine + H2O = 3-alpha,7-alpha,12-alpha-trihydroxy-5-beta-cholanate + glycine.

name: L-2,4-diaminobutyrate:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-2,4-diaminobutanoate + 2-oxoglutarate = L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + L-glutamate.

name: protein phosphorylated amino acid binding
definition: Binding to a phosphorylated amino acid residue within a protein.

name: unmethylated CpG binding
definition: Binding to uan nmethylated CpG motif. Unmethylated CpG dinucleotides are often associated with gene promoters.

name: mercury ion binding
definition: Binding to a mercury ion (Hg2+).

name: interleukin-1 type I receptor antagonist activity
definition: Blocks the binding of interleukin-1 to interleukin-1 type I receptors.

name: interleukin-1 type II receptor antagonist activity
definition: Blocks the binding of interleukin-1 to interleukin-1 type II receptors.

name: chalcone isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a chalcone = a flavanone.

name: flavonol synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a dihydroflavonol + 2-oxoglurate + O2 = a flavonol + succinate + CO2 + H2O.

name: lycopene epsilon cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cyclization of an epsilon ring at one end of the lycopene molecule (psi, psi-carotene) to form delta-carotene (epsilon, psi-carotene).

name: lycopene beta cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cyclization of beta rings at one or both ends of the lycopene molecule (psi, psi-carotene) to form gamma-carotene or the bicyclic beta-carotene (beta, beta-carotene), respectively.

name: uridine nucleosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + uridine = ribofuranose + uracil.

name: isopenicillin-N epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isopenicillin N = penicillin N.

name: deacetoxycephalosporin-C hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + deacetoxycephalosporin C + O2 = CO2 + deacetylcephalosporin C + succinate.

name: trichothecene 3-O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the 3-O-acetylation of a trichothecene. Trichothecenes are sesquiterpene epoxide mycotoxins that act as potent inhibitors of eukaryotic protein synthesis.

name: galactose oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galactose + O2 = D-galacto-hexodialdose + H2O2.

name: 6-endo-hydroxycineole dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-endo-hydroxycineole + NAD+ = 6-oxocineole + H+ + NADH.

name: trichodiene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate = diphosphate + trichodiene.

name: aristolochene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans,trans-farnesyl diphosphate = aristolochene + diphosphate.

name: L-lysine:2-oxoglutarate 6-transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + L-lysine = L-glutamate + allysine.

name: omega-6 fatty acid desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the introduction of an omega-6 double bond into the fatty acid hydrocarbon chain.

name: flavanone 3-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + a (2S)-flavan-4-one + O2 = a (2R,3R)-dihydroflavonol + CO2 + succinate.

name: chemorepellent activity
definition: Providing the environmental signal that initiates the directed movement of a motile cell or organism towards a lower concentration of that signal.

name: dynein light chain binding
definition: Binding to a light chain of the dynein complex.

name: dynein heavy chain binding
definition: Binding to a heavy chain of the dynein complex.

name: dynein intermediate chain binding
definition: Binding to an intermediate chain of the dynein complex.

name: interleukin-24 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-24 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-25 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-25 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-26 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-26 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-27 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-27 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-24 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-24.

name: interleukin-25 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-25.

name: interleukin-26 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-26.

name: interleukin-27 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-27.

name: interleukin-16 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-16 receptor.

name: interleukin-18 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-18 receptor.

name: interleukin-19 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-19 receptor.

name: interleukin-20 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-20 receptor.

name: interleukin-22 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-22 receptor.

name: interleukin-23 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-23 receptor.

name: interleukin-24 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-24 receptor.

name: interleukin-25 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-25 receptor.

name: interleukin-26 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-26 receptor.

name: interleukin-27 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-27 receptor.

name: gibberellin 2-beta-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a gibberellin + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = a 2-beta-hydroxygibberellin + succinate + CO2.

name: gibberellin 20-oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 2-oxoglutarate + gibberellin A12 (GA12) + H+ + 3 O2 = 3 CO2 + gibberellin A9 (GA9) + 2 H2O + 2 succinate. This reaction results in the oxidation of C-20 gibberellins to form the corresponding C-19 lactones, via a three-step oxidation at C-20 of the GA skeleton. Also converts GA53 to GA20. GA25 is also formed as a minor product.

name: syndecan binding
definition: Binding to syndecan, an integral membrane proteoglycan (250-300 kDa) associated largely with epithelial cells.

name: ditrans,polycis-polyprenyl diphosphate synthase [(2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate specific] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate + n isopentenyl diphosphate = a di-trans,poly-cis-polyprenyl diphosphate + n diphosphate.

name: phenylalanine ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine = NH4 + trans-cinnamate.

name: 9-cis-epoxycarotenoid dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: a 9-cis-epoxycarotenoid + O2 = 2-cis,4-trans-xanthoxin + a 12'-apo-carotenal; 9-cis-violaxanthin + O2 = 2-cis,4-trans-xanthoxin + (3S,5R,6S)-5,6-epoxy-3-hydroxy-5,6-dihydro-12'-apo-beta-caroten-12'-al; and 9'-cis-neoxanthin + O2 = 2-cis,4-trans-xanthoxin + (3S,5R,6R)-5,6-dihydroxy-6,7-didehydro-5,6-dihydro-12'-apo-beta-caroten-12'-al.

name: cinnamyl-alcohol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cinnamyl alcohol + NADP+ = cinnamaldehyde + NADPH + H+. Also acts on coniferyl alcohol, sinapyl alcohol and 4-coumaryl alcohol.

name: dihydroflavanol 4-reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a (2R,3S,4S)-leucoanthocyanidin + NADP+ = a (2R,3R)-dihydroflavonol + NADPH + H+.

name: TRAIL binding
definition: Binding to TRAIL (TNF-related apoptosis inducing ligand), a member of the tumor necrosis factor ligand family that rapidly induces apoptosis in a variety of transformed cell lines.

name: ketoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reduction of a ketone group to form the corresponding alcohol.

name: nutrient reservoir activity
definition: Functions in the storage of nutritious substrates.

name: precorrin-6Y C5,15-methyltransferase (decarboxylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine + precorrin-6Y = 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + precorrin-8X + CO2.

name: precorrin-4 C11-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + precorrin-4 = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + precorrin 5.

name: phospholipid:diacylglycerol acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a glycerophospholipid + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol = a monoacylglycerophospholipid + a triacyl-sn-glycerol.

name: mannitol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannitol + NAD+ = D-mannose + H+ + NADH.

name: inositol trisphosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: myo-inositol trisphosphate + H2O = myo-inositol bisphosphate + phosphate.

name: gluconokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-gluconate + ATP = 6-phospho-D-gluconate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: SMAD binding
definition: Binding to a SMAD signaling protein.

name: aminoglycoside 3-N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-deoxystreptamine antibiotic + acetyl-CoA = an N(3)-acetyl-2-deoxystreptamine antibiotic + CoA + H+.

name: polynucleotide 3'-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3'end (2'-deoxyribonucleotide 3'-phosphate)-DNA + H2O = a 3'-end 2'-deoxyribonucleotide-DNA + phosphate.

name: ATP-dependent polydeoxyribonucleotide 5'-hydroxyl-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + 5'-dephospho-DNA = ADP + 5'-phospho-DNA.

name: glycerol dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycerol = 3-hydroxypropanal + H2O.

name: magnesium protoporphyrin IX methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Mg-protoporphyrin IX + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = Mg-protoporphyrin IX 13-monomethyl ester + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: chlorophyll synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chlorophyllide a + phytyl diphosphate + 2 H+ = chlorophyll a + diphosphate.

name: p-coumarate 3-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: shikimate or quinate ester of p-coumaric acid + NADPH + H+ + O2 = caffeic acid conjugate (caffeoyl shikimic acid or chlorogenic acid) + H2O + NADP+.

name: methylisocitrate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2S,3R)-3-hydroxybutane-1,2,3-tricarboxylate = pyruvate + succinate.

name: violaxanthin de-epoxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: violaxanthin + 2 ascorbate = zeaxanthin + 2 dehydroascorbate + 2 H2O; and antheraxanthin + ascorbate = zeaxanthin + dehydroascorbate + H2O.

name: allene-oxide cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (9Z,13S,15Z)-12,13-epoxyoctadeca-9,11,15-trienoate = (15Z)-12-oxophyto-10,15-dienoate.

name: ferulate 5-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ferulic acid + NADPH + H+ + O2 = 5-hydroxyferulic acid + H2O + NADP+.

name: 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoate polyprenyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoate + an all-trans-polyprenyl diphosphate + H+ = a 2-demethylmenaquinol + CO2 + diphosphate.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl diphosphate synthase activity (ferredoxin)
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl diphosphate + H2O + 2 oxidized ferredoxin = 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclodiphosphate + 2 reduced ferredoxin.

name: galactolipid galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 mono-beta-D-galactosyldiacylglycerol = alpha-D-galactosyl-beta-D-galactosyldiacylglycerol + 1,2-diacylglycerol.

name: digalactosyldiacylglycerol synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-diacyl-3-beta-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol + UDP-D-galactose = 3-[alpha-D-galactosyl-(1->6)-beta-D-galactosyl]-1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + H+ + UDP.

name: UDPsulfoquinovose synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sulfite + UDP-D-glucose = H2O + UDP-6-sulfoquinovose.

name: hydrolase activity, acting on carbon-sulfur bonds
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of any carbon-sulfur bond, C-S.

name: 1,2-diacylglycerol 3-beta-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + UDP-D-galactose = 1,2-diacyl-3-beta-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol + H+ + UDP.

name: UDP-sulfoquinovose:DAG sulfoquinovosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-sulfoquinovose + 1,2-diacylglycerol = sulfoquinovosyldiacylglycerol + UDP.

name: S-methyl-5-thioribose kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-methyl-5-thio-D-ribose + ATP = S-methyl-5-thio-alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: S-methyl-5-thioribose-1-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-methyl-5-thio-alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate = S-methyl-5-thio-D-ribulose 1-phosphate.

name: sucrose-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + D-fructose 6-phosphate = UDP + sucrose 6-phosphate.

name: xylosylprotein 4-beta-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + O-beta-D-xylosylprotein = UDP + 4-beta-D-galactosyl-O-beta-D-xylosylprotein.

name: D-xylulose reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + xylitol = D-xylulose + H+ + NADH.

name: glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a glucosyl group to an acceptor molecule, typically another carbohydrate or a lipid.

name: histamine N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + histamine = N(tau)-methylhistamine + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

name: trans-aconitate 3-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + trans-aconitate = (E)-2-(methoxycarbonylmethyl)but-2-enedioate + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: D-malate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-malate + NAD+ = CO2 + NADH + pyruvate.

name: L-malate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate + NADP+ = oxaloacetate + NADPH + H+.

name: acetylxylan esterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the deacetylation of xylans and xylo-oligosaccharides.

name: alpha-L-arabinofuranosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing alpha-L-arabinofuranoside residues in alpha-L-arabinosides.

name: glucan endo-1,6-beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the random hydrolysis of (1->6) linkages in (1->6)-beta-D-glucans.

name: arabinan endo-1,5-alpha-L-arabinosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->5)-alpha-arabinofuranosidic linkages in (1->5) arabinans.

name: alpha-glucuronidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alpha-D-glucuronoside + H2O = an alcohol + D-glucuronate.

name: beta-D-glucose oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-D-glucose + O2 = D-glucono-1,5-lactone + H2O2.

name: oxalate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + oxalate = CO2 + formate.

name: 3-dehydroshikimate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-dehydroshikimate = 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + H2O. 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate is also known as protocatechuate.

name: aphidicolan-16 beta-ol synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 9-alpha-copalyl diphosphate + H2O = aphidicolan-16-beta-ol + diphosphate.

name: 3-methylbutanal reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methylbutanol + NAD(P)+ = 3-methylbutanal + NAD(P)H + H+. 3-methylbutanal is also known as isovaleraldehyde.

name: glyoxal oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glyoxal + O2 + H2O = glyoxalate + H2O2.

name: methylthioribulose 1-phosphate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-methyl-5-thio-D-ribulose 1-phosphate = 5-(methylthio)-2,3-dioxopentyl phosphate + H2O.

name: versicolorin B synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2S-3S)-versiconal hemiacetal = versicolorin B + H2O.

name: lactonohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of lactone rings (intramolecular cyclic esters) to produce a hydroxyl group and a carboxyl group.

name: glucuronidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of glucuronosides, yielding free glucuronic acid.

name: rhamnogalacturonan acetylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of acetylesters (as acetate) from galacturonic acid residues in the backbone of rhamnogalacturonan.

name: rhamnogalacturonan alpha-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1->4)-alpha-D-galactopyranosyluronide lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of rhamnogalacturonan, generating oligosaccharides of the form alpha-D-us-galacturonic acid-(1,2)-alpha-L-rhamnose-(1,4)-alpha-D-galacturonate-(1,2)-L-rhamnose-(1,2)-alpha-L-rhamnose-p-(1,4)-alpha-D-galacturonic acid, terminating at the non-reducing end with a hex-4-enopyranosyluronic acid residue.

name: long-chain-alcohol oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 long-chain alcohol + O2 = 2 long-chain aldehyde + 2 H2O.

name: monoatomic cation efflux transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a cation or cations from the inside of the cell to the outside of the cell across a membrane.

name: ribonuclease T1 activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage to nucleoside 3'-phosphates and 3'-phosphooligonucleotides ending in Gp with 2',3'-cyclic phosphate intermediates.

name: polyamine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the oxidative degradation or interconversion of polyamines.

name: mandelonitrile lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: mandelonitrile = cyanide + benzaldehyde.

name: carotenoid isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the isomerization of poly-cis-carotenoids to all-trans-carotenoids.

name: sphingolipid floppase activity
definition: Catalysis of the movement of a sphingolipid from the cytosolic to the exoplasmic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP.

name: sphingolipid intramembrane carrier activity
definition: Enables the directed movement of sphingolipids into, out of or within a cell, or between cells. Sphingolipids are a class of lipids containing the long-chain amine diol sphingosine or a closely related base (a sphingoid).

name: sphingolipid binding
definition: Binding to a sphingolipid, a class of lipids containing the long-chain amine diol sphingosine or a closely related base (a sphingoid).

name: digestive hormone activity
definition: The action characteristic of a hormone that takes part in the digestion process.

name: galactoside 6-L-fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an L-fucosyl group from GDP-beta-L-fucose to a galactoside acceptor molecule, usually an N-glycan, to form an alpha(1,6)-fucosylated galactoside.

name: natural killer cell lectin-like receptor binding
definition: Binding to a lectin-like natural killer cell receptor.

name: borate binding
definition: Binding to borate, the anion (BO3)3-.

name: host cell surface receptor binding
definition: Binding to a receptor on the host cell surface.

name: virion binding
definition: Binding to a virion, either by binding to components of the capsid or the viral envelope.

name: host cell extracellular matrix binding
definition: Binding to the extracellular matrix of a host cell.

name: histone deacetylase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of histone deacetylase, which catalyzes of the removal of acetyl groups from histones, proteins complexed to DNA in chromatin and chromosomes.

name: host cell surface binding
definition: Binding to the surface of a host cell.

name: chemokine receptor antagonist activity
definition: Interacts with chemokine receptors to reduce the action of a chemokine.

name: aminodeoxychorismate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamine + chorismate = 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate + L-glutamate. It is composed of two enzymatic activities (which may be present on one or two polypeptides); the first is a glutaminase which yields ammonia from glutamine, releasing glutamate. The ammonia is used by the second activity which catalyzes the amination of chorismate to form 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate.

name: hydroxyapatite binding
definition: Binding to hydroxyapatite, the calcium phosphate mineral of formula Ca10(PO4)6(OH)2 found both in rocks of nonorganic origin and as a component of bone and dentin.

name: oxidoreductase activity, acting on other nitrogenous compounds as donors, with NAD or NADP as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a nitrogenous group, excluding NH and NH2 groups, acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces NAD or NADP.

name: ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase activator activity
definition: Binds to and iincreases the activity of rubisco by the removal of otherwise inhibitory sugar phosphates: RuBP, and in some plants, 2-carboxyarabinitol 1-phosphate.

name: cadmium ion binding
definition: Binding to a cadmium ion (Cd).

name: N-acetylgalactosamine binding
definition: Binding to N-acetylgalactosamine, 2-acetamido-2-deoxygalactopyranose, the n-acetyl derivative of galactosamine.

name: metal ion binding
definition: Binding to a metal ion.

name: metal ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of metal ions from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: ephrin receptor binding
definition: Binding to an ephrin receptor.

name: 3,4-didehydroretinal binding
definition: Binding to 3,4-didehydroretinal, a form of retinal that plays a role in the visual process in freshwater fish and some amphibians analogous to that of all-trans retinal in other vertebrates. 3,4-didehydro-11-cis-retinal combines with an opsin to form cyanopsin (cone) or porphyropsin (rod).

name: nucleoside triphosphate adenylate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + AMP = nucleoside diphosphate + ADP.

name: calcium oxalate binding
definition: Binding to calcium oxalate, CaC2O4, a salt of oxalic acid. In animals, it may be excreted in urine or retained in the form of urinary calculi.

name: 15-cis-phytoene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 geranylgeranyl diphosphate = 15-cis-phytoene + 2 diphosphate.

name: tetrapyrrole binding
definition: Binding to a tetrapyrrole, a compound containing four pyrrole nuclei variously substituted and linked to each other through carbons at the alpha position.

name: pectinesterase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of pectinesterase.

name: metal chelating activity
definition: The formation of bonds from two or more atoms within the same ligand to a metal atom in complexes in which the metal is part of a ring.

name: acyltransferase activity, acyl groups converted into alkyl on transfer
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an acyl group from one compound (donor) to another (acceptor), with the acyl group being converted into alkyl on transfer.

name: transition metal ion binding
definition: Binding to a transition metal ions; a transition metal is an element whose atom has an incomplete d-subshell of extranuclear electrons, or which gives rise to a cation or cations with an incomplete d-subshell. Transition metals often have more than one valency state. Biologically relevant transition metals include vanadium, manganese, iron, copper, cobalt, nickel, molybdenum and silver.

name: transition metal ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of transition metal ions from one side of a membrane to the other. A transition metal is an element whose atom has an incomplete d-subshell of extranuclear electrons, or which gives rise to a cation or cations with an incomplete d-subshell. Transition metals often have more than one valency state. Biologically relevant transition metals include vanadium, manganese, iron, copper, cobalt, nickel, molybdenum and silver.

name: triphosphoribosyl-dephospho-CoA synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + 3-dephospho-CoA = 2'-(5''-triphosphoribosyl)-3'-dephospho-CoA + adenine.

name: pyruvyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a pyruvyl (oxopropanoyl) group from one compound to another.

name: alpha-(1->3)-fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an L-fucosyl group from GDP-beta-L-fucose to an acceptor molecule to form an alpha-(1->3) linkage.

name: alpha-(1->6)-fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an L-fucosyl group from GDP-beta-L-fucose to an acceptor molecule to form an alpha-(1->6) linkage.

name: peptide-O-fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an alpha-L-fucosyl residue from GDP-beta-L-fucose to the serine hydroxy group of a protein acceptor.

name: ER lumen protein retrieval receptor activity
definition: Binding to an endoplasmic reticulum (ER) retention sequence, a short stretch of amino acids found in a protein that acts as a signal to retain the protein within the ER.

name: sodium-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other by a rotational mechanism according to the reaction: 4 Na+(out) + ADP + phosphate + H+ => 4 Na+(in) + ATP + H2O.

name: proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism
definition: Enables the synthesis of ATP from ADP and phosphate by the transfer of protons from one side of a membrane to the other by a rotational mechanism driven by a gradient according to the reaction: ADP + phosphate + 5 H+(out) => ATP + H2O + 4 H+(in).

name: 1-phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4,5-bisphosphate + ATP = a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 3,4,5-trisphosphate + ADP + H+.

name: 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase regulator activity
definition: Modulates the activity of the enzyme 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase activity.

name: 2'-deoxyadenosine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-deoxyadenosine + H+ + H2O = 2'-deoxyinosine + NH4+.

name: azetidine-2-carboxylic acid acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-azetidine-2-carboxylic acid + acetyl-CoA = CoA-SH + N-acetyl azetidine-2-carboxylic acid.

name: carboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of carboxylic acids from one side of a membrane to the other. Carboxylic acids are organic acids containing one or more carboxyl (COOH) groups or anions (COO-).

name: proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism
definition: Enables the transfer of protons from one side of a membrane to the other by a rotational mechanism according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + 4 H+(in) => ADP + phosphate + 5 H+(out).

name: sodium-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other by a rotational mechanism according to the reaction: 4 Na+(in) + ATP + H2O => 4 Na+(out) + ADP + phosphate + H+.

name: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate, a naturally occurring mixed anhydride synthesized from adenosine 5'-phosphosulfate, from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: nuclear retinoid X receptor binding
definition: Binding to a nuclear retinoid X receptor.

name: nuclear thyroid hormone receptor binding
definition: Binding to a nuclear thyroid hormone receptor.

name: histone H3K9 deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 9) + NAD+ + H2O = histone H3 L-lysine (position 9) + 2''-O-acetyl-ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide. This reaction transfers an acetyl group attached to a lysine residue in H3K9 to NAD, producing nicotinamide.

name: histone H4K16 deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 16) + NAD+ + H2O = histone H4 L-lysine (position 16) + 2''-O-acetyl-ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide. This reaction transfers an acetyl group attached to a lysine residue in H4K16 to NAD, producing nicotinamide.

name: histone H4K16 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H4 L-lysine (position 16) = CoA + histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 16). This reaction represents the addition of an acetyl group to the lysine at position 16 of histone H4.

name: histone H3K9 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H3 L-lysine (position 9) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H3 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 9). This reaction is the addition of up to three methyl groups to the lysine residue at position 9 of the histone H3 protein.

name: histone H3K36 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H3 L-lysine (position 36) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H3 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 36). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the lysine residue at position 36 of the histone H3 protein.

name: histone H3K27 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H3 L-lysine (position 27) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H3 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 27). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the lysine residue at position 27 of the histone H3 protein.

name: TAP binding
definition: Binding to TAP protein, transporter associated with antigen processing protein. TAP protein is a heterodimeric peptide transporter consisting of the subunits TAP1 and TAP2.

name: TAP1 binding
definition: Binding to the TAP1 subunit of TAP (transporter associated with antigen processing) protein.

name: TAP2 binding
definition: Binding to the TAP2 subunit of TAP (transporter associated with antigen processing) protein.

name: tapasin binding
definition: Binding to tapasin, a member of the MHC class I loading complex which bridges the TAP peptide transporter to class I molecules.

name: beta-1,4-mannosylglycolipid beta-1,3-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of N-acetylglucosamine (GlcNAc) in a beta-1,3 linkage to the mannose(beta-1,4)Glc disaccharide core of glycolipids.

name: protein heterodimerization activity
definition: Binding to a nonidentical protein to form a heterodimer.

name: protein dimerization activity
definition: The formation of a protein dimer, a macromolecular structure consists of two noncovalently associated identical or nonidentical subunits.

name: N-acetyllactosamine beta-1,3-glucuronosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer, in a beta 1,3 linkage, of D-glucuronic acid (GlcUA) from UDP-D-glucuronic acid to N-acetyllactosamine (galactosyl beta-1,4-N-acetylglucosamine).

name: asioloorosomucoid beta-1,3-glucuronosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer, in a beta 1,3 linkage, of D-glucuronic acid (GlcUA) from UDP-GlcUA to asioloorosomucoid.
