definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycine + NAD+ + H2O = glyoxylate + NH4+ + NADH + H+.

name: glycine N-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + glycine = CoA + N-acylglycine.

name: glycine N-benzoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzoyl-CoA + glycine = N-benzoylglycine + CoA + H+.

name: glycine N-choloyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: choloyl-CoA + glycine = CoA + glycocholate.

name: glyoxylate reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycolate + NAD+ = glyoxylate + NADH.

name: glycoprotein O-fatty-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: palmitoyl-CoA + mucus glycoprotein = CoA + O-palmitoylglycoprotein.

name: glycosulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose 6-sulfate + H2O = D-glucose + H+ + sulfate.

name: glycyrrhizinate beta-glucuronidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycyrrhizate + H2O = 2-(beta-D-glucuronosyl)-D-glucuronate + glycyrrhetinate.

name: glyoxylate dehydrogenase (acylating, NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CoA + glyoxylate + NADP+ = H+ + NADPH + oxalyl-CoA.

name: glyoxylate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glyoxylate + H2O + O2 = H2O2 + H+ + oxalate.

name: guanidinoacetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanidinoacetate + H2O = glycine + urea.

name: guanidinobutyrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-guanidinobutanoate + H2O = 4-aminobutanoate + urea.

name: guanidinopropionase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-guanidinopropanoate + H2O = beta-alanine + urea.

name: guanidinoacetate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + guanidinoacetate = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphoguanidinoacetate.

name: guanosine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine + H2O + H+ = xanthosine + NH4+.

name: guanosine phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine + phosphate = alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate + guanine.

name: hamamelose kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-hamamelose + ATP = D-hamamelose 2'-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: hepoxilin-epoxide hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (5Z,9E,14Z)-(8x,11R,12S)-11,12-epoxy-8-hydroxyicosa-5,9,14-trienoate + H2O = (5Z,9E,14Z)-(8x,11x,12S)-8,11,12-trihydroxyicosa-5,9,14-trienoate.

name: hexadecanol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hexadecanol + NAD+ = hexadecanal + NADH.

name: hexose oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hexose + O2 = aldono-1,5-lactone + H202.

name: hippurate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-benzoylglycine + H2O = benzoate + glycine.

name: L-histidine N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-histidine + acetyl-CoA = N(alpha)-acetyl-L-histidine + CoA + H+.

name: homocysteine desulfhydrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-homocysteine + H2O = 2-oxobutanoate + hydrogen sulfide + NH4+ + H+.

name: homoglutathione synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-alanine + L-gamma-glutamyl-L-cysteine + ATP = gamma-L-glutamyl-L-cysteinyl-beta-alanine + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: hydrogen dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2 + NAD+ = H+ + NADH.

name: hydrogen-sulfide S-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + S(2-) = CoA + thioacetate.

name: hydroxyacid-oxoacid transhydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-hydroxybutanoate + 2-oxoglutarate = acetoacetate + (R)-2-hydroxyglutarate.

name: hydroxybutyrate-dimer hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-3-[(R)-3-hydroxybutanoyloxy]butanoate + H2O = 2 (R)-3-hydroxybutanoate + H+.

name: hydroxyglutamate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxy-L-glutamate + H+ = 4-amino-3-hydroxybutanoate + CO2.

name: hydroxylamine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydroxylamine + O2 = H2O + H+ + nitrite.

name: hydroxylysine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: erythro-5-hydroxy-L-lysine + GTP = 5-phosphonooxy-L-lysine + GDP + 2 H+.

name: hydroxymalonate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydroxymalonate + NAD+ = H+ + NADH + oxomalonate.

name: hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA + H2O = 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutarate + CoA + H+.

name: (2R)-hydroxyphenylpyruvate reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R)-2-hydroxy-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate + NAD(P)+ = 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: (2S)-2-hydroxyphytanate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2S)-2-hydroxyphytanate + O2 = 2-oxophytanate + H2O2.

name: hydroxypyruvate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxypyruvate + H+ = CO2 + glycolaldehyde.

name: hyoscyamine (6S)-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + L-hyoscyamine + O2 = (6S)-6-hydroxyhyoscyamine + CO2 + succinate.

name: hyponitrite reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 hydroxylamine + 2 NAD+ = 2 H+ + hyponitrous acid + 2 NADH.

name: isoflavone 3'-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: formononetin + NADPH + O2 = calycosin + NADP+ + H2O.

name: erythrose-4-phosphate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-erythrose 4-phosphate + H2O + NAD+ = 4-phospho-D-erythronate + 2 H+ + NADH.

name: receptor ligand activity
definition: The activity of a gene product that interacts with a receptor to effect a change in the activity of the receptor. Ligands may be produced by the same cell that expresses the receptor. Ligands may also be expressed at the plasma membrane of an adjacent cell (e.g. Notch ligands) or be secreted and diffuse extracellularly from their point of origin to the receiving cell (e.g. interleukins).

name: receptor antagonist activity
definition: The activity of a gene product that interacts with a receptor to decrease the ability of the receptor agonist to bind and activate the receptor.

name: CCR chemokine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a CCR chemokine receptor.

name: mRNA 5'-UTR binding
definition: Binding to an mRNA molecule at its 5' untranslated region.

name: galacturonan binding
definition: Binding to a simple or complex galacturonan. Galacturonan is any glycan composed solely of galacturonic acid residues, a specific type of glycuronan, and a constituent of some pectins.

name: monosaccharide binding
definition: Binding to a monosaccharide. Monosaccharides are the simplest carbohydrates; they are polyhydroxy aldehydes H[CH(OH)]nC(=O)H or polyhydroxy ketones H[CHOH]nC(=O)[CHOH]mH with three or more carbon atoms. They form the constitutional repeating units of oligo- and polysaccharides.

name: disaccharide binding
definition: Binding to a disaccharide. Disaccharides are sugars composed of two monosaccharide units.

name: trisaccharide binding
definition: Binding to a trisaccharide. Trisaccharides are sugars composed of three monosaccharide units.

name: galacturonate binding
definition: Binding to a galacturonate. Galacturonate is the anion of galacturonic acid, the uronic acid formally derived from galactose by oxidation of the hydroxymethylene group at C-6 to a carboxyl group.

name: quinone binding
definition: Binding to a quinone, any member of a class of diketones derivable from aromatic compounds by conversion of two CH groups into CO groups with any necessary rearrangement of double bonds.

name: ubiquinone binding
definition: Binding to ubiquinone, a quinone derivative with a tail of isoprene units.

name: UDP-glucuronate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + UDP-alpha-D-glucuronate = CO2 + UDP-alpha-D-xylose.

name: calmodulin-activated 3',5'-cyclic-GMP phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: nucleoside 3',5'-cyclic GMP + H2O = GMP + H+; this activity is activated by binding to calcium-bound calmodulin.

name: tau protein binding
definition: Binding to tau protein. tau is a microtubule-associated protein, implicated in Alzheimer's disease, Down Syndrome and ALS.

name: activin binding
definition: Binding to activin, a dimer of inhibin-beta subunits.

name: phytanoyl-CoA dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + O2 + phytanoyl-CoA = 2-hydroxyphytanoyl-CoA + CO2 + succinate.

name: CXCR3 chemokine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a CXCR3 chemokine receptor.

name: high-affinity phosphate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of phosphate from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations.

name: flap endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of a flap structure in DNA, but not other DNA structures; processes the ends of Okazaki fragments in lagging strand DNA synthesis.

name: 3'-flap endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of a 3' flap structure in DNA, but not other DNA structures; processes the 3' ends of Okazaki fragments in lagging strand DNA synthesis.

name: methionine adenosyltransferase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of methionine adenosyltransferase.

name: mitogen-activated protein kinase p38 binding
definition: Binding to mitogen-activated protein kinase p38, an enzyme that catalyzes the transfer of phosphate from ATP to hydroxyl side chains on proteins in response to mitogen activation.

name: calcium-dependent protein binding
definition: Binding to a protein or protein complex in the presence of calcium.

name: ferredoxin-nitrite reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 H2O + NH4+ + 6 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] = 8 H+ + nitrite + 6 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin].

name: brain-derived neurotrophic factor binding
definition: Binding to brain-derived neurotrophic factor.

name: nerve growth factor binding
definition: Binding to nerve growth factor (NGF).

name: platelet-derived growth factor binding
definition: Binding to platelet-derived growth factor.

name: epidermal growth factor binding
definition: Binding to epidermal growth factor.

name: threonine-phosphate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-phospho-L-threonine + H+ = (R)-1-aminopropan-2-yl phosphate + CO2.

name: beta-tubulin binding
definition: Binding to the microtubule constituent protein beta-tubulin.

name: Roundabout binding
definition: Binding to Roundabout (ROBO) receptor, a transmembrane receptor.

name: ABC-type thiamine transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + thiamine(out) = ADP + H+ + phosphate + thiamine(in).

name: magnesium-protoporphyrin IX monomethyl ester (oxidative) cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: magnesium protoporphyrin IX 13-monomethyl ester + 3 NADPH + 3 H+ + 3 O2 = divinylprotochlorophyllide + 3 NADP+ + 5 H2O.

name: beta-1,3-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a galactose residue from a donor molecule to an oligosaccharide, forming a beta-1,3-linkage.

name: calcium-induced calcium release activity
definition: Enables transmembrane transfer of calcium ions from an intracellular store to the cytosol on induction by increased calcium concentration.

name: D-glutaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glutamine + H2O = D-glutamate + NH4+.

name: D-proline reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-aminopentanoate + [PrdC protein]-Se-L-selenocysteinyl-S-L-cysteine = [PrdC protein]-L-selenocysteine/L-cysteine + D-proline.

name: deoxycytidylate C-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + dCMP = 2'-deoxy-5-methyl-5'-cytidylate + 7,8-dihydrofolate.

name: isoflavone 7-O-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + isoflavone = UDP + isoflavone 7-O-beta-D-glucoside.

name: isohexenylglutaconyl-CoA hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxy-3-(4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl)glutaryl-CoA = 3-(4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl)pent-2-enedioyl-CoA + H2O.

name: isomaltulose synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sucrose = 6-O-alpha-D-glucopyranosyl-D-fructofuranose.

name: isonocardicin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + nocardicin E = S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine + H+ + isonocardicin A.

name: isopiperitenone delta-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isopiperitenone = piperitenone.

name: isopropanol dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + propan-2-ol = acetone + H+ + NADPH.

name: isovitexin beta-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isovitexin + UDP-D-glucose = H+ + isovitexin 2''-O-beta-D-glucoside + UDP.

name: itaconyl-CoA hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: citramalyl-CoA = itaconyl-CoA + H2O.

name: juglone 3-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 juglone + O2 = 2 3,5-dihydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone + 2 H+.

name: 2-dehydropantoate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-dehydropantoate = 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + formaldehyde.

name: ketotetrose-phosphate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-erythrulose 1-phosphate = formaldehyde + glycerone phosphate.

name: kievitone hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: kievitone hydrate = H2O + H+ + kievitone.

name: kynurenine 7,8-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: kynurenate + donor-H2 + O2 = 7,8-dihydro-7,8-dihydroxykynurenate + acceptor.

name: L-3-cyanoalanine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteine + HCN = sulfide + L-3-cyanoalanine.

name: amino-acid dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an L-alpha-amino acid +NAD(P)+ + H2O = a 2-oxocarboxylate + NH4+ + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: L-arabinitol 4-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arabinitol + NAD+ = L-xylulose + H+ + NADH.

name: L-arabinonate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arabinonate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-L-arabinonate + H2O.

name: L-arabinonolactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arabinono-1,4-lactone + H2O = L-arabinonate + H+.

name: L-arabinose 1-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arabinose + NAD+ = L-arabinono-1,4-lactone + NADH.

name: L-fuconate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-fuconate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-L-fuconate + H2O.

name: L-galactonolactone oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-galactono-1,4-lactone + O2 = L-ascorbate + H2O2 + H+.

name: L-glutamate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate + O2 + H2O = 2-oxoglutarate + H2O2 + NH4+.

name: L-glycol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an L-glycol + NAD(P)+ = a 2-hydroxycarbonyl compound + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: L-lysine-lactamase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-2-aminohexano-6-lactam + H2O = L-lysine.

name: L-lysine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + L-lysine + O2 = 6-amino-2-oxohexanoate + H2O2 + NH4+.

name: L-pipecolate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-pipecolate + acceptor = delta1-piperideine-6-carboxylate + reduced acceptor. Delta1-piperideine-6-carboxylate is also known as 2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridine-2-carboxylate.

name: L-pipecolate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-pipecolate + O2 = 2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridine-2-carboxylate + H2O2 + H+. Delta1-piperideine-6-carboxylate is also known as 2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridine-2-carboxylate.

name: L-rhamnonate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-rhamnonate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-L-rhamnonate + H2O.

name: L-rhamnono-1,4-lactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-rhamnono-1,4-lactone + H2O = L-rhamnonate + H+.

name: L-rhamnose 1-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-rhamnofuranose + NAD+ = L-rhamnono-1,4-lactone + H+ + NADH.

name: L-sorbose oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-sorbose + O2 = 5-dehydro-D-fructose + H2O2.

name: L-threonate 3-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-threonate + NAD+ = 3-dehydro-L-threonate + H+ + NADH.

name: L-xylose 1-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-xylose + NADP+ = H+ + L-xylono-1,4-lactone + NADPH.

name: L-xylulose reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + xylitol = L-xylulose + H+ + NADPH.

name: lactaldehyde reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + propane-1,2-diol = (S)-lactaldehyde + H+ + NADPH.

name: lactate 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactate + O2 = acetate + CO2 + H2O.

name: lactate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactate = acetaldehyde + formate.

name: lactate-malate transhydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactate + oxaloacetate = malate + pyruvate.

name: lactate racemase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactate = (R)-lactate.

name: galactose-6-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galactose 6-phosphate = D-tagatose 6-phosphate.

name: laminaribiose phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-beta-D-glucosyl-D-glucose + phosphate = D-glucose + alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate.

name: delta7-sterol 5(6)-desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a Delta(7)-sterol + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + O2 + 2 H+ = a Delta(5),Delta(7)-sterol + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O.

name: L-leucine 2,3-aminomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-leucine = (3R)-beta-leucine.

name: L-leucine dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-leucine + NAD+ + H2O = 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate + NH4+ + NADH + H+.

name: L-leucine N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-leucine + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-L-leucine + CoA + H+.

name: leukotriene-B4 20-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: leukotriene B4 + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = 20-hydroxy-leukotriene B4 + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase].

name: leukotriene-E4 20-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + leukotriene E(4) + NADPH + O2 = 20-hydroxy-leukotriene E(4) + H2O + NADP+.

name: levansucrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sucrose + 2,6-beta-D-fructosyl(n) = glucose + 2,6-beta-D-fructosyl(n+1).

name: lignostilbene alpha beta-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-bis(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)ethylene + O2 = 2 vanillin.

name: limonin-D-ring-lactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: limonoate D-ring-lactone + H2O = limonoate.

name: linalool 8-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: linalool + 2 O2 + 2 reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = (6E)-8-oxolinalool + 2 H+ + 3 H2O + 2 oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: linamarin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile = UDP + linamarin.

name: linoleate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: linoleate = 9-cis,11-trans-octadecadienoate.

name: lombricine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + lombricine = ADP + N-phospholombricine.

name: long-chain-alcohol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain alcohol + 2 NAD+ + H2O = a long-chain carboxylate + 2 NADH.

name: long-chain fatty aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain fatty aldehyde + H2O + NAD+ = a long-chain fatty acid + 2 H+ + NADH.

name: long-chain-fatty-acyl-CoA reductase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain fatty aldehyde + CoA + NADP+ = a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA + NADPH.

name: luteolin 7-O-glucuronosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: luteolin + UDP-alpha-D-glucuronate = luteolin 7-O-beta-D-glucosiduronate + UDP.

name: L-lysine:pyruvate 6-transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysine + pyruvate = (S)-2-amino-6-oxohexanoate + L-alanine.

name: L-lysine 2,3-aminomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysine = (3S)-3,6-diaminohexanoate.

name: L-lysine 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysine + O2 = 5-aminopentanamide + CO2 + H2O.

name: lysine carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysine + carbamoyl phosphate = L-homocitrulline + H+ + phosphate.

name: L-lysine dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysine + NAD+ = delta1-piperideine-2-carboxylate + NH4+ + NADH + H+.

name: lysolecithin acylmutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine = 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine.

name: phosphatidylglycerol lysyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) + L-lysyl-tRNA(Lys) = 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1'-(3'-O-L-lysyl)-sn-glycerol + tRNA(Lys).

name: macrolide 2'-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a macrolide = ADP + 2 H+ + a macrolide-2'-O-phosphate. Substrates include oleandomycin, erythromycin, spiramycin and other macrolide antibiotics.

name: malate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + malate + CoA = ADP + phosphate + malyl-CoA.

name: maleate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-malate = H2O + maleate.

name: maleate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: maleate = fumarate.

name: maleylpyruvate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-maleylpyruvate = 3-fumarylpyruvate.

name: malonate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + malonate = acetate + malonyl-CoA.

name: acetylenecarboxylate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-oxopropanoate = propynoate + H2O.

name: malonyl-CoA decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: malonyl-CoA = acetyl-CoA + CO2.

name: maltose-6'-phosphate glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + maltose 6'-phosphate = D-glucose + D-glucose 6-phosphate.

name: maltose phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: maltose + phosphate = D-glucose + beta-D-glucose 1-phosphate.

name: malyl-CoA lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3S)-3-carboxy-3-hydroxypropanoyl-CoA = acetyl-CoA + glyoxylate.

name: mannitol-1-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannitol 1-phosphate + H2O = D-mannitol + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: mannitol 2-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannitol + NADP+ = D-fructose + H+ + NADPH.

name: mannitol 2-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannitol + NAD+ = D-fructose + NADH.

name: mannitol dehydrogenase (cytochrome) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 [Fe(III)cytochrome c] + D-mannitol = 2 [Fe(II)cytochrome c] + D-fructose + 2 H+.

name: mannose-6-phosphate 6-reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannitol 1-phosphate + NADP+ = D-mannose 6-phosphate + 3 H+ + NADPH.

name: mannose isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannose = D-fructose.

name: mannuronate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannonate + NAD(P)+ = D-mannuronate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: melilotate 3-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-(2-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate + H+ + NADH + O2 = 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propanoate + H2O + NAD+.

name: meso-tartrate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R,3S)-tartrate + NAD+ = dihydroxyfumarate + H+ + NADH.

name: methanol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methanol + NAD+ = formaldehyde + H+ + NADH.

name: L-methionine:glyoxylate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glyoxylate + L-methionine = 4-methylsulfanyl-2-oxobutanoate + glycine.

name: methionine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-methionine + H+ = 3-methylthiopropanamine + CO2.

name: methylaspartate ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: threo-3-methyl-L-aspartate = mesaconate + NH4.

name: methylaspartate mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: threo-3-methyl-L-aspartate = L-glutamate.

name: methylguanidinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + methylguanidine = methylammonium + urea.

name: methylglutamate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-methyl-L-glutamate + A + H2O = L-glutamate + AH(2) + formaldehyde.

name: methylitaconate delta-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-methylene-3-methylsuccinate = dimethylmaleate.

name: mimosinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-mimosine + H2O = 3-hydroxy-4H-pyrid-4-one + L-serine.

name: cellodextrin phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,4-beta-D-glucosyl(n) + phosphate = 1,4-beta-D-glucosyl(n-1) + alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate.

name: dextrin dextranase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,4-alpha-D-glucosyl(n) + 1,6-alpha-D-glucosyl(m) = 1,4-alpha-D-glucosyl(n-1) + 1,6-alpha-D-glucosyl(m+1).

name: L-gulonate 3-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-gulonate + NAD+ = 3-dehydro-L-gulonate + H+ + NADH.

name: L-gulonolactone oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-gulono-1,4-lactone + O2 = L-xylo-hex-3-ulonolactone + H2O2.

name: monomethyl-sulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + monomethyl sulfate = H+ + methanol + sulfate.

name: monoterpenol O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + a monoterpenol = CoA + a monoterpenol acetate ester.

name: monoterpenyl-diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2S,4R)-bornyl diphosphate + H2O = (1R,2S,4R)-borneol + diphosphate.

name: morphine 6-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: morphine + NAD(P)+ = morphinone + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: mycocerosate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + 7n H+ + n methylmalonyl-CoA + 2n NADPH = n CO2 + n CoA + n H2O + multi-methyl-branched acyl-CoA + 2n NADP+.

name: inositol 2-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: myo-inositol + NAD+ = 2,4,6/3,5-pentahydroxycyclohexanone + H+ + NADH.

name: inositol oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: myo-inositol + O2 = D-glucuronate + H2O + H+.

name: myo-inosose-2 dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4,6/3,5-pentahydroxycyclohexanone = 3D-3,5/4-trihydroxycyclohexane-1,2-dione + H2O.

name: myosin-light-chain-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: myosin light-chain phosphate + H2O = myosin light chain + phosphate.

name: N,N-dimethylformamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N,N-dimethylformamide + H2O = dimethylamine + formate.

name: N-acetyl-beta-alanine deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-beta-alanine + H2O = beta-alanine + acetate.

name: N-acetyldiaminopimelate deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N-acetyl-(2S,6S)-2,6-diaminoheptanedioate = (2S,6S)-2,6-diaminoheptanedioate + acetate.

name: N-acetylglucosamine deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + H2O = D-glucosamine + acetate.

name: N-acetylhexosamine 1-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + H2O + NAD+ = N-acetyl-D-glucosaminate + 2 H+ + NADH.

name: N-acylglucosamine 2-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acyl-D-glucosamine = N-acyl-D-mannosamine.

name: N-acylhexosamine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + H2O + O2 = N-acetyl-D-glucosaminate + H2O2 + H+.

name: N-acylmannosamine 1-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acyl-D-mannosamine + NAD+ = N-acyl-D-mannosaminolactone + H+ + NADH.

name: N-acylneuraminate-9-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acylneuraminate 9-phosphate + H2O = N-acylneuraminate + phosphate.

name: N-benzyloxycarbonylglycine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-benzyloxycarbonylglycine + H2O + H+ = benzyl alcohol + CO2 + glycine.

name: N-carbamoylputrescine amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-carbamoylputrescine + H2O + 2 H+ = CO2 + NH4 + putrescine.

name: N-carbamoylsarcosine amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-carbamoylsarcosine + H2O + 2 H+ = CO2 + NH4 + sarcosine.

name: N-feruloylglycine deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-feruloylglycine + H2O = ferulate + glycine.

name: N-formylglutamate deformylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-formyl-L-glutamate + H2O = L-glutamate + formate.

name: N-methyl-2-oxoglutaramate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-methyl-2-oxoglutaramate + H2O = 2-oxoglutarate + methylammonium.

name: N-methyl-L-amino-acid oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-methyl-L-amino acid + H2O + O2 = an L-amino acid + formaldehyde + H2O2.

name: N-methyl-L-alanine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-methyl-L-alanine + NADP+ + H2O = methylamine + pyruvate + NADPH + H+.

name: N6-hydroxylysine O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-hydroxy-L-lysine + acetyl-CoA = N(6)-acetyl-N(6)-hydroxy-L-lysine + CoA.

name: N6-methyl-lysine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-methyl-L-lysine + H2O + O2 = L-lysine + formaldehyde + H2O2.

name: NADP+ nucleosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + H2O = ADP-D-ribose 2'-phosphate + nicotinamide + H+.

name: NADH dehydrogenase (quinone) (non-electrogenic) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADH + H+ + a quinone = NAD+ + a quinol.

name: NADPH peroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O2 + H+ + NADPH = 2 H2O + NADP+.

name: nicotinate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + NADP+ + nicotinate = 6-hydroxynicotinate + H+ + NADPH.

name: nicotinate-N-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinate + UDP-D-glucose = N-(beta-D-glucosyl)nicotinate + UDP.

name: nitrate reductase (cytochrome) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome] + nitrate + 2 H+ = 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome] + nitrite + H2O.

name: nitrogenase (flavodoxin) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N2 + 4 reduced [flavodoxin] + 16 ATP + 16 H2O = 4 oxidized [flavodoxin] + H2 + 2 NH4+ + 16 ADP + 16 phosphate + 18 H+.

name: nocardicin-A epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isonocardicin A = nocardicin A. May also catalyse the epimerisation of isonocardicin C, but the in vivo substrate appears to be isonocardicin A.

name: nucleoside deoxyribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-deoxy-D-ribosyl-base1 + base2 = 2-deoxy-D-ribosyl-base2 + base1.

name: nucleoside monophosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a ribonucleoside 5'-phosphate + ATP = a ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate + ADP.

name: nucleoside phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a nucleotide + a 2'-deoxynucleoside = a nucleoside + a 2'-deoxynucleoside 5'-monophosphate.

name: nucleoside ribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribosyl-base1 + base2 = D-ribosyl-base2 + base1.

name: nucleotide diphosphokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + nucleoside 5'-phosphate = AMP + 5'-phosphonucleoside 3'-diphosphate.

name: o-aminophenol oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 2-aminophenol + 3 O2 = 2 isophenoxazine + 6 H2O.

name: o-pyrocatechuate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate + H+ = catechol + CO2.

name: oleate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-10-hydroxystearate = H2O + oleate.

name: omega-amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a monoamide of a dicarboxylic acid + H2O = a dicarboxylate + NH4+. Substrates include 2-oxosuccinamate and 2-oxoglutaramate, which get converted to oxaloacetate and 2-oxoglutarate, respectively.

name: omega-hydroxydecanoate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10-hydroxydecanoate + NAD+ = 10-oxodecanoate + H+ + NADH.

name: opheline kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + guanidinoethyl methyl phosphate = N'-phosphoguanidinoethyl methylphosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: ornithine N-benzoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ornithine + 2 benzoyl-CoA = N(2),N(5)-dibenzoyl-L-ornithine + 2 CoA + 2 H+.

name: ornithine racemase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ornithine = D-ornithine.

name: dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-dihydroorotate + NADP+ = H+ + NADPH + orotate.

name: orsellinate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: o-orsellinate + H+ = CO2 + orcinol.

name: orsellinate-depside hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + orsellinate depside = 2 o-orsellinate + H+.

name: succinyl-CoA:oxalate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: oxalate + succinyl-CoA = oxalyl-CoA + succinate.

name: oxalate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 H+ + O2 + oxalate = 2 CO2 + H2O2.

name: oxaloacetate tautomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: oxaloacetate = <stereo>enol</stereo>-oxaloacetate.

name: pantetheine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + pantetheine = ADP + pantetheine 4'-phosphate.

name: pantoate 4-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-pantoate + NAD+ = (R)-4-dehydropantoate + H+ + NADH.

name: pantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-[(R)-pantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H+ = (R)-pantetheine + CO2.

name: pentanamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + pentanamide = NH4 + valerate.

name: protein-glutaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [protein]-C-terminal-L-glutamine + H2O = [protein]-C-terminal-L-glutamate + NH4+.

name: phenylalanine 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine + O2 = 2-phenylacetamide + CO2 + H2O.

name: phenylalanine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine = phenylethylamine + CO2.

name: L-phenylalanine dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine + NAD+ + H2O = 3-phenylpyruvate + NH4+ + NADH + H+.

name: L-phenylalanine N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-L-phenylalanine + CoA + H+.

name: phenylpyruvate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenylpyruvate = phenylacetaldehyde + CO2.

name: phenylpyruvate tautomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: keto-phenylpyruvate = enol-phenylpyruvate.

name: phenylserine aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-threo-3-phenylserine = benzaldehyde + glycine.

name: phloretin hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + phloretin = H+ + phloretate + phloroglucinol.

name: phorbol-diester hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + phorbol 12,13-dibutanoate = butanoate + H+ + phorbol 13-butanoate.

name: phosphate butyryltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: butanoyl-CoA + phosphate = butanoyl phosphate + CoA.

name: phosphatidylcholine 12-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-acyl-2-(9Z)-octadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = 1-acyl-2-[(R)-12-hydroxyoleoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + H2O.

name: acyl-lipid omega-6 desaturase (cytochrome b5) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a (9Z)-octadecenoyl-containing glycerolipid + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = a (9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl-containing glycerolipid + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O.

name: phosphatidylinositol deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol + H2O = 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol + a carboxylate + H+.

name: phosphoadenylylsulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + H2O = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + sulfate.

name: phosphoamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-phosphocreatine + H2O = creatine + phosphate.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphoenolpyruvate = 3-phosphonopyruvate.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + phosphoenolpyruvate = phosphate + pyruvate.

name: phosphoglucokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + ATP = alpha-D-glucose 1,6-bisphosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: phosphoglycerate kinase (GTP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phospho-D-glycerate + GTP = 3-phospho-D-glyceroyl phosphate + GDP + H+.

name: phosphoglycerate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-phospho-D-glycerate + H2O = D-glycerate + phosphate.

name: phosphoketolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-xylulose 5-phosphate + phosphate = acetyl phosphate + D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + H2O.

name: phosphonoacetaldehyde hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + phosphonoacetaldehyde = acetaldehyde + H+ + phosphate.

name: phosphoribokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 5-phosphate + ATP = D-ribose 1,5-diphosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: [phosphorylase] phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [phosphorylase a] + 4 H2O = 2 [phosphorylase b] + 4 phosphate.

name: phytanate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + CoA + phytanate = AMP + diphosphate + H+ + phytanoyl-CoA.

name: pinosylvin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-cinnamoyl-CoA + 3 H+ + 3 malonyl-CoA = 4 CO2 + 4 CoA + pinosylvin.

name: piperidine N-piperoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (E,E)-piperoyl-CoA + piperidine = N-[(E,E)-piperoyl]piperidine + CoA + H+.

name: fucokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-fucose + ATP = beta-L-fucose 1-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: octopamine dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-2-aminoethanol = (4-hydroxyphenyl)acetaldehyde + NH4.

name: oxalate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + CoA + oxalate = AMP + diphosphate + H+ + oxalyl-CoA.

name: oxalomalate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-oxalomalate = glyoxylate + oxaloacetate.

name: oxamate carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carbamoyl phosphate + oxamate = oxalurate + phosphate.

name: oximinotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-(hydroxyimino)propanoate + acetone = acetone oxime + pyruvate.

name: plasmanylethanolamine desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:1-(1,2-saturated alkyl)-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = 1-O-(1Z-alkenyl)-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O.

name: polysialic-acid O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + an alpha-2,8-linked polymer of sialic acid = CoA + polysialic acid acetylated at O-7 or O-9.

name: polyvinyl-alcohol oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: polyvinyl alcohol + O2 = oxidized polyvinyl alcohol + H2O2.

name: prenyl-diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dimethylallyl diphosphate + H2O = diphosphate + prenol.

name: procollagen galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + procollagen 5-hydroxy-L-lysine = UDP + procollagen 5-(D-galactosyloxy)-L-lysine.

name: progesterone 11-alpha-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: progesterone + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = 11alpha-hydroxyprogesterone + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] + H2O + H+.

name: progesterone monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AH2 + O2 + progesterone = A + H2O + testosterone acetate.

name: propanediol dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: propane-1,2-diol = H2O + propanal.

name: propanediol-phosphate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + propane-1,2-diol 1-phosphate = H+ + hydroxyacetone phosphate + NADH.

name: propioin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxyhexan-3-one = 2 propanal.

name: propionate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + propanoate + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + propanoyl-CoA.

name: prostaglandin-A1 delta-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: prostaglandin A1 = prostaglandin C1.

name: prostaglandin-E synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: prostaglandin H(2) = prostaglandin E(2).

name: prostaglandin E2 9-reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (5Z,13E)-(15S)-9-alpha,11-alpha,15-trihydroxyprosta-5,13-dienoate + NADP+ = (5Z,13E)-(15S)-11-alpha,15-dihydroxy-9-oxoprosta-5,13-dienoate + NADPH.

name: protocatechuate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + H+ = catechol + CO2.

name: prunasin beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-prunasin + H2O = D-glucose + mandelonitrile.

name: pseudouridine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + pseudouridine = ADP + 2 H+ + pseudouridine 5'-phosphate.

name: psychosine sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + galactosylsphingosine = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + psychosine sulfate.

name: pteridine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-amino-4-hydroxypteridine + O2 = 2-amino-4,7-dihydroxypteridine + unknown.

name: pterin deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-amino-4-hydroxypteridine + H2O + H+ = a 2,4-dihydroxypteridine + NH4+.

name: purine imidazole-ring cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: DNA 4,6-diamino-5-formamidopyrimidine = DNA adenine + H2O.

name: putrescine carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carbamoyl phosphate + putrescine = N-carbamoylputrescine + H+ + phosphate.

name: putrescine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + O2 + putrescine = 4-aminobutanal + H2O2 + NH4+.

name: pyranose oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose + O2 = 2-dehydro-D-glucose + H2O2.

name: pyrazolylalanine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + pyrazole = 3-(pyrazol-1-yl)-L-alanine + H2O.

name: pyridoxal 4-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + pyridoxal = 4-pyridoxolactone + H+ + NADH.

name: pyridoxine 4-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + pyridoxine = H+ + NADPH + pyridoxal.

name: pyridoxine 4-oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyridoxine + O2 = pyridoxal + H2O2.

name: pyridoxine 5-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyridoxine + acceptor = isopyridoxal + reduced acceptor.

name: pyrithiamine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(4-amino-2-methylpyrimid-5-ylmethyl)-3-(2-hydroxyethyl)-2-methylpyridinium + H2O + H+ = 1-(4-hydroxy-2-methylpyrimid-5-ylmethyl)-3-(2-hydroxyethyl)-2-methylpyridinium + NH4+.

name: pyrogallol 1,2-oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O2 + pyrogallol = (Z)-5-oxohex-2-enedioate + 2 H+.

name: pyrroline-2-carboxylate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-proline + NAD(P)+ = 1-pyrroline-2-carboxylate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: pyruvate, phosphate dikinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + phosphate + pyruvate = AMP + diphosphate + 2 H+ + phosphoenolpyruvate.

name: pyruvate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CoA + NADP+ + pyruvate = acetyl-CoA + CO2 + NADPH.

name: pyruvate oxidase (CoA-acetylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CoA + H+ + O2 + pyruvate = acetyl-CoA + CO2 + H2O2.

name: raucaffricine beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + raucaffricine = D-glucose + vomilenine.

name: Renilla-luciferin 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Renilla luciferin + O2 = oxidized Renilla luciferin + CO2 + light.

name: Renilla-luciferin sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate + Renilla luciferin = adenosine 3',5'-diphosphate + H+ + luciferyl sulfate.

name: retinol isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-retinol = 11-cis-retinol.

name: retinol O-fatty-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + retinol = CoA + retinyl ester.

name: retinyl-palmitate esterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: retinyl palmitate + H2O = retinol + palmitate + H+.

name: rhodopsin kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + rhodopsin = ADP + phosphorhodopsin.

name: ribitol 2-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribitol + NAD+ = D-ribulose + H+ + NADH.

name: ribitol-5-phosphate 2-dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribitol 5-phosphate + NAD(P)+ = D-ribulose 5-phosphate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: riboflavin phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + riboflavin = D-glucose + FMN.

name: riboflavinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + H+ + riboflavin = D-ribitol + lumichrome.

name: ribose 1-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + NADP+ + ribofuranose = D-ribonate + 2 H+ + NADPH.

name: ribose-5-phosphate-ammonia ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 5-phosphate + ATP + NH4 = 5-phospho-D-ribosylamine + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: ribose isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: aldehydo-D-ribose = D-ribulose.

name: ribosylnicotinamide kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-nicotinamide D-riboside + ATP = beta-nicotinamide D-ribonucleotide + ADP + H+.

name: ribosylpyrimidine nucleosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-D-ribosylpyrimidine + H2O = D-ribose + a pyrimidine.

name: rifamycin-B oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 H+ + O2 + rifamycin B = H2O2 + rifamycin O.

name: RNA uridylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UTP + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n+1).

name: rosmarinate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: caffeoyl-CoA + 3-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)lactate = CoA + rosmarinate.

name: rubber cis-polyprenylcistransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (cis-prenyl)n-diphosphate + isopentenyl diphosphate = (cis-prenyl)(n+1)-diphosphate + diphosphate.

name: coniferyl-alcohol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: coniferyl alcohol + NADP+ = coniferyl aldehyde + NADPH.

name: coniferyl-aldehyde dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: coniferyl aldehyde + H2O + NAD(P)+ = ferulate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: S-adenosylhomocysteine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H2O + H+ = S-inosyl-L-homocysteine + NH4.

name: S-carboxymethylcysteine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-chloro-L-alanine + thioglycolate = S-carboxymethyl-L-cysteine + chloride + H+.

name: S-succinylglutathione hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-succinylglutathione + H2O = glutathione + H+ + succinate.

name: salicyl-alcohol beta-D-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: salicyl alcohol + UDP-D-glucose = H+ + salicin + UDP.

name: scopoletin glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: scopoletin + UDP-D-glucose = H+ + scopolin + UDP.

name: scyllo-inosamine 4-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-amino-1-deoxy-scyllo-inositol + ATP = 1-amino-1-deoxy-scyllo-inositol 4-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: sedoheptulokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + sedoheptulose = ADP + 2 H+ + sedoheptulose 7-phosphate.

name: sedoheptulose-bisphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sedoheptulose 1,7-bisphosphate + H2O = sedoheptulose 7-phosphate + phosphate.

name: sepiapterin deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-sepiapterin + H2O + H+ = (S)-xanthopterin-B2 + NH4+.

name: sequoyitol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-5-O-methyl-myo-inositol + NAD+ = 2D-5-O-methyl-2,3,5/4,6-pentahydroxycyclohexanone + H+ + NADH.

name: L-serine:glyoxylate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + glyoxylate = 3-hydroxypyruvate + glycine.

name: L-serine 2-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + NAD+ + H2O = 3-hydroxypyruvate + NH4+ + NADH + H+.

name: serine-sulfate ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: -serine O-sulfate + H2O = sulfate + pyruvate + NH4+ + H+.

name: sinapate 1-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + sinapate = UDP + 1-sinapoyl-D-glucose.

name: sinapine esterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-sinapoylcholine + H2O = choline + H+ + sinapate.

name: sorbitol-6-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucitol 6-phosphate + H2O = D-glucitol + phosphate.

name: sorbose 5-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-sorbose + NADP+ = 5-dehydro-D-fructose + H+ + NADPH.

name: sorbose dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-sorbose + A = 5-dehydro-D-fructose + AH(2).

name: spermidine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: spermidine + acceptor + H2O = 1,3-diaminopropane + 4-aminobutanal + reduced acceptor.

name: sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase D activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + sphingomyelin = ceramide 1-phosphate + choline + H+.

name: sphingosine N-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + sphingosine = CoA + N-acylsphingosine.

name: steroid 9-alpha-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AH2 + O2 + pregna-4,9(11)-diene-3,20-dione = 9,11alpha-epoxypregn-4-ene-3,20-dione + A + H2O.

name: steroid-lactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + testololactone = H+ + testolate.

name: steroid sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + a phenolic steroid = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + steroid O-sulfate.

name: steryl-beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholesteryl-beta-D-glucoside + H2O = D-glucose + cholesterol.

name: stipitatonate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + stipitatonate = CO2 + H+ + stipitatate.

name: stizolobate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-dopa + O2 = 4-(L-alanin-3-yl)-2-hydroxy-cis,cis-muconate 6-semialdehyde + H+.

name: stizolobinate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,4-dihydroxy-L-phenylalanine + O2 = 5-(L-alanin-3-yl)-2-hydroxy-cis,cis-muconate 6-semialdehyde.

name: streptomycin 3''-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + streptomycin = ADP + 2 H+ + streptomycin 3''-phosphate.

name: aminoglycoside 6-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + streptomycin = ADP + 2 H+ + streptomycin 6-phosphate.

name: streptomycin-6-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + streptomycin 6-phosphate = phosphate + streptomycin.

name: indole-3-acetaldehyde oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + indole-3-acetaldehyde + O2 = (indol-3-yl)acetate + H+ + H2O2.

name: L-lysine 6-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysine + NAD+ = L-1-piperideine-6-carboxylate + NH4+ + NADH + 2 H+. (S)-(2-aminoethyl)-L-cysteine can act as a substrate, and NADP+ can act as the acceptor.

name: nitrous-oxide reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + 2 cytochrome c + nitrogen = 2 reduced cytochrome c + nitrous oxide.

name: strombine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-(carboxymethyl)-D-alanine + H2O + NAD+ = glycine + H+ + NADH + pyruvate.

name: sucrose 1F-fructosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 sucrose = D-glucose + 1F-beta-D-fructosylsucrose.

name: sucrose-phosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sucrose 6F-phosphate + H2O = sucrose + phosphate.

name: sugar-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sugar phosphate + H2O = sugar + phosphate.

name: sugar-terminal-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + sugar phosphorylated on the terminal carbon = a sugar + phosphate.

name: sulfite dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sulfite + 2 ferricytochrome c + H2O = sulfate + 2 ferrocytochrome c.

name: sulfite reductase (ferredoxin) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydrogen sulfide + 3 oxidized ferredoxin + 3 H2O = sulfite + 3 reduced ferredoxin.

name: sulfur dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-sulfanylglutathione + O2 + H2O = sulfite + glutathione + 2 H+.

name: sym-norspermidine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,3-diaminopropane + S-adenosylmethioninamine = S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine + bis(3-aminopropyl)amine + H+.

name: synephrine dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: synephrine = (4-hydroxyphenyl)acetaldehyde + methylammonium.

name: dGMP kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dGMP + ATP = dGDP + ADP.

name: tagatose kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-tagatose + ATP = D-tagatose 6-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: tannase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: digallate + H2O = 2 gallate + H+.

name: tartrate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tartrate + H+ = D-glycerate + CO2.

name: tartrate epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tartrate = (2R,3S)-tartrate.

name: tau-protein kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + tau-protein = ADP + O-phospho-tau-protein on serine and threonine residues.

name: taurine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: taurine + 2-oxoglutarate = sulfoacetaldehyde + L-glutamate.

name: taurine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A + H2O + taurine = AH(2) + NH4 + sulfoacetaldehyde.

name: taurocyamine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + taurocyamine = N-phosphotaurocyamine + ADP + 2 H+.

name: tauropine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + NAD+ + tauropine = H+ + NADH + pyruvate + taurine.

name: taxifolin 8-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: taxifolin + NAD(P)H + H+ + O2 = 2,3-dihydrogossypetin + NAD(P)+ + H2O.

name: tetrahydroberberine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-tetrahydroberberine + 2 O2 = berberine + 2 H2O2.

name: tetrahydroxypteridine cycloisomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tetrahydroxypteridine = H+ + xanthine-8-carboxylate.

name: theanine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(5)-ethyl-L-glutamine + H2O = L-glutamate + ethylamine.

name: thiamine-diphosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + thiamin diphosphate = ADP + thiamin triphosphate.

name: thiamine pyridinylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyridine + thiamine = 5-(2-hydroxyethyl)-4-methylthiazole + heteropyrithiamine.

name: thiamine triphosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + thiamine triphosphate = thiamine diphosphate + H+ + phosphate.

name: thiaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + thiamine = 4-amino-5-hydroxymethyl-2-methylpyrimidine + 5-(2-hydroxyethyl)-4-methylthiazole + H+.

name: thioethanolamine S-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + cysteamine = S-acetylcysteamine + CoA.

name: thiosulfate-thiol sulfurtransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: thiosulfate + 2 glutathione = glutathione disulfide + hydrogen sulfide + sulfite + 2 H+.

name: thiosulfate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 thiosulfate + 2 ferricytochrome c = tetrathionate + 2 ferrocytochrome c.

name: TTPase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTTP + H2O = dTDP + H+ + phosphate.

name: thymine dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: thymine + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = 5-hydroxymethyluracil + succinate + CO2.

name: tocopherol C-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: gamma-tocopherol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = (+)-alpha-tocopherol + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction can also use delta-tocopherol, gamma-tocotrienol and delta-tocotrienol as substrates.

name: trans-2-enoyl-CoA reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + NAD+ = trans-didehydroacyl-CoA + NADH.

name: trans-cinnamate 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-cinnamate + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 2-coumarate + H2O + NADP+.

name: trans-epoxysuccinate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-2,3-epoxysuccinate + H2O = (2R,3S)-tartrate.

name: trans-L-3-hydroxyproline dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-L-3-hydroxyproline = 1-pyrroline-2-carboxylate + H2O + H+.

name: trehalose O-mycolyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 alpha,alpha'-trehalose 6-mycolate = alpha,alpha'-trehalose 6,6'-bismycolate + alpha,alpha-trehalose.

name: triacetate-lactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + triacetate lactone = triacetate.

name: trihydroxystilbene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3 malonyl-CoA + 4-coumaroyl-CoA = 4 CoA + 3,4',5-trihydroxy-stilbene + 4 CO2.

name: trimetaphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + trimetaphosphate = 2 H+ + triphosphate.

name: trimethylamine-oxide aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + trimethylamine N-oxide = dimethylamine + formaldehyde.

name: trimethyllysine dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + N(6),N(6),N(6)-trimethyl-L-lysine + O2 = 3-hydroxy-N(6),N(6),N(6)-trimethyl-L-lysine + CO2 + succinate.

name: triokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde + ATP = D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: inorganic triphosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + inorganic triphosphate = diphosphate + phosphate.

name: tropine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + tropine = H+ + NADPH + tropinone.

name: tropinesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: atropine + H2O = H+ + tropate + tropine.

name: tropinone reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + pseudotropine = H+ + NADPH + tropinone.

name: tryptophan 2'-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + O2 + H+ = 3-indoleglycolaldehyde + NH4+ + CO2.

name: tryptophan 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + O2 = CO2 + H2O + indole-3-acetamide.

name: L-tryptophan:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + 2-oxoglutarate = indole-3-pyruvate + L-glutamate.

name: L-tryptophan dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + NAD(P)+ + H2O = indole-3-pyruvate + NH4+ + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: tryptophan dimethylallyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dimethylallyl diphosphate + L-tryptophan = diphosphate + 4-(3-methylbut-2-enyl)-L-tryptophan.

name: tryptophanamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophanamide + H2O = L-tryptophan + NH4.

name: tyramine N-feruloyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: feruloyl-CoA + tyramine = CoA + N-feruloyltyramine.

name: tyrosine-arginine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + L-tyrosine + ATP = L-tyrosyl-L-arginine + AMP + diphosphate + 2 H+.

name: L-tyrosine 2,3-aminomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine = 3-amino-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate.

name: [tyrosine 3-monooxygenase] kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-seryl-[tyrosine-3-monooxygenase] = ADP + H+ + O-phospho-L-seryl-[tyrosine-3-monooxygenase].

name: tyrosine N-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + 2 reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + 2 O2 = (E)-4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde oxime + 2 oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + CO2 + 3 H2O + 2 H+.

name: tyrosine phenol-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + H2O = NH4 + phenol + pyruvate.

name: UDP-arabinose 4-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-L-arabinose = UDP-alpha-D-xylose.

name: UDP-galacturonate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + UDP-alpha-D-galacturonate = CO2 + UDP-L-arabinose.

name: UDP-glucosamine 4-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucosamine = UDP-galactosamine.

name: UDP-glucose 4,6-dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-D-glucose = H2O + UDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-D-glucose.

name: UDP-glucuronate 4-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-glucuronate = UDP-alpha-D-galacturonate.

name: UDP-glucuronate 5'-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-glucuronate = UDP-L-iduronate.

name: undecaprenyl-diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + H2O = di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl phosphate + H+ + phosphate.

name: uracil-5-carboxylate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + uracil 5-carboxylate = CO2 + uracil.

name: uracil dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uracil + acceptor = barbiturate + reduced acceptor.

name: urate-ribonucleotide phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-(beta-D-ribofuranosyl)uric acid + phosphate = alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate + H+ + urate.

name: ureidoglycolate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-ureidoglycolate = glyoxylate + urea.

name: ureidosuccinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-carbamoyl-L-aspartate + H2O + 2 H+ = L-aspartate + CO2 + NH4.

name: urethanase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + H+ + urethane = CO2 + ethanol + NH4.

name: uronate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galacturonate + H2O + NAD+ = galactarate + 2 H+ + NADH.

name: uronolactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucurono-6,2-lactone + H2O = D-glucuronate.

name: valine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-valine + H+ = 2-methylpropanamine + CO2.

name: L-valine dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-valine + NADP+ + H2O = 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + NH4+ + NADPH + H+.

name: vicianin beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-vicianin + H2O = mandelonitrile + vicianose.

name: vinylacetyl-CoA delta-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: vinylacetyl-CoA = (2E)-butenoyl-CoA.

name: viomycin kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + viomycin = ADP + O-phosphoviomycin.

name: vitexin beta-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-D-glucose + vitexin = H+ + UDP + vitexin 2''-O-beta-D-glucoside.

name: vomifoliol 4'-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (6S,9R)-6-hydroxy-3-oxo-alpha-ionol + NAD+ = (6S)-6-hydroxy-3-oxo-alpha-ionone + H+ + NADH.

name: Watasenia-luciferin 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Watasenia luciferin + O2 = oxidized Watasenia luciferin + CO2 + light.

name: wax-ester hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a wax ester + H2O = a long-chain alcohol + a long-chain carboxylate.

name: xanthommatin reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,12-dihydroxanthommatin + NAD+ = H+ + NADH + xanthommatin.

name: xylitol kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + xylitol = ADP + 2 H+ + xylitol 5-phosphate.

name: xylonate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-xylonate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-arabinonate + H2O.

name: xylono-1,4-lactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-xylono-1,4-lactone + H2O = D-xylonate.

name: trans-zeatin O-beta-D-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-zeatin + UDP-D-glucose = O-beta-D-glucosyl-trans-zeatin + H+ + UDP.

name: zeatin O-beta-D-xylosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-xylose + zeatin = O-beta-D-xylosylzeatin + H+ + UDP.

name: [acetyl-CoA carboxylase]-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [acetyl-CoA carboxylase]-phosphate + H2O = [acetyl-CoA carboxylase] + phosphate.

name: [glycogen-synthase-D] phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [glycogen-synthase D] + H2O = [glycogen-synthase I] + phosphate.

name: [pyruvate kinase]-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [pyruvate kinase] phosphate + H2O = [pyruvate kinase] + phosphate.

name: indolylacetylinositol arabinosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1L-1-O-(indol-3-yl)acetyl-myo-inositol + UDP-L-arabinose = (indol-3-yl)acetyl-myo-inositol 3-L-arabinoside + H+ + UDP.

name: 3-oxolaurate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-oxododecanoate + H+ = 2-undecanone + CO2. Also decarboxylates other C14 to C16 oxo acids.

name: cinnamate beta-D-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-cinnamate + UDP-D-glucose = 1-O-trans-cinnamoyl-beta-D-glucopyranose + UDP.

name: D-alanine 2-hydroxymethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + D-alanine + H2O = (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + 2-methylserine.

name: formimidoylaspartate deiminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-formimidoyl-L-aspartate + H2O = N-formyl-L-aspartate + NH4+.

name: formimidoylglutamase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-formimidoyl-L-glutamate + H2O = L-glutamate + formamide.

name: formimidoylglutamate deiminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-formimidoyl-L-glutamate + H2O = N-formyl-L-glutamate + NH4+.

name: glutamin-(asparagin-)ase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: H2O + L-glutamine = NH4 + L-glutamate; and H2O + L-asparagine = NH4 + L-aspartate.

name: hydroxylamine reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an acceptor + NH4+ + H2O = hydroxylamine + a reduced acceptor + H+.

name: hydroxymandelonitrile lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxymandelonitrile = 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde + hydrocyanate.

name: maltose synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate = maltose + 2 phosphate.

name: nitrite reductase (NO-forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nitric oxide + Fe(III)-[cytochrome c] + H2O = Fe(II)-[cytochrome c] + nitrite + 2 H+.

name: strictosidine beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3alpha(S)-strictosidine + H2O = D-glucose + strictosidine aglycone.

name: thiamine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: thiamine + 2 O2 = thiamine acetic acid + 2 H2O2.

name: transforming growth factor beta binding
definition: Binding to TGF-beta, transforming growth factor beta, a multifunctional peptide that controls proliferation, differentiation and other functions in many cell types.

name: microfibril binding
definition: Binding to a microfibril, any small fibril occurring in biological material.

name: (-)-endo-fenchol synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: geranyl diphosphate + H2O = (-)-endo-fenchol + diphosphate.

name: 2-ethylmalate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxobutanate + acetyl-CoA + H2O = (R)-2-ethylmalate + CoA + H+.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-oxoadipate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + glyoxylate + H+ = 2-hydroxy-3-oxoadipate + CO2.

name: 2-methylcitrate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + oxaloacetate + propanoyl-CoA = (2R,3S)-2-methylcitrate + CoA + H+.

name: 3-ethylmalate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: butanoyl-CoA + glyoxylate + H2O = 3-ethylmalate + CoA + H+.

name: 3-propylmalate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glyoxylate + H2O + pentanoyl-CoA = 3-propylmalate + CoA + H+.

name: asparagusate reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-sulfanyl-2-(sulfanylmethyl)propanoate + NAD+ = asparagusate + NADH + H+.

name: azobenzene reductase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: aniline + N,N-dimethyl-1,4-phenylenediamine + 2 NADP+ = 4-(dimethylamino)azobenzene + 2 H+ + 2 NADPH.

name: zeatin 9-aminocarboxyethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-acetyl-L-serine + zeatin = L-lupinate + acetate + H+.

name: beta-cyclopiazonate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-cyclopiazonate + A = alpha-cyclopiazonate + AH(2).

name: casbene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-geranylgeranyl diphosphate = casbene + diphosphate.

name: CoA-disulfide reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 CoA + NADP+ = CoA-disulfide + NADPH + H+.

name: CoA-glutathione reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CoA + glutathione + NADP+ = CoA-glutathione + NADPH + H+.

name: coenzyme F420 hydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: coenzyme F420 + H(2) + H+ = reduced coenzyme F420.

name: columbamine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 columbamine + O2 = 2 berberine + 2 H2O.

name: L-cystine reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 L-cysteine + NAD+ = L-cystine + H+ + NADH.

name: decylcitrate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + lauroyl-CoA + oxaloacetate = (2S,3S)-2-hydroxytridecane-1,2,3-tricarboxylate + CoA + H+.

name: decylhomocitrate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + H2O + lauroyl-CoA = (3S,4S)-3-hydroxytetradecane-1,3,4-tricarboxylate + CoA + H+.

name: ethanolamine-phosphate phospho-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + phosphoethanolamine = acetaldehyde + NH4 + phosphate.

name: hydroxylamine reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NH4+ + NAD+ + H2O = hydroxylamine + NADH + 2 H+.

name: L-mimosine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,4-dihydroxypyridine + O-acetyl-L-serine = 3-(3,4-dihydroxypyridinium-1-yl)-L-alanine + acetate.

name: N-acetylneuraminate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphoenolpyruvate + N-acetyl-D-mannosamine + H2O = phosphate + N-acetylneuraminate.

name: nitrate reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nitrite + NAD(P)+ + H2O = nitrate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: nitrate reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nitrite + NADP+ + H2O = nitrate + NADPH + H+.

name: nitroquinoline-N-oxide reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-(hydroxyamino)quinoline N-oxide + 2 NAD(P)+ + H2O = 4-nitroquinoline N-oxide + 2 NAD(P)H + 2 H+.

name: pentalenene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate = diphosphate + pentalenene.

name: reticuline oxidase activity

name: sabinene-hydrate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: geranyl diphosphate + H2O = diphosphate + sabinene hydrate.

name: trimethylamine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trimethylamine + H2O + electron-transferring flavoprotein = dimethylamine + formaldehyde + reduced electron-transferring flavoprotein.

name: uracilylalanine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O3-acetyl-L-serine + uracil = 3-(uracil-1-yl)-L-alanine + acetate.

name: zeatin reductase activity

name: arachidonate 15-lipoxygenase activity

name: (S)-norcoclaurine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-(2-aminoethyl)benzene-1,2-diol + 4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde = (S)-norcoclaurine + H2O.

name: acetylenedicarboxylate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + acetylenedicarboxylate = CO2 + pyruvate.

name: acyl-lysine deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-acyl-L-lysine = L-lysine + a carboxylate.

name: glyceryl-ether monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-alkyl-sn-glycerol + O2 + (tetrahydrobiopterin/tetrahydropteridine) = 1-hydroxyalkyl-sn-glycerol + H2O + (dihydrobiopterin/dihydropteridine).

name: imidazolonepropionase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-(4-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-5-yl)propanoic acid + H2O = N-formimidoyl-L-glutamate + H+.

name: mandelate 4-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-mandelate + 5,6,7,8-tetrahydrobiopterin + O2 = (S)-4-hydroxymandelate + 7,8-dihydrobiopterin + H2O. (S)-2-hydroxy-2-phenylacetate is also known as S-mandelate.

name: oxidoreductase activity, acting on X-H and Y-H to form an X-Y bond, with a disulfide as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which X-H and Y-H form X-Y and the acceptor is disulfide.

name: intramolecular hydroxytransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a hydroxyl group from one position to another within a single molecule.

name: sulfoacetaldehyde acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl phosphate + H+ + sulfite = phosphate + sulfoacetaldehyde.

name: ecdysteroid UDP-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + ecdysteroid = UDP + glucosyl-ecdysteroid.

name: 1,4-lactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + a 1,4-lactone = a 4-hydroxyacid.

name: sulcatone reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + sulcatol = H+ + NADH + sulcatone.

name: glycerol-1-phosphate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD(P)+ + sn-glycerol-1-phosphate = NAD(P)H + H+ + dihydroxy-acetone-phosphate.

name: alkylthioltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an alkylthio group from one compound (donor) to another (acceptor).

name: oxidoreductase activity, acting on paired donors, with incorporation or reduction of molecular oxygen, with 2-oxoglutarate as one donor, and the other dehydrogenated
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which hydrogen or electrons are transferred from 2-oxoglutarate and one other donor, and the latter donor is dehydrogenated.

name: oxidoreductase activity, acting on phosphorus or arsenic in donors, with NAD(P)+ as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a phosphorus- or arsenic-containing group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces a NAD(P)+ to NAD(P)H.

name: 1,3-beta-galactosyl-N-acetylhexosamine phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphate + beta-D-galactopyranosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine = N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + alpha-D-galactopyranose 1-phosphate.

name: hyaluronan synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-D-glucuronate + UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine = [beta-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-(1->4)-beta-D-glucuronosyl-(1->3)](n) + 2n UDP.

name: cis-zeatin O-beta-D-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-zeatin + UDP-D-glucose = O-beta-D-glucosyl-cis-zeatin + H+ + UDP.

name: trehalose 6-phosphate phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trehalose 6-phosphate + phosphate = glucose 6-phosphate + beta-D-glucose 1-phosphate.

name: mannosyl-3-phosphoglycerate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phospho-D-glycerate + GDP-alpha-D-mannose = 2-(alpha-D-mannosyl)-3-phosphoglycerate + GDP + H+.

name: hydroquinone glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydroquinone + UDP-D-glucose = H+ + hydroquinone O-beta-D-glucopyranoside + UDP.

name: vomilenine glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-D-glucose + vomilenine = H+ + raucaffricine + UDP.

name: indoxyl-UDPG glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: indoxyl + UDP-D-glucose = H+ + indican + UDP.

name: glucuronosyl-N-acetylglucosaminyl-proteoglycan 4-alpha-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-O-{[(1->4)-beta-D-GlcA-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc](n)-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcA-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-beta-D-Xyl}-L-seryl-[protein] + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine = 3-O-{alpha-D-GlcNAc-[(1->4)-beta-D-GlcA-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc](n)-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcA-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-beta-D-Xyl}-L-seryl-[protein] + H+ + UDP.

name: N-acetylglucosaminyl-proteoglycan 4-beta-glucuronosyltransferase activity
