name: amino acid:monoatomic cation antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: solute(out) + monoatomic cation(in) = solute(in) + monoatomic cation(out). Monoatomic cations include H+, Mg2+, Ca2+, etc.

name: ATP-dependent H2AZ histone chaperone activity
definition: A histone chaperone that mediates the exchange of histone H2A-H2B dimer and histone H2AZ-H2B dimers in a nucleosome, driven by ATP hydrolysis. Some chaperones insert H2AZ-H2B dimers and remove H2A-H2B, while others do the opposite.

name: histone H2B C-terminal K residue ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to a histone 2B at the conserved C-terminal lysine (K) residue. The last K residue is at position 119 in fission yeast, 123 in budding yeast, and 120 in mammals.

name: histone H3K14 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to histone 3 at the lysine-14 residue.

name: histone ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of ubiquitin to a histone substrate.

name: cholesterol-protein transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholesterol + glycyl-L-cysteinyl-[protein] + H+ = [protein]-C-terminal glycyl cholesterol ester + N-terminal L-cysteinyl-[protein].

name: histone H3S57 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3-serine (position 57) + ATP = histone H3-phosphoserine (position 57) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the serine residue at position 57 of histone H3.

name: histone H2AK13 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to histone 2A at the lysine-13 residue.

name: histone H3T45 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3-threonine (position 45) + ATP = histone H3-phosphothreonine (position 45) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the threonine residue at position 45 of histone H3.

name: histone H2AK15 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to histone 2A at the lysine-15 residue.

name: pterocarpan synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + medicarpin = 4'-methoxyisoflavan-2',4,7-triol.

name: (3R)-2'-hydroxyisoflavanone reductase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a (3R,4R)-4,2'-dihydroxyisoflavan + NADP+ = a (3R)-2'-hydroxyisoflavanone + H+ + NADPH.

name: histone H2AK119 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to histone 2A at the lysine-119 residue.

name: histone H2AK127 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to histone 2A at the lysine-127 residue.

name: histone H2AK129 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to histone 2A at the lysine-129 residue.

name: miRNA inhibitor activity via base-pairing
definition: Stops, prevents or reduces the activity of miRNA-mediated gene silencing activity by base-pairing with a target miRNA. An example of this activity is mediated by long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs).

name: RNA polymerase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of RNA polymerase.

name: repressor of RNA polymerase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of an RNA polymerase inhibitor.

name: H1 histone chaperone activity
definition: A histone chaperone that carries a H1 histone.

name: sodium,bicarbonate:chloride antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction chloride(in) + 2 hydrogencarbonate(out) + Na+(out) = chloride(out) + 2 hydrogencarbonate(in) + Na+(in).

name: neutral amino acid, sodium:proton antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: H+(in) + amino acid(out) + Na+(out) = H+(out) + amino acid(in) + Na+(in).

name: mechanoreceptor activity
definition: Combining with a mechanical force and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity or state as part of signal transduction.

name: chloride:bicarbonate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: chloride(in) + HCO3-(out) = chloride(out) + HCO3-(in).

name: L-asparagine:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: L-asparagine(out) + Na+(out) = L-asparagine(in) + Na+(in).

name: L-glutamine:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: L-glutamine(out) + Na+(out) = L-glutamine(in) + Na+(in).

name: histone H3R26 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + (histone H3)-arginine (position 26) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + (histone H3)-N-methyl-arginine (position 26). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the arginine residue at position 26 of histone H3.

name: haloperoxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: R-CH + a halogen + H2O2 = R-C-halogen + H2O.

name: halogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: R-CH + a halogen + oxygen donor = R-C-halogen +H2O.

name: flavin-dependent halogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: R-CH + a halogen + FADH2 + O2 = R-C-halogen + FAD + H2O.

name: histone H3K122 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H3 L-lysine (position 122) = CoA + histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 122).

name: pore-forming activity
definition: An activity in which a protein is inserted into the membrane of another cell where it forms transmembrane pores. Pores disrupts the integrity of the cell membrane, resulting in deregulated ion homeostasis, cellular dysfunction, and can result in cell death.

name: membrane destabilizing activity
definition: Binding to a membrane and increasing its permeability. This may lead to cell membrane lysis and cell content release.

name: L-kynurenine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-kynurenine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: cyclic-di-GMP transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of cyclic-di-GMP from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: mannose:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-mannose(out) + Na+(out) = D-mannose(in) + Na+(in).

name: fructose:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-fructose(out) + Na+(out) = D-fructose(in) + Na+(in).

name: neutral L-amino acid:sodium:chloride symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: neutral L-amino acid(out) + Na+(out) + Cl-(out) = neutral L-amino acid(in) + Na+(in)+ Cl-(in).

name: 5'-(N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-[mRNA] diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-end (N2,N2,N7-trimethyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA + H2O = a 5'-end diphospho-ribonucleoside in mRNA + 2 H+ + N7-methyl-GMP. Can also use (N7-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA as a substrate.

name: 5'-(N(7)-methylguanosine 5'-triphospho)-[mRNA] hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-end (N7-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA + H2O = a 5'-end phospho-ribonucleoside in mRNA + N7-methyl-GDP + H+.

name: histone deubiquitinase activity
definition: A deubiquitinase that cleaves ubiquitin from a histone protein to which it is conjugated.

name: histone H2B conserved C-terminal lysine deubiquitinase activity
definition: A histone deubiquitinase that cleaves ubiquitin from the conserved C-terminal lysine residue of a histone H2B protein to which it is conjugated. The conserved lysine residue is K119 in fission yeast, K123 in budding yeast, and K120 in mammals.

name: histone H2B deubiquitinase activity
definition: A histone deubiquitinase that cleaves ubiquitin from a histone H2B protein to which it is conjugated.

name: histone H4K12 deacetylase activity, hydrolytic mechanism
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 12) + H2O = histone H4 L-lysine (position 12) + acetate. This reaction represents the removal of an acetyl group from lysine at position 12 of the histone H4 protein.

name: histone H3 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a histone H3 = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a methylated histone H3. Histone methylation generally occurs on either an arginine or a lysine residue.

name: histone H4 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a histone H4 = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a methylated histone H4. Histone methylation generally occurs on either an arginine or a lysine residue.

name: histone H2A methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a histone H2 = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a methylated histone H2A. Histone methylation generally occurs on either an arginine or a lysine residue.

name: histone H4K20me methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-methyl-L-lysyl(20)-[histone H4] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(6),N(6)-dimethyl-L-lysyl(20)-[histone H4] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the monomethylated lysine residue at position 20 of histone H4, producing H4K20me2.

name: histone H3K9 dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of two methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 9 of histone H3, producing histone H3K9me2.

name: histone H4K20 trimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl(20)-[histone H4] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N(6),N(6),N(6)-trimethyl-L-lysyl(20)-[histone H4] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of three methyl groups to the lysine residue at position 20 of the histone H4 protein, producing histone H4K20me3.

name: histone H4K20 monomethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl20-[histone H4] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6-methyl-L-lysyl20-[histone H4] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 20 of histone H4, producing histone H4K20me.

name: histone H3K4 monomethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6-methyl-L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a single methyl group to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 4 of histone H3, producing histone H3K4me.

name: histone H3K4 dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of two methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 4 of histone H3, producing histone H3K4me2.

name: histone H3K9me2 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a single methyl group to the dimethylated lysine residue at position 9 of histone H3, producing histone H3K9me3.

name: histone H3K9 monomethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6-methyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 9 of histone H3, producing histone H3K9me.

name: histone H3K9 trimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of three methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 9 of histone H3, producing histone H3K9me3.

name: histone H2A deubiquitinase activity
definition: A histone deubiquitinase that cleaves ubiquitin from a histone H2A protein to which it is conjugated.

name: histone H3K27 trimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of three methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 27 of histone H3, producing histone H3K27me3.

name: histone H3K27 dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of two methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 27 of histone H3, producing histone H3K27me2.

name: histone H3K27 monomethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6-methyl-L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a single methyl group to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 27 of histone H3, producing histone H3K27me.

name: histone H3K36 dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl36-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl36-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of two methyl groups to the lysine residue at position 36 of histone H3, producing histone H3K36me2.

name: histone H3K36 trimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl36-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl36-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of three methyl groups to the lysine residue at position 36 of histone H3, producing histone H3K36me3.

name: histone H3K79 trimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of up to three methyl group to the lysine residue at position 79 of the histone H3 protein, producing H3K79me3.

name: polyspecific organic cation:proton antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of various organic cations in exchange for a proton, according to the reaction: H+(out) + organic cation(in) = H+(in) + organic cation(out). The transported substrates are usually toxic molecules, drugs and xenobiotics.

name: mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit binding
definition: Binding to a mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit.

name: medium-chain fatty acid omega-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an omega-methyl-medium-chain fatty acid + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = an omega-hydroxy-medium-chain fatty acid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]. A medium-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 6 to 12 carbons.

name: calcium:manganese antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Ca2+(in) + Mn2+(out) = Ca2+(out) + Mn2+(in).

name: histone H4K12 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H4 L-lysine (position 12) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H4 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 12). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the lysine residue at position 12 of the histone H4 protein.

name: G protein-coupled chemorepellent receptor activity
definition: Combining with a chemorepellent and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: ATP:phosphate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of ATP from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP(out) + phosphate(in) = ATP(in) + phosphate(out).

name: ADP:phosphate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of ADP from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ADP(out) + phosphate(in) = ADP(in) + phosphate(out).

name: 7-deoxyloganate 7-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7-deoxyloganate + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = H+ + H2O + loganate + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase].

name: histone modifying activity
definition: A catalytic activity that acts on a histone protein. Reversible histone modifications contribute to regulation of gene expression.

name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat modifying activity
definition: A catalytic activity that acts on the RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat (consensus YSPTSPS). Reversible modifications cof the RNA polymerase II CTD repeats contribute to regulation of RNA polymerase activity.

name: histone H2A kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone H2A.

name: histone H3 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone H3.

name: histone H4 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone H4.

name: histone H2B kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone H2B.

name: histone H3K4 trimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of three methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 4 of histone H3, producing histone H3K4me3.

name: histone H4K91 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to histone 4 at the lysine-91 residue.

name: histone H4K16 propionyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4 L-lysine (position 16) + propionyl-CoA = CoA + H+ + histone H3 N6-propionyl-L-lysyl (position 16).

name: histone H2AX kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone variant H2AX.

name: G/T mismatch-specific thymine-DNA glycosylase activity
definition: Hydrolyzes mismatched double-stranded DNA and polynucleotides, releasing free thymine and leaving an apyrimidinic (AP) site.

name: CTP-dependent diacylglycerol kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + CTP = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate + CDP + H+.

name: phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K).

name: phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and decreases the activity of a phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K).

name: very-long-chain 3-oxoacyl-CoA reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a very-long-chain (3R)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA + NADP+ = a very-long-chain 3-oxoacyl-CoA + H+ + NADPH. This reaction is the second (reduction) step of the four-step fatty acid elongation cycle in the endoplasmic reticulum that extends fatty acids of C-16 or longer with an additional 2-C unit.

name: Atg8-family conjugating enzyme activity
definition: Isoenergetic transfer of an Atg8 family modifier from one protein to a phosphatidylethanolamine or phosphatidylserine on a membrane, via the reaction X-Atg8 + Y = Y-Atg8 + X.

name: molecular tag activity
definition: A molecular function exhibited by a protein that is covalently attached (AKA tagged or conjugated) to another molecule (for example a protein or a lipid) where it acts as a marker, recognized by the cellular apparatus to target the tagged protein for some cellular process such as modification, sequestration, transport or degradation.

name: membrane tag activity
definition: A molecular function exhibited by a protein that is covalently attached (AKA tagged or conjugated) to a lipid, where it acts as a marker for a membrane, recognized by the cellular apparatus to target the tagged protein for some cellular process such as autophagy.

name: protein-glutathione oxidoreductase (glutathione) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glutathionylated protein (PSSG) + glutathione (GSH) = protein-thiol (PSH) + glutathione disulfide (GSSG). The reaction may proceed via a 'monothiol' or 'dithiol' mechanism.

name: histone H3K deacetylase activity
definition: Removal of an acetyl group from a lysine residue in a histone H3.

name: histone H4K deacetylase activity
definition: Removal of an acetyl group from a lysine residue in a histone H4.

name: histone H3 demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a modified lysine residue of the histone H3 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate.

name: histone H2A ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of ubiquitin to a histone H2A substrate.

name: histone H2B ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of ubiquitin to a histone H2B substrate.

name: histone H3 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of ubiquitin to a histone H3 substrate.

name: histone H4 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of ubiquitin to a histone H4 substrate.

name: histone H3 arginine deiminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + histone H3 L-arginyl = histone H3 L-citrullyl + NH4+, resulting in histone H3 citrullination.

name: histone H4 demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a modified lysine residue of the histone H4 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate.

name: receptor ligand inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and decreases the activity of the ligand of a signaling receptor.

name: glucose sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of glucose.

name: protein serine pyrophosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein phospho-serine + inositol 5-triphosphate pentakisphosphate = protein diphospho-serine + inositol 5-diphosphate pentakisphosphate.

name: 5-amino-6-(D-ribitylamino)uracil--L-tyrosine 4-hydroxyphenyl transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-amino-6-(D-ribitylamino)uracil + L-tyrosine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2-iminoacetate + 5'-deoxyadenosine + 5-amino-5-(4-hydroxybenzyl)-6-(D-ribitylimino)-5,6-dihydrouracil + H+ + L-methionine.

name: DNA loop anchor binding
definition: Binding to a DNA loop anchor, a region of chromosome that defines the ends of a DNA loop where two parts of same DNA strand are held in close physical proximity. For example, in animals, the anchors of DNA loops are convergently oriented CTCF binding sites during interphase.

name: ligand-modulated transcription repressor activity
definition: A DNA-binding transcription repressor activity regulated by binding to a ligand and that inhibits the transcription of specific genes and gene sets.

name: ligand-modulated transcription activator activity
definition: A DNA-binding transcription activator activity regulated by binding to a ligand and that activates the transcription of specific genes and gene sets.

name: tRNA (cytidine(34)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cytidine(34) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylcytidine(34) in tRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA (guanine(18)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + guanosine 18 in tRNA= S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 2'-O-methylguanosine 18 in tRNA + H+.

name: tRNA(Ser) (uridine(44)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + uridine44 in tRNASer = 2'-O-methyluridine44 in tRNASer + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA (5-carboxymethylaminomethyluridine(34)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-carboxymethylaminomethyluridine34 in tRNA(Leu) + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-carboxymethylaminomethyl-2'-O-methyluridine34 in tRNA(Leu) + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA methyltransferase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a methyltransferase.

name: methyltransferase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of a methyltransferase.

name: transporter regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of a transporter.

name: transporter activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a transporter.

name: transporter inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents, or reduces the activity of a transporter.

name: nitric oxide dioxygenase activity, heme protein as donor
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Fe(II)-heme b-[protein] + nitric oxide + O2 = Fe(III)-heme b-[protein] + nitrate.

name: nitrogen-oxygen lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the breakage of a nitrogen-oxygen bond by means other than hydrolysis and oxidation.

name: tRNA-queuosine(34) galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: queuosine34 in tRNA + UDP-alpha-D-galactose = H+ + O-5''-beta-D-galactosylqueuosine34 in tRNATyr + UDP. Substrates include tRNA(Tyr) and tRNA(Asp).

name: short-chain fatty acyl-CoA hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a short-chain fatty acyl-CoA + H2O = a short fatty acid + CoA + H+. A short-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail of less than 6 carbons.

name: DNA N6-methyladenine demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + an N6-methyl-2'-deoxyadenosine in DNA + O2 = a 2'-deoxyadenosine in DNA + CO2 + formaldehyde + succinate.

name: diphthine methyl ester synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-[(3S)-amino-3-carboxypropyl]-L-histidyl-[translation elongation factor 2] + 4 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = diphthine methyl ester-[translation elongation factor 2] + 3 H+ + 4 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: intracellularly calcium-gated channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a solute by a channel that opens when calcium ions bind on the intracellular side of the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: enoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2,3-saturated acyl-[ACP] + NADP+ = a (2E)-enoyl-[ACP] + H+ + NADPH.

name: glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + sn-glycerol 3-phosphate = dihydroxyacetone phosphate + H+ + NADH.

name: glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: NADP+ + sn-glycerol 3-phosphate = dihydroxyacetone phosphate + H+ + NADPH.

name: glucosinolate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a glucosinolate across a membrane.

name: receptor clustering activity
definition: A protein-protein adaptor that acts as a platform for receptor clustering, often serving to amplify the sensitivity of a signaling response.

name: dsDNA-RNA triple helix-forming chromatin adaptor activity
definition: A chromatin-protein adaptor activity that bridges dsDNA and chromatin proteins to bring regions of a chromosome in proximity. The DNA:DNA:RNA triple-helical structure is formed non-Watson-Crick base-pairing.

name: UFM1-modified protein reader activity
definition: A molecular adaptor recognizes and binds a target protein containing a UFM1 modification and brings the target protein into contact with another protein to allow those proteins to function in a coordinated way.

name: ATP:ATP adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 ATP + H+ = diphosphate + P(1),P(4)-bis(5'-adenosyl)tetraphosphate.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-enyl-diphosphate synthase activity (flavodoxin)
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-enyl diphosphate + 2 H+ + H2O + oxidized [flavodoxin] = 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclic diphosphate + reduced [flavodoxin].

name: UTP thiamine diphosphokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UTP + thiamine = UMP + thiamine diphosphate.

name: peptide lactyltransferase (ATP-dependent) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: lactate + ATP + L-lysyl-[protein] = N(6)-lactoyl-L-lysyl-[protein]+ AMP + diphosphate. Can also act on free lactate.

name: NAD-dependent protein lysine delactylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-lactoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD = L-lysyl-[protein] + nicotinamide +2''-O-lactoyl-ADP-D-ribose, transfering a lactoyl group attached to a lysine residue in a protein to NAD.

name: N-acetyltaurine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyltaurine + H2O = acetate + taurine.

name: NAD-dependent protein lysine deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N6-acyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ + H2O = 2''-O-acyl-ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide + L-lysyl-[protein].

name: histone deacetylase activity, hydrolytic mechanism
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-acetyl-L-lysyl-[histone] = acetate + L-lysyl-[histone].

name: histone H3K4 deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 14) + NAD+ + H2O = histone H3 L-lysine (position 14) + 2''-O-acetyl-ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide. This reaction transfers an acetyl group attached to a lysine residue in H3K4 to NAD, producing nicotinamide.

name: cysteine synthase activity, acting on O-succinyl-L-serine
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydrogen sulfide + O-succinyl-L-serine = L-cysteine + succinate.

name: oxidised low-density lipoprotein particle receptor activity
definition: Combining with an oxidised low-density lipoprotein particle and delivering the oxidised low-density lipoprotein particle into the cell via endocytosis.

name: structural constituent of synapse-associated extracellular matrix
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the extracellular matrix of the perisynaptic space (the extracellular space adjacent to the synapse) and the synaptic cleft.

name: ADP-D-ribose modification-dependent protein binding
definition: Binding to a protein upon ADP-ribosylation of the target protein.

name: mono-ADP-D-ribose modification-dependent protein binding
definition: Binding to a protein upon mono-ADP-ribosylation of the target protein.

name: poly-ADP-D-ribose modification-dependent protein binding
definition: Binding to a protein upon poly-ADP-ribosylation of the target protein.

name: protein decrotonylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] = (2E)-2-butenoate + L-lysyl-[protein].

name: histone decrotonylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[histone] = (2E)-2-butenoate + L-lysyl-[histone].

name: protein de-2-hydroxyisobutyrylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2-hydroxyisobutanoyl)-L-lysyl-[protein] = 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanoate + L-lysyl-[protein].

name: NAD-dependent protein decrotonylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2E)-but-2-enoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[protein] + nicotinamide.

name: histone decrotonylase activity, NAD-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[histone] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2E)-but-2-enoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[histone] + nicotinamide.

name: NAD-dependent protein de-2-hydroxyisobutyrylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2-hydroxyisobutanoyl)-L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2-hydroxyisobutanoyl)-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[protein] + nicotinamide.

name: CCACCA tRNA nucleotidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a tRNA with a 3' CCA end + 2 CTP + ATP = a tRNA with a 3' CCACCA end + 3 diphosphate.

name: serotonin-gated chloride channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a chloride ion by a channel that opens when the biogenic amine serotonin has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts. Serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine) is a neurotransmitter and hormone found in vertebrates and invertebrates.

name: neuropeptide activity
definition: The receptor ligand activity of any polypeptide expressed in, and secreted from a neuron.

name: purine nucleotide uniporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the active transport of purine nucleotides across a membrane by a mechanism involving conformational change, where energy for active transport is derived from membrane potential if the solute is charged.

name: sulfate:chloride antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: chloride(in) + sulfate(out) = chloride(out) + sulfate(in).

name: oxalate:chloride antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: chloride(out) + oxalate(in) = chloride(in) + oxalate(out).

name: muramyl dipeptide kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + muramyl dipeptide = ADP + H+ + 6-O-phospho-muramyl dipeptide.

name: xanthine binding
definition: Binding to xanthine, a purine base.

name: serine-based site-specific recombinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the formation of new phosphodiester bonds between a pair of short, unique DNA target sequences; occurs through a phosphoseryl intermediate in which the target sequence is first cleaved by the nucleophilic attack by a serine in the active site.

name: ubiquitin ligase complex scaffold activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together an ubiquitin ligase and an ubiquitin ligase-substrate adaptor, permitting those molecules to function in a coordinated way.

name: G protein-coupled glycine receptor activity
definition: Combining with glycine and transmitting the signal across the membrane by changing the activity of intracellular G protein signaling.

name: ABC-type indole transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + indole(in) = ADP + phosphate + indole(out).

name: iodide channel activity
definition: Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of iodide through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel.

name: hypoxia-inducible factor-proline dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + L-prolyl-[hypoxia-inducible factor alpha subunit] + O2 = CO2 + succinate + trans-4-hydroxy-L-prolyl-[hypoxia-inducible factor alpha subunit].

name: internal N(7)-methylguanine-containing RNA reader activity
definition: A protein adaptor that recognizes and binds an RNA molecule modified by N(7)-methylguanine (m7G), a modification present at internal sites of mRNAs and some non-coding RNAs.

name: internal mRNA (guanine-N7-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a guanosine in mRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = an N(7)-methylguanosine in mRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: reverse gyrase activity
definition: Catalysis of a DNA topological transformation by transiently cleaving one DNA strand at a time to allow passage of another strand; changes the linking number by +1 per catalytic cycle, is driven by ATP hydrolysis.

name: tRNA (guanine(10)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(10) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(10) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA (guanine(10)-N2)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(10) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(2)-methylguanosine(10) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA (guanine(26)-N2/guanine(27)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(26)/guanosine(27) in tRNA + 4 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 4 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(26)/N(2)-dimethylguanosine(27) in tRNA + 4 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA (guanine(26)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:guanosine(26) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(26) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA (adenine(22)-N1)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine(22) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(1)-methyladenosine(22) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA (adenine(9)-N1)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine(9) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(1)-methyladenosine(9) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA (adenine(58)-N1)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine(58) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(1)-methyladenosine(58) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA (guanine(6)-N2)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(6) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(2)-methylguanosine(6) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: tRNA (guanine(7)-N2)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(7) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(2)-methylguanosine(7) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: bis(monoacylglycero)phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 3-acyl-sn-glycero-1-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) = 3-acyl-sn-glycero-1-phospho-(3'-acyl-1'-sn-glycerol) + sn-glycero-1-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol).

name: structural constituent of nuclear lamina
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of nuclear lamina.

name: guanyl nucleotide exchange factor activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a guanyl nucleotide exchange factor.

name: pH-gated sodium channel activity
definition: A gated channel activity that enables the transmembrane transfer of a sodium ion by a channel that opens in response to a change in pH.

name: pH-gated calcium channel activity
definition: A gated channel activity that enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion by a channel that opens in response to a change in pH.

name: pH-gated monoatomic ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an inorganic ion by a channel that opens in response to a change in proton concentration (pH).

name: protein-DNA covalent cross-linking activity
definition: Catalysis of the cross-link between a protein and a DNA abasic site, forming a thiazolidine linkage between a DNA ring-opened abasic site and the alpha-amino and sulfhydryl substituents of cysteine residue of the protein.

name: bicarbonate channel activity
definition: Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of bicarbonate through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel.

name: protein-RNA sequence-specific adaptor activity
definition: A protein adaptor activity characterized by the capacity to selectively recognize and interact with RNA molecules in a sequence-specific manner. Entities possessing this activity typically exhibit discerning binding preferences for specific nucleotide sequences within RNA molecules, enabling the identification and engagement of distinct RNA motifs or structural elements. This function is integral to various biological processes, including RNA processing, transport, and regulatory mechanisms, contributing to the specificity and precision of cellular RNA-related activities.

name: 16S rRNA pseudouridine(516) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(516) in 16S rRNA = pseudouridine(516) in 16S rRNA.

name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(2457) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(2457) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(2457) in 23S rRNA.

name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(2604) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(2604) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(2604) in 23S rRNA.

name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(2605) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(2605) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(2605) in 23S rRNA.

name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(1911/1915/1917) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(1911/1915/1917) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(1911/1915/1917) in 23S rRNA.

name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(955/2504/2580) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(955/2504/2580) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(955/2504/2580) in 23S rRNA.

name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(746) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(746) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(746) in 23S rRNA.

name: 21S rRNA pseudouridine(2819) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(2819) in 21S rRNA = pseudouridine(2819) in 21S rRNA.

name: tRNA pseudouridine(38-40) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(38/39/40) in tRNA = pseudouridine(38/39/40) in tRNA. Modifies uridine(38), uridine(39) and/or uridine(40) in tRNA.

name: tRNA pseudouridine(55) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(55) in tRNA = pseudouridine(55) in tRNA.

name: tRNA pseudouridine(65) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(65) in tRNA = pseudouridine(65) in tRNA.

name: tRNA pseudouridine(13) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(13) in tRNA = pseudouridine(13) in tRNA.

name: tRNA pseudouridine(32) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(32) in tRNA = pseudouridine(32) in tRNA.

name: tRNA pseudouridine(31) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(31) in tRNA = pseudouridine(31) in tRNA.

name: mitochondrial tRNA pseudouridine(27/28) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(27/28) in mitochondrial tRNA = pseudouridine(27/28) in mitochondrial tRNA.

name: tRNA pseudouridine(38/39) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(38/39) in tRNA = pseudouridine(38/39) in tRNA. Modifies uridine(38) and/or uridine(39) in tRNA.

name: S-nitrosoglutathione reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADPH + S-nitrosoglutathione = NADP+ + S-(hydroxysulfenamide)glutathione.

name: 2-oxoadipate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoadipate + H+ + N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue succinyltransferase] = CO2 + N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-glutaryldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue succinyltransferase].

name: histamine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of histamine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: dipeptide uniporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the transport of a dipeptide across a membrane; transport is independent of the movement of any other molecular species.

name: nitrate reductase (quinone) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a quinol + nitrate = a quinone + H2O + nitrite.

name: autophagosome-membrane adaptor activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a target membrane and an autophagosome membrane during autophagy.

name: phospholipase C activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of the enzyme phospholipase C.

name: phospholipase C inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of the enzyme phospholipase C.

name: paracellular tight junction channel activity
definition: Enables size- and charge-selective transport of solutes through a tight junction barrier paracellularly, across the epithelium.

name: peroxisome-mitochondrion membrane tether activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together the peroxisome membrane and the mitochondrial outer membrane, establishing the localization of the peroxisome close to the mitochondrion.

name: steroid 22S-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a C28-steroid + O2 + reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase = a (22S)-22-hydroxy C28-steroid + H+ + H2O + oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase. Also catalyzes the C-22 hydroxylation of a variety of C27 and C29 steroids.

name: L-lactate dehydrogenase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of L-lactate dehydrogenase.

name: polyprenol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a di-trans,poly-cis-polyprenol + NAD+ = a di-trans,poly-cis-polyprenal + NADH + H+.

name: dolichal reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + NADP+ = a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichal + NADPH + H+.

name: polyprenal reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ditrans,polycis-polyprenal+ H+ + NADPH = ditrans,polycis-dolichal+ NADP.

name: mitochondrion-mitochondrion outer membrane tether activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together two mitochondrion membranes via membrane lipid binding or by interacting with a mitochondrial outer membrane protein, to establish or maintain the localization of the mitochondrion.

name: cysteine-dependent adenosine diphosphate thiazole synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [ADP-thiazole synthase]-L-cysteine + glycine + NAD(+) = [ADP-thiazole synthase]-dehydroalanine + ADP-5-ethyl-4-methylthiazole-2-carboxylate + 2 H(+) + 3 H2O + nicotinamide.

name: tRNA (cytidine(32)/uridine(32)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cytidine(32)/uridine(32) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylcytidine(32)/2'-O-methyluridine(32) in tRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: L-serine O-succinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + succinyl-CoA = CoA + O-succinyl-L-serine.

name: glycine-gated cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a cation by a channel that opens when glycine is bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts on the extracellular side of the plasma membrane.

name: endoplasmic reticulum-plasma membrane adaptor activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a plasma membrane with an endoplasmic reticulum membrane, via membrane lipid binding, to establish membrane contact sites and mediate exchange and communication.

name: deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: R-CO-X + H2O = R-COOH + HX, hydrolysis of an acyl group or groups from a substrate molecule.

name: protein lysine delactylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-lactoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] = (S)-lactate + L-lysyl-[protein].

name: D-alanine-(R)-lactate ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactate + ATP + D-alanine = ADP + D-alanyl-(R)-lactate + phosphate.

name: D-alanine-D-serine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-alanine + D-serine = ADP + D-alanyl-D-serine + H+ + phosphate.

name: 3-demethoxyubiquinone 3-hydroxylase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5-methoxy-2-methyl-3-(all-trans-polyprenyl)benzoquinone + NADH + O2 = a 3-demethylubiquinone + NAD+ + H2O.

name: G-quadruplex unwinding activity
definition: Unwinding G-quadruplex structures in nucleic acids. A G-quadruplex is a specialized structure formed in DNA/RNA when sequences rich in guanine (G) assemble into a unique four-stranded arrangement.

name: bile acid-gated sodium channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a sodium ion by a channel that opens when bile acid has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: peroxisome-endoplasmic reticulum membrane tether activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a peroxisome membrane and an ER membrane, either via membrane lipid binding or by interacting with a membrane protein.

name: U6 snRNA (guanine-N(2))-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine in U6 snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(2)-methylguanosine in U6 snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: valine sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of valine.

name: tRNA 5-taurinomethyluridine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + taurine + GTP + H2O + uridine34 in tRNA + A = 7,8-dihydrofolate + GDP + phosphate + 5-taurinomethyluridine34 in tRNA + H+ + AH2.

name: D-Ala-D-Ala dipeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-alanyl-D-alanine + H2O = 2 D-alanine.

name: long-chain fatty aldehyde oxidative decarbonylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] + O2 + a long-chain fatty aldehyde = oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] + CO2 + H2O + H+ + a long-chain alkane.

name: cardiolipin dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a cardiolipin + NAD+ = a diphosphatidylglycerone + NADH + H+.

name: phosphatidylglycerol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) + NAD+ = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerone) + NADH + H+.

name: histone H1 demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a modified lysine residue of the histone H1 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate.

name: NADPH-iron-sulfur [2Fe-2S] protein oxidoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[protein] + NADPH = 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[protein] + NADP+ + H+.

name: autophagy cargo adaptor activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a cargo, targeted for degradation via autophagy, to a phagophore.

name: tRNA (guanine(27)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(27) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(27) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: protein asparagine deamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-asparaginyl-[protein] + H2O = L-aspartyl-[protein] + NH4+.

name: histone H1 asparagine deamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H1 L-asparagine + H2O = histone H1 L-aspartate + NH4+.

name: histone H1 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H1 = CoA + acetyl-histone H1.

name: histone H1K75 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H1 L-lysine (position 75) = CoA + histone H1 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 75).

name: histone H1N76/N77 asparagine deamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H1 L-asparagine [positions 76 and 77] + H2O = histone H1 L-aspartate [positions 76 and 77] + NH4+.

name: O-fucosylpeptide 3-beta-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a alpha-D-glucose residue from UDP-alpha-D-glucose to the fucose residue of a fucosylated protein acceptor.

name: histone H1K26me1 reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H1 monomethylated at lysine 26.

name: histone H1K26me2 reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H1 dimethylated at lysine 26.

name: phosphatidylserine-phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate exchange activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate)(out) + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(in) = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate)(in) + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(out). This reaction results in the exchange of phosphatidylserine (PS) for phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate (PI(4)P) between membranes.

name: RNA 2',3'-cyclic phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3'-end 2',3'-cyclophospho-ribonucleotide-RNA + 2 H2O = a 3'-end ribonucleotide-RNA + phosphate + H+.

name: RNA 2'-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + a 3'-end 2'-phospho-ribonucleotide-RNA = a 3'-end ribonucleotide-RNA + phosphate.

name: queuine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of queuine from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: queuine(out) = queuine(in).

name: queuosine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of queuosine from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: queuosine(out) = queuosine(in).

name: 2-oxoglutarate-dependent tRNA 5-methylcytidine formyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-methylcytidine(34) in mitochondrial tRNA(Met) + 2 2-oxoglutarate + 2 O2 = 5-formylcytidine(34) in mitochondrial tRNA(Met) + 2 succinate + 2 CO2 + H2O.

name: phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate-cholesterol exchange activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate)(out) + cholesterol(in) = 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate)(in) + cholesterol(out). This reaction results in the exchange of cholesterol for phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate (PI(4)P) between membranes.

name: cap-dependent translation initiation factor activity
definition: A translation initiation factor activity that enables the recognition and binding to the 7-methylguanosine cap structure at the 5' end of eukaryotic mRNAs, promoting ribosome recruitment and assembly and translation initiation in a cap-dependent manner.

name: IRES-mediated translation initiation factor activity
definition: A translation initiation factor activity that enables interaction with internal ribosome entry sites (IRESs) located within mRNA, promoting ribosome recruitment and assembly at internal initiation sites and translation initiation independent of the 5' cap structure.

name: pyridinol guanylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-carboxymethyl-3,5-dimethyl-4-hydroxypyridin-2-ol + GTP + H+ = guanylylpyridinol + diphosphate.

name: guanylylpyridinol adenylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanylylpyridinol + ATP + H+ = guanylylpyridinol-AMP + diphosphate.

name: 6-carboxymethyl-5-methyl-4-hydroxypyridin-2-ol 3-C-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-carboxymethyl-5-methyl-4-hydroxypyridin-2-ol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 6-carboxymethyl-3,5-dimethyl-4-hydroxypyridin-2-ol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

name: 4-vinylphenol methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-vinylphenol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 4-vinylanisole + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

name: succinate dehydrogenase (FAD) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: FAD + succinate + H+ = fumarate + FADH2.

name: lipoyl-dependent peroxiredoxin activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-dihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[lipoyl-carrier protein] + a hydroperoxide = N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[lipoyl-carrier protein] + an alcohol + H2O.

name: vesicle docking activity
definition: The binding activity of a protein that directly mediates the stable attachment of a transport vesicle to a target membrane, bringing the two membranes into close apposition.

name: ergothioneine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of ergothioneine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: heme B transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of heme B from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: lipoate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of lipoate from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: cyclic nucleotide phosphodiesterase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of cyclic nucleotide phosphodiesterase.

name: endoplasmic reticulum-lipid droplet tether activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a lipid droplet with an endoplasmic reticulum membrane, via membrane lipid binding, to establish membrane contact sites and mediate exchange and communication.

name: mRNA phosphatase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of mRNA phosphatase.

name: endoplasmic reticulum-organelle membrane tether activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together two membranes, either via membrane lipid binding or by interacting with a membrane protein, to establish or maintain membrane contact sites and mediate organelle exchange and communication.

name: stalled ribosome sensor activity
definition: A molecule that recognizes stalled ribosomes and initiates a signaling response.

name: histone H3K18 decrotonylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[histone H3 position 18] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2E)-but-2-enoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[histone H3] + nicotinamide.

name: carbon dioxide receptor activity
definition: Combining with carbon dioxide to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: endoplasmic reticulum-endosome tether activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together an endosome membrane and an ER membrane either via membrane lipid binding or by interacting with an endosome protein, to establish and facilitate organelle exchange.

name: ionotropic olfactory receptor activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a specific odorant has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: ionotropic taste receptor activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a soluble compound has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: ionotropic bitter taste receptor activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a specific bitter compound has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: ionotropic sweet taste receptor activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a specific soluble sweet compound has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: isopentenyl pyrophosphate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of isopentenyl pyrophosphate from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: nuclease activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a nuclease.

name: ribonuclease activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a ribonuclease.

name: lipid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a lipid from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: cholesterol 7-desaturase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholesterol + H+ + NAD(P)H + O2 = 7-dehydrocholesterol + 2 H2O + NAD(P)+.

name: RNA ligase (GTP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the joining of an RNA with 3'-phosphate or 2',3'-cyclic-phosphate ends to an RNA with 5'-hydroxy ends according to either (i) a 3'-end 3'-phospho-ribonucleotide-RNA + a 5'-end dephospho-ribonucleoside-RNA + GTP = a ribonucleotidyl-ribonucleotide-RNA + diphosphate + GMP; or (ii) a 3'-end 2',3'-cyclophospho-ribonucleotide-RNA + a 5'-end dephospho-ribonucleoside-RNA + GTP + H2O = a ribonucleotidyl-ribonucleotide-RNA + diphosphate + GMP + H+.

name: microtubule destabilizing activity
definition: A protein-containing complex destabilizing activity that promotes microtubule catastrophe (transition from microtubule growth to microtubule shrinkage).

name: nickel chaperone activity
definition: Directly binding to and delivering nickel ions to a target protein.

name: geranylgeranyltransferase type III activity
definition: Catalyzes the covalent addition of a geranylgeranyl group to a mono-farnesylated substrate via a thioether linkage to a cysteine residue located within a conserved C-terminal tandem cysteine motif (CCAIM or CCIIM) that is used in substrate recognition. Known substrates include mono-farnesylated Golgi SNARE proteins.

name: histone methyltransferase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a histone methyltransferase.

name: cyclic-di-AMP binding
definition: Binding to a cyclic di-AMP nucleotide.

name: S-adenosyl-L-methionine:S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine(out) + S-adenosyl-L-methionine(in) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine(in) + S-adenosyl-L-methionine(out).

name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat Y1 phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat--phospho-L-tyrosine (consensus YSPTSPS)(position 1) + H2O = RNA polymerase II large subunit + phosphate.

name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat T4 phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat--phospho-L-threonine (consensus YSPTSPS)(position 4) + H2O = RNA polymerase II large subunit + phosphate.

name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat S2 phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat--phospho-L-serine (consensus YSPTSPS)(position 2) + H2O = RNA polymerase II large subunit + phosphate.

name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat S5 phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat--phospho-L-serine (consensus YSPTSPS)(position 5) + H2O = RNA polymerase II large subunit + phosphate.

name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat S7 phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat--phospho-L-serine (consensus YSPTSPS)(position 7) + H2O = RNA polymerase II large subunit + phosphate.

name: broad specificity neutral L-amino acid:basic L-amino acid antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: basic L-amino acid(in) + neutral L-amino acid(out) = basic L-amino acid(in) + neutral L-amino acid(out).

name: lysophosphatidylserine flippase activity
definition: Catalysis of the movement of a lysophosphatidylserine from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP.

name: protein-tRNA adaptor activity
definition: The binding activity of a protein that brings together another protein and a tRNA, permitting those molecules to function in a coordinated way.

name: SUMO ligase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of a SUMO ligase.

name: K11-linked deubiquitinase activity
definition: Hydrolysis of a ubiquitin unit from a ubiquitinated protein linked via the Lys11 residue of ubiquitin.

name: membrane bending activity
definition: The activity of bending or deforming a membrane. This activity can occur by multiple mechanisms including the insertion amphipathic domains into one or both leaflets.

name: U6 snRNA 2'-O-ribose methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + U6 snRNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + U6 containing a 3'-terminal 2'-O-methylnucleotide + H+.

name: membrane grommet activity
definition: An activity in which a protein, or group of proteins, acts to restrict the size of a fenestration in a membrane or membrane system (i.e. restrict the diameter of a hole in a membrane). An example of this is the molecular function is performed by ESCRT-III proteins at the nuclear envelope of fission yeast during anaphase B.

name: inositol phosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: inositol phosphate + ATP = inositol phosphate + ADP.

name: histone H4K5 deacetylase activity, hydrolytic mechanism
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 5) + H2O = histone H4 L-lysine (position 5) + acetate. This reaction represents the removal of an acetyl group from lysine at position 5 of the histone H4 protein.

name: histone H4K8 deacetylase activity, hydrolytic mechanism
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 8) + H2O = histone H4 L-lysine (position 8) + acetate. This reaction represents the removal of an acetyl group from lysine at position 8 of the histone H4 protein.

name: dol-P-Man:GlcN-acyl-PI alpha-1,4-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-acyl-6-alpha-D-glucosaminyl-1-(1-radyl,2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho)-1D-myo-inositol + a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichyl beta-D-mannosyl phosphate = a 2-acyl-6-(alpha-D-mannosyl-(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosaminyl)-1-(1-radyl,2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho)-1D-myo-inositol + a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichyl phosphate + H+.

name: inositol pyrophosphate sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of an inositol pyrophosphate.

name: borate channel activity
definition: Enables the facilitated diffusion of borate (by an energy-independent process) involving passage through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel without evidence for a carrier-mediated mechanism.

name: protein-mitochondrial outer membrane tethering activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a protein or protein complex and a mitochondrial outer membrane lipid or membrane-associated protein, in order to maintain the localization of the protein, or protein complex at a specific mitochondrial outer membrane location.

name: translation factor activity
definition: A molecular function required for translation of a mRNA into a protein functioning as part of initiation, elongation or termination of translation.

name: ribosome translocase activity
definition: A motor activity that generates movement of a ribosome one codon forward along the mRNA, driven by GTP hydrolysis.

name: citrate:2-oxoglutarate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: citrate(out) + 2-oxogluarate(in) = citrate(in) + 2-oxogluarat(out).

name: mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit binding
definition: Binding to a mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit.

name: mitochondrial RNA polymerase general transcription initiation factor activity
definition: A general transcription initiation factor activity that contributes to transcription start site selection and transcription initiation by the mitochondrial RNA polymerase.

name: oligopeptide binding
definition: Binding to an oligopeptide.

name: ubiquinone-6 binding
definition: Binding to ubiquinone-6. Ubiquinone-6 is a ubiquinone compound having a (2E,6E,10E,14E,18E)-3,7,11,15,19,23-hexamethyltetracosa-2,6,10,14,18,22-hexaen-1-yl substituent at position 2.

name: salicylic acid binding
definition: Binding to salicylic acid.

name: (R)-carnitine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of (R)-carnitine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoate from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: ABC-type tungstate transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + tungstate(in) = ADP + phosphate + tungstate(out).

name: malonate(1-) transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of malonate(1-) from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of 4-hydroxyphenylacetate from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: ABC-type doxorubicin transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + doxorubicin(in) = ADP + phosphate + doxorubicin(out).

name: nucleoside phosphate binding
definition: Binding to nucleoside phosphate.

name: catecholamine binding
definition: Binding to catecholamine.

name: tungstate binding
definition: Binding to tungstate.

name: heterocyclic compound binding
definition: Binding to heterocyclic compound.

name: acetate ester transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of an acetate ester from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: azole transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the directed movement of azoles, heterocyclic compound found in many biologically important substances, from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: aminotriazole transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of amitrole from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: oleate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of oleate from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: carbohydrate derivative transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of carbohydrate derivative from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: lipo-chitin oligosaccharide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of lipo-chitin oligosaccharide from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: ATPase-coupled lipo-chitin oligosaccharide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + lipo-chitin oligosaccharide(in) = ADP + phosphate + lipo-chitin oligosaccharide(out).

name: poly-beta-1,6-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of poly-beta-1,6-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: hypochlorite binding
definition: Binding to hypochlorite.

name: fatty acid derivative binding
definition: Binding to fatty acid derivative.

name: tetrapeptide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of tetrapeptide from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: dethiobiotin binding
definition: Binding to dethiobiotin.

name: dethiobiotin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of dethiobiotin from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: phosphatidylglycerol binding
definition: Binding to phosphatidylglycerol.

name: cardiolipin binding
definition: Binding to cardiolipin.

name: XTP binding
definition: Binding to XTP.

name: ITP binding
definition: Binding to ITP.

name: sulfur compound binding

name: phosphatidic acid transfer activity

Phosphatidic acid refers to a glycophospholipids with, in general, a saturated fatty acid bonded to carbon-1, an unsaturated fatty acid bonded to carbon-2, and a phosphate group bonded to carbon-3.

name: DNA-5-methylcytosine glycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: DNA containing 5-methylcytosine + H2O = DNA with abasic site + 5-methylcytosine. This reaction is the hydrolysis of DNA by cleavage of the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the DNA 5-methylcytosine and the deoxyribose sugar to remove the 5-methylcytosine, leaving an abasic site.

name: thiazole synthase activity

name: RNA helicase inhibitor activity

name: flavonoid sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a flavonoid + 3'-phosphoadenosine-5'-phosphosulfate = sulfated flavonoid + adenosine-3',5'-diphosphate. This reaction is the transfer of a sulfate group to the hydroxyl group of a flavonoid acceptor, producing the sulfated flavonoid derivative.

name: linoleate 9S-lipoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: linoleate + O2 = (9S,10E,12Z)-9-hydroperoxy-10,12-octadecadienoate.

name: plant seed peroxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RH + ROOH = ROH + ROH.

name: talin binding
definition: Binding to a talin, a family of related cytoskeletal proteins that play a role in assembly of actin filaments and migration of various cell types.

name: histone H3K4 deacetylase activity, hydrolytic mechanism
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 4) + H2O = histone H3 L-lysine (position 4) + acetate. This reaction represents the removal of an acetyl group from lysine at position 4 of the histone H3 protein.

name: single-strand break-containing DNA binding

name: phosphodiesterase decapping endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of the cap from an unmethylated 5'-end capped RNA resulting in the release of the entire cap structure (GpppN) and a 5' monophosphorylated RNA.

name: EH domain binding
definition: Binding to an EH domain of a protein. The EH stand for Eps15 homology. This was originally identified as a motif present in three copies at the NH2-termini of Eps15 and of the related molecule Eps15R.

name: euchromatin binding

name: protein N-terminal-serine acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + N-terminal L-seryl-[protein] = CoA + H+ + N-terminal Nalpha-acetyl-L-seryl-[protein].

name: protein-N-terminal-glutamate acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + N-terminal L-glutamate in peptide = CoA + N-acetyl-L-glutamate-peptide.

name: jasmonyl-Ile conjugate hydrolase activity

name: histone H2AT120 kinase activity

name: N6-methyladenosine-containing RNA reader activity
definition: A protein adaptor that recognizes and binds an RNA molecule modified by N6-methyladenosine (m6A), a modification present at internal sites of mRNAs and some non-coding RNAs.

name: keratin filament binding
definition: Binding to a keratin filament, an intermediate filament composed of acidic and basic keratins (types I and II), typically expressed in epithelial cells.

name: histone H2AQ104 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamine(104)-[histone H2A] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(5)-methyl-L-glutamine(104)-[histone H2A] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+. Note that this corresponds to Q105 in yeast.

name: RNA polymerase II C-terminal domain phosphoserine binding

name: anti-Mullerian hormone receptor activity

name: preribosome binding

name: RNA 5'-gamma-phosphate methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to the 5'-gamma-phosphate in an RNA molecule.

name: cellulosome binding

name: type-I dockerin domain binding

name: type-II dockerin domain binding

name: type-III cohesin domain binding

name: glyoxalase (glycolic acid-forming) activity

name: protein arginine kinase activity

name: extracellular matrix protein binding

name: exon-exon junction complex binding
definition: Binding to an exon-exon junction complex, a protein complex deposited by the spliceosome upstream of messenger RNA exon-exon junctions. The exon-exon junction complex provides a binding platform for factors involved in mRNA export and nonsense-mediated mRNA decay.

name: linear polyubiquitin binding
definition: Binding to a linear polymer of ubiquitin. Linear ubiquitin polymers are formed by linking the amino-terminal methionine (M1) of one ubiquitin molecule to the carboxy-terminal glycine (G76) of the next.

name: lipooligosaccharide binding

name: transferrin receptor binding

name: leptin receptor binding

name: (2R)-hydroxyacid dehydrogenase (quinone) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a (2R)-2-hydroxycarboxylate + a quinone = a 2-oxocarboxylate + a quinol.

name: piRNA cluster binding
definition: Binding to piRNA clusters, double-stranded DNA regions that give rise to PIWI-interacting RNAs (piRNAs).

name: piRNA uni-strand cluster binding
definition: Binding to uni-strand piRNA clusters, double-stranded DNA regions that give rise to PIWI-interacting RNAs (piRNAs) that map predominantly to only one strand and exhibit hallmarks of canonical Pol II transcription. Uni-strand piRNA clusters are found in many taxa.

name: piRNA dual-strand cluster binding
definition: Binding to dual-strand piRNA clusters, double-stranded DNA regions that give rise to PIWI-interacting RNAs (piRNAs) where piRNAs originate from both DNA strands via noncanonical transcription.

name: sphingolipid alpha-glucuronosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucuronate + inositol phosphorylceramide (IPC) = UDP + GlcA-IPC.

name: single-stranded 3'-5' DNA helicase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate, in the presence of single-stranded DNA; drives the unwinding of the DNA helix in the direction 3' to 5'.

name: BIR domain binding

name: phospholipase D activator activity

name: hydroxyproline O-arabinosyltransferase activity

name: nascent polypeptide-associated complex binding

name: L-altrarate dehydratase activity

name: glutamate-cysteine ligase regulator activity

name: acetolactate synthase regulator activity

name: guanyl nucleotide exchange factor inhibitor activity

name: ErbB-4 class receptor binding

name: protein phosphatase 5 binding

name: inositol-2,4,5-triphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 2,4,5-trisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 2,4-bisphosphate + phosphate.

name: microtubule site clamp
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that attaches the spindle microtubules to the kinetochore.

name: inositol-4,5,6-triphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 4,5,6-trisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 4,6-bisphosphate + phosphate.

name: inositol-1,2,4,5-tetrakisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 1,2,4,5-tetrakisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1,2,4-trisphosphate + phosphate.

name: inositol-2,4,5,6-tetrakisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 2,4,5,6-tetrakisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 2,4,6-trisphosphate + phosphate.

name: inositol-1,2,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity

name: 4 iron, 3 sulfur cluster binding
