name: dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (fumarate) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-dihydroorotate + fumarate = orotate + succinate.

name: palmitoleoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a palmitoleoyl group, a 16-carbon monounsaturated fatty acid (C16:1), to an acceptor molecule.

name: palmitoleyl hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of a hydrolase reaction that removes a palmitoleyl moiety, a 16-carbon monounsaturated fatty acid (C16:1), from some substrate.

name: hydroxyproline O-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of galactose from UDP-galactose to hydroxyproline residues present in the peptide backbone.

name: mRNA CDS binding
definition: Binding to an mRNA molecule coding sequence (CDS).

name: cord factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with a cord factor, an M. tuberculosis cell wall glycolipid, and transmitting a signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: pseudouridine 5'-phosphatase activity

name: polynucleotide adenylyltransferase activator activity

name: ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity

name: ubiquitin ligase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a ubiquitin ligase.

name: osmolarity-sensing monoatomic cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a monoatomic cation by a channel that opens when a change in the osmolarity occurs in the extracellular space of the cell in which the cation channel resides.

name: arrestin family protein binding
definition: Binding to a member of the arrestin family, proteins involved in agonist-mediated desensitization of G protein-coupled receptors.

name: protein tyrosine kinase binding
definition: Binding to protein tyrosine kinase.

name: F-bar domain binding
definition: Binding to an F-BAR domain of a protein, a domain of about 60 residues that occurs in a wide range of cytoskeletal proteins.

name: DNA/DNA annealing activity
definition: An activity that facilitates the formation of a complementary double-stranded DNA molecule.

name: poly(A) RNA polymerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n)-3'-adenine ribonucleotide. The primer may be an RNA or DNA fragment, or oligo(A) bearing a 3'-OH terminal group.

name: sequence-specific mRNA binding

name: deaminase binding
definition: Binding to an enzyme that catalyzes the removal of an amino group from a substrate, producing ammonia (NH3).

name: C-rich single-stranded DNA binding
definition: Binding to C-rich, single-stranded DNA.

name: clathrin-uncoating ATPase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate. Catalysis of the removal of clathrin from vesicle membranes, coupled to the hydrolysis of ATP.

name: sequence-specific double-stranded DNA binding
definition: Binding to double-stranded DNA of a specific nucleotide composition, e.g. GC-rich DNA binding, or with a specific sequence motif or type of DNA, e.g. promotor binding or rDNA binding.

name: poly(U)-specific exoribonuclease activity, producing 3' uridine cyclic phosphate ends
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3'-end uridylyl-uridine-RNA = a 3'-end 2',3'-cyclophospho-uridine-RNA + uridine.

name: promoter-specific chromatin binding
definition: Binding to a section of chromatin that is associated with gene promoter sequences of DNA.

name: ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase.

name: methionyl-initiator methionine tRNA binding
definition: Binding to methionine-initiator methionine tRNA.

name: 18S rRNA cytidine N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a cytidine in 18S rRNA + acetyl-CoA + ATP + H2O = an N(4)-acetylcytidine in 18S rRNA + ADP + phosphate + CoA + H+.

name: 2-polyprenyl-6-hydroxyphenol O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-polyprenyl-6-hydroxyphenol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2-polyprenyl-6-methoxyphenol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

name: histone H4K20me3 reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H4 trimethylated at lysine 20.

name: netrin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a netrin receptor.

name: structural constituent of ascospore wall
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of an ascospore wall.

name: proteasome-nuclear membrane anchor activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a proteasome complex and a nuclear inner membrane, to maintain the nuclear membrane localization of the proteasome.

name: sulfoquinovosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 6-sulfo-alpha-D-quinovosyldiacylglycerol + H2O = 6-sulfo-alpha-D-quinovose + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol.

name: mRNA N1-methyladenosine dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the oxidative demethylation of N1-methyladenosine RNA, with concomitant decarboxylation of 2-oxoglutarate and releases oxidized methyl group on N1-methyladenosine as formaldehyde.

name: mRNA N6-methyladenosine dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the oxidative demethylation of N6-methyladenosine RNA, with concomitant decarboxylation of 2-oxoglutarate and releases oxidized methyl group on N6-methyladenosine as formaldehyde.

name: 5.8S rRNA binding
definition: Binding to 5.8S ribosomal RNA, a eukaryotic ribosomal RNA which forms a complex with 28S RNA.

name: splicing factor binding
definition: Binding to a protein involved in the process of removing sections of the primary RNA transcript to form the mature form of the RNA.

name: ubiquitin ligase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a ubiquitin ligase.

name: G-rich single-stranded DNA binding
definition: Binding to G-rich, single-stranded DNA.

name: cytosylglucuronate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cytosylglucuronic acid + H+ = cytosylarabinopyranose + CO2.

name: trans-activation response element binding
definition: Binding to a trans-activation response (TAR) element, a hairpin RNA structure located at the 5' end of all HIV-1 transcripts, and which is required for trans-activation of a viral promoter.

name: tRNA demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from one or more positions within a tRNA molecule.

name: xylan binding
definition: Binding to xylan.

name: glucomannan binding
definition: Binding to glucomannan.

name: cellooligosaccharide binding
definition: Binding to cellooligosaccharide.

name: mannan binding
definition: Binding to mannan.

name: amylopectin binding
definition: Binding to amylopectin.

name: pullulan binding
definition: Binding to pullulan.

name: arabinoxylan binding
definition: Binding to arabinoxylan.

name: glycogen binding
definition: Binding to glycogen.

name: starch binding
definition: Binding to starch.

name: maltoheptaose binding
definition: Binding to maltoheptaose.

name: galactomannan binding
definition: Binding to galactomannan.

name: cyclodextrin binding
definition: Binding to cyclodextrin.

name: (1->3),(1->4)-beta-glucan binding
definition: Binding to (1->3),(1->4)-beta-glucan.

name: (1->6)-beta-D-glucan binding
definition: Binding to (1->6)-beta-D-glucan.

name: beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-D-Glc binding
definition: Binding to beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-D-Glc.

name: chitosan binding
definition: Binding to chitosan.

name: (1->4)-beta-D-galactan binding
definition: Binding to (1->4)-beta-D-galactan.

name: inulin binding
definition: Binding to inulin.

name: alpha-D-glucan binding
definition: Binding to alpha-D-glucan.

name: L-arabinofuranose binding
definition: Binding to L-arabinofuranose.

name: arabinogalactan binding
definition: Binding to arabinogalactan.

name: camalexin binding
definition: Binding to camalexin.

name: quercitrin binding
definition: Binding to quercitrin.

name: sodium:ammonium:chloride symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: Na+(out) + NH4+(out) + Cl-(out) = Na+(in) + NH4+(in) + Cl-(in).

name: amino acid conjugated cholate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an L-alpha-amino acid + cholate = an N-choloyl-L-alpha-amino acid + H2O.

name: L-serine conjugated cholate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholate + L-serine = L-serocholate + H2O.

name: L-alanine conjugated cholate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholate + L-alanine = L-alanocholate + H2O.

name: L-phenylalanine conjugated cholate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholate + L-phenylalanine = L-phenylalanocholate + H2O.

name: L-arginine conjugated cholate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholate + L-arginine = L-arginocholate + H2O.

name: L-histidine conjugated cholate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholate + L-histidine = L-histidocholate + H2O.

name: L-tryptophan conjugated cholate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholate + L-tryptophan = L-tryptophocholate + H2O.

name: lipid exchange activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a specific lipid molecule from one membrane to another, coupled with the simultaneous counter-transfer of a different lipid molecule in the opposite direction.

name: N(6),N(6),N(6)-trimethyl-L-lysine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of N(6),N(6),N(6)-trimethyl-L-lysine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: dimethylarginine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of dimethylarginine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: phosphatidylserine receptor activity
definition: Combining with phosphatidylserine and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: sodium ion sequestering activity
definition: Binding to a sodium ion to prevent it from interacting with other partners or to inhibit its localization to the area of the cell or complex where it is active.

name: flavin transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-threonyl-[protein] + FAD = FMN-L-threonyl-[protein] + AMP + H+.

name: lipid chaperone activity
definition: Binding to a lipid and delivering it to an acceptor protein, including enzymes, nuclear receptors, and other lipid-binding proteins. The lipid may be presented while bound to the chaperone for enzymatic modification or signaling, or fully transferred to the acceptor protein.

name: phycoerythrobilin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: biliverdin IXalpha + 2 reduced ferredoxin + 4 H+ = (3Z)-phycoerythrobilin + 2 oxidized ferredoxin.

name: tRNA(Val) (adenine(37)-N6)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + adenosine(37) in tRNA(Val) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + N(6)-methyladenosine(37) in tRNA(Val) + H+.

name: vesicle membrane tethering activity
definition: A membrane-membrane adaptor activity that provides the first point of contact and physically bridges the vesicle membrane and its target membrane prior to vesicle docking and fusion.

name: actin-filament cross-linking activity
definition: An adaptor activity that brings together two actin filaments, enabling the bundling or networking of actin filaments (F-actin).

name: peroxisome-chloroplast membrane tether activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together the peroxisome membrane and the chloroplast membrane, establishing the localization of the peroxisome close to the chloroplast.

name: endoplasmic reticulum-vacuole tether activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together an endoplasmic reticulum membrane and a vacuole membrane either via membrane lipid binding or by interacting with a membrane protein, to establish or maintain membrane contact sites.

name: contractile vacuole-plasma membrane tether activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together the contractile vacuolar membrane and the plasma membrane, either via membrane lipid binding or by interacting with a membrane protein, to establish or maintain the localization of the contractile vacuole at a specific plasma membrane discharge site.

name: ferric iron reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 Fe2+ + NADP+ + H+ = 2 Fe3+ + NADPH.

name: double-stranded RNA immune receptor activity
definition: Combining with a double-stranded RNA and transmitting the signal to initiate an innate immune response.

name: left-handed Z-RNA immune receptor activity
definition: Combining with a left-handed Z-RNA and transmitting the signal to initiate an innate immune response. Z-RNA is a left-handed double-helical conformation of RNA in which the phosphate backbone zigzags.

name: questin reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: questin hydroquinone + NADP+ = questin + NADPH + 2 H+.

name: questin hydroquinone dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: questin hydroquinone + O2 = demethylsulochrin + 2 H+.

name: resveratrol dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-resveratrol + O2 = 3,5-dihydroxybenzaldehyde + 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde.

name: sodium channel activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a sodium channel.
